links.title: RamseyGadgets: A Graph Construction Dataset for LLMs

evidence: Experiments and Results / Table 1: Gemma-4-31B achieves 51.83 ± 3.05% mean accuracy and 66.20% Pass@5 in the Multiround setting with a graph colorer, the best result on the dataset; abstract reports 37.70% accuracy on hard-tier problems.

RamseyGadgets / Notes on our Dataset: '13×6+9×4=70' problems from 13 (F,H) pairs and three gadget types; 26 determiner problems labeled 'easy', 44 labeled 'hard'; four polynomial-time hardness-gadget cases excluded.

Verification of Results: (F,H)-good colorings correspond to satisfying assignments of a CNF formula psi_G over edge-color variables; determiner verification checks satisfiability of psi_G and unsatisfiability of psi_G ∧ (¬r_e), implemented with PySAT/Glucose per Implementation Details.

Results (Impact of Minimal Solution Size): authors state 'our dataset only has 8 problems that have minimal solutions with at least 8 vertices (see Figure 3), making it difficult to assert this trend,' while noting the 4-to-7-vertex degradation is well represented.

Results (Impact of Structural and Size Hints): structural hint 'typically had a negative effect'; size hint improves gpt-oss-120b from 21.14% to 25.71% accuracy (Pass@5 38.57% to 48.57%) in Table 1; example-hint comparison (Table 2) covers only 30 problems.

Reproducibility: dataset and verification scripts at github.com/deepakpandita57/RamseyGadgets; Appendix A lists hyperparameters (max_tokens 32K, per-model settings; Gemma temperature field left blank) and Appendix B points to prompt files in the released package; experiments run on 12 GH200 nodes via vLLM.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A directly in-scope LLM reasoning/evaluation benchmark: it tests five open-weight LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-31B, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen3-235B, DeepSeek-R1) on graph construction, with hint-based prompting ablations (structural/size/example) and a multiround tool-use setting using a graph colorer, hitting the LLM, reasoning, prompting, tool-use, and evaluation preferences. The dataset is genuinely novel and well-motivated: 70 underexplored Ramsey-good gadget problems chosen to limit training-data recollection, solutions capped at 10 vertices, SAT-verifiable (psi_G encoding), and expandable by varying (F,H). Rigor is solid but imperfect: 5 runs with mean±std and Pass@5, difficulty tiers (26 easy/44 hard), and honest caveats (only 8 problems with minimal solutions >=8 vertices; example-hint setting restricted to 30 problems); however, no significance testing, the Gemma temperature is left blank in the appendix, and the claimed '(10%)' size-hint gain for gpt-oss-120b is ambiguous (4.57 points accuracy, 10 points Pass@5). Evidence is mostly quantitative and traceable to Tables 1-2 and Figures 3-6. Generalizability is limited by the small, niche Ramsey-theory instance set, though the contamination-resistance-by-underexploration design and hint/tool findings plausibly transfer. Reproducibility is good: public GitHub dataset, verification scripts, prompts in code files, hyperparameters and hardware/software stack documented.

primary_link.title: RamseyGadgets: A Graph Construction Dataset for LLMs

papers.summary: Constructing special graphs is an important task within graph theory and computer science. Many popular graph constructions are the result of a comprehensive exploration of relevant graphs and human ingenuity. papers.summary_zh: 為評估 LLM 的圖形建構推理能力並避免訓練資料污染，本文提出 RamseyGadgets：70 個文獻中較少被探索的 Ramsey-good 圖形建構問題。題目要求建構具有特定著色性質的圖，如強制某邊在所有 good 著色中恆為紅色的 determiner gadget、兩邊同色或異色的 sender gadget，以及模擬 SAT 子句的 hardness gadget；解至多 10 個頂點，可透過 SAT 求解器自動驗證，且改變禁制單色子圖即可擴充資料集。作者評估五個開源模型：零樣本下最佳為 Gemma-4-31B（準確率 36.00%、Pass@5 51.43%），DeepSeek-R1 與 Llama-3.1-8B 表現不佳；給予圖形著色工具的多輪設定將 Gemma-4-31B 提升至 51.83%（Pass@5 66.20%），但在困難層級僅 37.70%。提示分析顯示一般性結構提示常反而降低表現，而尺寸與範例提示幾乎總是有幫助；表現亦隨最小解頂點數增加而下降。Qwen3-235B 的 token 成本最高，Gemma-4-31B 兼具成本與效能。限制為 F、H 增大時最小解難以計算。此資料集為圖形建構推理提供了可驗證、可擴充且抗飽和的測試平台。

links.title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs

evidence: Sec.3.2/Alg.1: OrderDecompose is an ordered hierarchical LLM proof search with SMT-30s subgoal closure, lemma proposal, and citation/unchanged checks (line 7).
Sec.4.1/4.2: double-blind human evaluation with 14 reviewers, 127 completed assignments, 254 step-fidelity ratings, 381 pairwise preferences; mean step-fidelity 4.52 vs 3.68 (Fig.2).
Sec.4.3/Table 2: fill-stage ablation (N=15, 3 runs each, 12h budget): OrderDecompose 15/15 coverage vs LLM-only 6/15, cost/success $15.6 vs $28.8.
Sec.4.4/Fig.6: cold-compile cactus plot, 48/48 Book I propositions compile vs 41 for LeanEuclid; whole book 13.3 min vs 7.3+ h (Sec.4.4, 33x claim).
Sec.4.5 + Appendix B.2-B.4: 33 assumption gaps (11/5/17 across Books I-III), 2 citation mistakes, 17 generic gaps, totaling the claimed 52.
Appendix E: ablation fairness controls (same model Opus 4.8, isolated worktrees, memory wiped, anti-cheating/auto-fail rules), but the ablated arm loses skills, scripts, hooks, and memory jointly.
Sec.6 Limitations: study limited to Euclidean geometry in System E (7 Book III props skipped, Appendix H), oracle reliance, conditions necessary but not sufficient.

Appendix A/F: implementation artifacts (euclid_sentence tactic, skills under .claude/skills/, reproducible_experiments/compile_time/ CSVs) support partial reproducibility, though no repo URL is stated in the text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent methodology paper (not a pure domain application): Pistis is an agentic, oracle-guided proof search (Claude Code/Opus driving skills, hooks, tools) that formalizes Euclid's Elements proofs into faithful Lean artifacts. Strong alignment with the highest-weight preferences: agentic orchestration, mathematical reasoning/decomposition (OrderDecompose), LLM-driven code synthesis, plus LLM-as-judge evaluation. Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: a five-condition faithfulness taxonomy and citation-enforced ordered decomposition are new relative to LeanEuclid/ProofFlow, yet hierarchical LLM decomposition search exists (HyperTree, Goedel-Code-Prover) and authors acknowledge the lineage. Rigor is comparatively strong: double-blind human study (14 independent reviewers, 127 assignments, anonymization, randomized order, live Lean server), two-model LLM-judge rubrics, anti-cheating ablation controls (Appendix E), and formal refutations checked in Lean; weaknesses include an ablation that conflates the algorithm with its tooling, a subjective human/LLM oracle for faithfulness, no significance testing, and a single narrow domain. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (15/15 vs 6/15 ablation coverage, $15.6 vs $28.8 per success, 48/48 vs 41/48 compiles, 52 gaps tallying 33+2+17), though headline ratios (2.89x, 5.2x, 33x) are simple aggregates partly driven by baseline timeouts. Generalizability is explicitly capped by the authors (System E, Euclidean geometry, oracle reliance, conditions necessary-not-sufficient). Reproducibility is moderate: detailed model/Lean/solver versions, released artifacts and result CSVs are referenced, but no repository URL is given and the proprietary model plus human oracle limit exact replication.

primary_link.title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs

papers.summary: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof
papers.summary_zh: 可編譯的形式證明未必反映自然語言論證如何抵達結論，作者稱此性質為忠實性並指出其長期被忽視。本文提出五項忠實形式的必要條件（覆蓋、原子性、原子忠實、順序與引用）加上 Lean 編譯健全性，並建構 Pistis 框架：map 階段由 LLM 代理與人類或 LLM 神諭協作，將自然語言證明切分為原子句、產生帶 sorry 的 Lean 模板；fill 階段以 OrderDecompose 進行有序的分治式證明搜尋，逐句以 30 秒 SMT 預算或中繼引理關閉子目標，失敗時透過反證暴露自然語言論證的缺口。應用於《幾何原本》前三卷 92 個命題，Pistis 證明編譯速度較 LeanEuclid 快逾 33 倍（第一卷 13.3 分鐘對 7.3 小時以上），48 個命題全數編譯成功；雙盲人類評審在 127 份完成的評分中以 2.89 倍比率偏好 Pistis，LLM 評審則以 26:5 勝負比支持。消融顯示 OrderDecompose 在 12 小時預算內完成 15/15 命題，純 LLM 基線僅 6/15 且成本更高。系統另標記 33 個假設缺口、2 個真實引用錯誤與 17 個一般缺口，並能反駁 AI 生成的證明。限制為僅涵蓋 System E 的歐氏幾何且依賴神諭。忠實形式化因此成為檢驗人類與 AI 論證的實用工具。

links.title: RoE-FND: Synergizing LLMs with Experiential Learning for Effective and Generalizable Evidence-Based Fake News Detection

evidence: Abstract/§1: two-stage framework — offline self-reflective experience building with ground-truth label as posterior supervision, then online deliberation with flipped pseudo-label; evaluated on CHEF, Snopes, PolitiFact, FakeTT, FakeSV.
§3.1/Algorithm 1: IntuitiveAnalyst vs InformedAnalyst dual analysis, Reflector distills divergence into entity-free guidelines, entries individually validated and merged via similarity threshold.
§3.3: temperature 1.0; th_re=0.9 and th_dis=0.25 'empirically set'; models are OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen via APIs, no parameter fine-tuning except distillation variant.
Table 1: RoE-FND (4o-mini) CHEF ACC 0.891 vs OpenAI o1 0.890 and DeepSeek-R1 0.882; RoE-FND (DeepSeekv3) Snopes ACC 0.863 vs D2D 0.818; distilled RoE-FND* PolitiFact ACC 0.891 marked 'Trained'.
Table 3: cross-dataset accuracy drop for RoE-FND is 1.7% (Snopes→PolitiFact) and 3.1% (PolitiFact→Snopes) vs 8.7-15.9% for GET/SEE/MUSER/L-Defense.

Table 4: w/o Reflector CHEF ACC 0.610 (-21.8%), w/o Advisor 0.748 (-8.0%); Fixed/Random/News-based retrieval all underperform query-from-discrepancy retrieval; text describes 'w/o InformedAnalyst' ablation absent from the table.
Table 2: RoE-FND (Qwen-VL) FakeTT ACC 0.882 and FakeSV 0.890 vs trained ExMRD 0.842/0.869 and Qwen-VL+RAG 0.710/0.694.
Appendix A: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings with cosine similarity, τ_re=0.9, τ_s=0.97; LoRA r=16, α=32, lr 2e-5 AdamW for distillation.
Appendix B/Tables 5-6: per-module token budgets and deployment cost 484.9-764.0 output tokens per sample vs Self-Reflect/D2D/DeepSeek-R1.
Appendix C heading 'Prompt of RoE-FND' present but no prompt content appears in the document; no code or artifact availability statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology-centric paper (agent-based analysts/reflector/advisor/judger, CoT deliberation, retrieved experience bank, LoRA distillation) applied to fake news detection across five text and multimedia benchmarks; squarely matches the LLM, reasoning/CoT, agents, and RAG preferences, so it is not penalized as a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: reflective experience accumulation and deliberation combine known ingredients (Self-Refine, debate, memory/RAG) with the new twist of flipped-posterior dual analysis and per-entry validation. Rigor is decent but flawed: broad baselines, cross-dataset tests, component and retrieval-strategy ablations, and token-cost reporting are present, yet results tie or trail OpenAI o1/DeepSeek-R1 in several cells (e.g., CHEF ACC 0.891 vs 0.890), the strongest variant is a distilled 'trained' model, no significance testing or seeds are reported, thresholds are 'empirically set' without sensitivity analysis, and the ablation text/table are inconsistent (numbering repeats; 'w/o InformedAnalyst' described but table shows 'w/o Dual Analysis'). Evidence strength follows the same limits; quantitative tables are specific and ablation deltas are large (Reflector removal -21.8% on CHEF), but single-run numbers and mixed reported-vs-rerun baselines weaken confidence. Generalizability is comparatively strong (cross-dataset drop 1.7-3.1% vs 8.7-15.9% for trained baselines) though only tested between two related fact-checking datasets. Reproducibility is below average: commercial APIs required, no code release, and Appendix C's prompt section is effectively empty in the document despite claims that prompts are provided.

We propose \textbf{RoE-FND} (\textbf{\underl
papers.summary_zh: 現有假新聞偵測管線若仰賴標註資料訓練則泛化受限，直接使用 LLM 又易過度信賴具說服力卻有瑕疵的推理，且缺乏累積可複用經驗的機制。作者提出 RoE-FND，分兩階段運作：離線經驗建構階段，先由 Intuitive Analyst 自由推理，若預測錯誤則呼叫獲得真值標籤後驗的 Informed Analyst 產生對照的正確分析，Reflector 比對兩者的關鍵分歧，濃縮為不含具體實體的關鍵字與短說明，每條經驗須個別驗證能修正原始錯誤方能入庫，再透過語意相似度合併與平均優勢分數過濾進行動態經驗管理。線上階段以翻轉偽標籤產生兩份結論相反的分析，Advisor 比對分歧並檢索最相關經驗，Judger 依經驗評分選出論證較佳者作為最終預測。在 CHEF、Snopes、PolitiFact、FakeTT、FakeSV 五個資料集上，RoE-FND（4o-mini）於 CHEF 達 0.891 準確率且不需微調；以 Qwen-VL 處理多媒體在 FakeTT、FakeSV 分別達 0.882 與 0.890。跨資料集測試準確率僅下降 1.7-3.1%，遠低於訓練式基線的 8.7-15.9%；消融顯示移除 Reflector 掉逾 19 個百分點。限制為多階段推論成本較高。此框架展示經驗累積如何提升 LLM 推理可靠性與跨域泛化。

links.title: When Do Concepts Become Functionally Sufficient During Language-Model Training?

evidence: Abstract/§6.1, Table 1: 'Downstream selection ... uses 6.6% - about one fifteenth of the candidate budget - at relative KL 0.020 and 0.80 percentage-point accuracy damage' vs reconstruction 73.0% soft occupancy at rel KL 0.009; downstream median NMSE 0.959 vs 0.215, supporting geometry-function separation.

§3: framework fits dictionaries (SVD/ICA/NMF/SemiNMF) per model/checkpoint/layer, selects sparse soft masks on calibration data, and 'Test evaluation replaces H_test by the masked reconstruction in the original graph' - sufficiency tested by intervention, not reconstruction alone.

§5, Propositions 1-2 and Appendix C: exact Taylor/Fisher remainder bound relating downstream KL to curvature-weighted reconstruction error, and the variance-of-the-mean identity for supervised concept-gate moments (tau, omega); proofs provided.

§6.4, Tables A8-A10: downstream hard masks enriched 3.26x (tau) and 5.32x (omega) at model-hierarchical medians with 7.3% hard occupancy capturing 49%/75% of score mass; activation-energy head is a strong baseline (rank correlation 0.85-0.96) and downstream selections reach 0.909/0.938 median oracle efficiency.

Limitations section: 'one run per model, and checkpoint, layer, method, and target cells are correlated repeated measurements rather than independent replications'; 'Evaluation observes one target-token prediction per sequence'; 'sufficiency is operational and target-conditional... at the single regularization setting used'.

Appendix A: full grid of exact artifacts (e.g., EleutherAI/pythia-70m, allenai/OLMo-1B-0724-hf), checkpoint lists, data sources with counts and seed offsets (base seed 13 plus source offsets), fixed hyperparameters, and software versions; however 'Exact accelerator-hour accounting was not retained' and 'Artifacts are identified by repository and checkpoint names rather than immutable repository commits'; no code or artifact release is mentioned.

Appendix A/B: K_max clamp diagnostic ('Every stored estimate reached the d/4 lower clip'), one seed per model, and stratified contrasts (Table A5) show results are protocol-specific operating points, not universal rankings.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope interpretability work on language models: a checkpoint-wise activation-intervention framework testing when sparse concept masks become functionally sufficient (reconstruction, fixed-head decodability, downstream KL preservation, checkpoint transfer) across seven pretrained LMs (Pythia 70M-410M, OLMo-1B, EuroBERT-210M/610M, ModernCamemBERT). Strong preference fit to Interpretability & Explainability, LLMs, Training & Optimization, and Transformer topics, though models are small and no frontier LLMs are studied. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the multi-target, longitudinal intervention framing and the exact Fisher-curvature interpretation of downstream KL (Propositions 1-2) are new combinations of established tools (SAEs, NMF/ICA, amnesic probing). Rigor is high: disjoint train/cal/test splits, exact within-cell pairing, shared fixed penalty acknowledged as a single operating point, proofs in Appendix C, and unusually candid limitations (one seed per model, correlated repeated measurements, no significance tests, sufficiency is target-conditional and not an onset-time claim). Evidence is extensive and calibrated (6.6% median downstream soft occupancy at rel KL 0.020 vs 73.0% for reconstruction; 93.2% trade-off rate; enrichment 3.26x/5.32x for tau/omega; oracle capture 0.909/0.938), but purely descriptive with medians over structured, non-independent cells and single-token evaluation. Generalizability is limited by model scale (70M-1B), four families, English/French data, and one target-token prediction per sequence - authors state extension to generation, instruction following, or larger models needs dedicated evaluation. Reproducibility is strong on protocol detail (exact repo IDs, checkpoint grids, seeds/offsets, hyperparameters, software versions) but no code release is stated, artifacts are not pinned to immutable commits, and accelerator-hour accounting was not retained.

papers.summary: Understanding a model and its learning mechanisms in depth requires identifying when its internal structures become useful, rather than simply looking at the final state. We study this through concept dynamics: at each layer and checkpoint, we decompose activations, select sparse soft masks, and inject masked reconstructions into the model. Concept analysis is therefore tested functionally: a mask is useful only insofar as it preserves a target under intervention. We compare sufficiency for acti
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討語言模型訓練過程中，內部概念結構何時真正發揮功能，而非僅可被重構。作者提出「概念動力學」框架：在每個層與檢查點，對激活值進行 SVD、ICA、NMF、SemiNMF 等分解，以稀疏軟遮罩選取座標，再將遮罩後的重構注入原模型，於保留測試資料上執行干預實驗。框架比較四種保存目標：激活重構、固定線性頭可解碼性、真實下游行為，以及跨檢查點遷移（學習對齊）。在七個模型（三個 Pythia、OLMo-1B、EuroBERT-210M/610M、ModernCamemBERT）上，以下游行為為目標的遮罩僅保留約 6.6% 軟遮罩容量，就能在相對 KL 僅 0.020 下保存預測分布；重構目標則需 73%，其 NMSE 為 0.215，下游遮罩 NMSE 卻高達 0.959，呈現幾何與功能的分離，作者以局部 Fisher 曲率加權解釋此現象。各模型亦展現各自的時間與深度特徵，下游遮罩並對監督梯度敏感度（τ、ω）顯著富集。限制包括每模型僅單次執行、僅評估單一目標 token，充分性屬操作定義而非可解釋性保證。此工作把靜態分解轉為縱向功能量測，有助區分「被表示」與「被使用」的資訊。

links.title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference

evidence: Abstract: 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput; 70.3534% vs 70.8996% normalized MC accuracy (99.23% retention) across 12,450 questions.

Section 1: 'Our contribution is empirical and systems-oriented rather than theoretical. Expert-only quantization, LRU-style caching, and MARLIN are not individually new. The contribution is their integration into a complete-expert runtime.'

Section 4.4: 'no external MoE quantization or offloading system was reproduced on the same hardware. The results therefore establish the measured quality-memory-throughput trade-off of this implementation, not general superiority over existing serving systems.'
Section 5.2: aggregate accuracy change -0.546 points with paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.964, -0.137] and exact McNemar p=0.0112; HellaSwag delta -0.71 (p=0.0027).

Section 5.3: fused grouped execution reaches 18.43 tok/s vs 9.36 tok/s sequential W4 reference (1.97x) with identical greedy tokens; kernel max relative mean error 0.00560 vs dequantized W4 reference.

Section 4.1 and Section 7: single NVIDIA L4, OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct at fixed revision 7f1c97f4; method requires MARLIN-compatible dimensions and NVIDIA GPUs, with quality retention acknowledged to vary across models and tasks.

Reproducibility Statement: archive contains raw request measurements, per-example predictions, cache/routing statistics, configuration files, execution logs, executed runtime, and SHA-256 checksums, though no public URL is given.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on memory-efficient LLM inference for sparse MoE models (OLMoE) via expert-only W4A16 quantization, kernel-native pinned host storage, and fused grouped MARLIN execution in vLLM. It matches LLM, MoE/Transformer-architecture, inference-serving, and efficiency preferences, though not the highest-weighted themes (Japanese LLMs, agents, reasoning). Novelty is modest and self-acknowledged: expert-only quantization, LRU caching, and MARLIN are known, with the contribution being their integration plus a measured memory-transfer-throughput frontier. Rigor and evidence are strong for the claims made: same-checkpoint, same-hardware controlled comparison, paired bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests over 12,450 questions, a fused-vs-sequential ablation (1.97x), kernel correctness gates, and internally consistent numbers (87.04% memory reduction, 99.23% accuracy retention, 47.4% full-residency speedup). Key weaknesses: single model and single L4 GPU, no external MoE offloading/quantization baselines reproduced (Section 4.4), single-sweep batch measurements, and MARLIN/NVIDIA dimension constraints, all of which limit generalizability. The reproducibility statement is unusually detailed (model revision hash, MARLIN commit, software versions, seeds, archived per-example predictions with SHA-256 checksums), but no explicit public artifact URL appears in the text.

primary_link.title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference

papers.summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kern
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏混合專家（MoE）模型雖只啟用少數專家，部署時仍須儲存與搬移整組專家權重，形成 GPU 記憶體瓶頸。本文提出 ExactMoE：僅對被路由專家施加對稱分組 128 的四位元（W4A16）權重量化，以 MARLIN 核心原生格式封裝，同時存放於釘選主機記憶體與可設定的 GPU 插槽快取；路由器、注意力、詞嵌入、正規化層與語言模型頭維持 BF16。推論時透過批次專家 ID 解析與分波融合核心執行所有被選中的專家，全程不產生 FP16 中間權重。「Exact」意指專家完整可用且 top-k 路由程序不變，而非與 BF16 數值完全相同。在單張 NVIDIA L4 上的 OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct 實驗顯示：16 插槽設定將峰值保留 GPU 記憶體自 14.168 GiB 降至 1.836 GiB（降低 87.04%），仍保留 BF16 解碼吞吐量的 81.85%；64 插槽全駐留達 31.923 tokens/s，較 BF16 的 21.662 快 47.4%。在 12,450 道零樣本選擇題上，標準化準確率 70.35% 對 BF16 的 70.90%，保留 99.23%，但配對統計檢定顯示微小且可偵測的下降。融合分組執行比逐專家序列執行快 1.97 倍。限制包括依賴路由局部性與主機記憶體、需 MARLIN 相容維度，且未與外部系統直接比較。此研究描繪出完整專家 MoE 推論的記憶體—傳輸—吞吐量取捨邊界。

Section 4.4: DeepSeek final-score evidence $15.20, adaptation $37.02, total $52.22, versus $574.68 submission-reported GPT cost; extended-timeout aggregate 88.76% is labeled descriptive.
Page 4, contributions: 'Core code and several runtime cases is opensourced at github' — no specific repository URL given.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A central Agents & Tool Use paper (weight 2.5) improving a fixed LLM's completed-task reliability via an externalized state-machine runbook, with coding-agent benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1, RefactorBench), cost-efficiency claims, and cross-model transfer — squarely on-preference. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes harness adaptation and cross-model transfer are not novel (Section 2), positioning the contribution as the agent-native, jointly editable runbook, closely adjacent to StateFlow and 2026 harness-evolution work. Rigor is mixed: the frozen-profile protocol, adjudication sensitivity analysis, and reported negative transfer are commendable, but headline comparisons use non-matched public references (footnote 3, page 11), the Terminal-Bench profile was developed on the benchmark's visible tasks, and the paper states results 'do not isolate the effect of the state-machine abstraction alone' (Section 3.1) with Table 3 associations explicitly 'not a component ablation'. Evidence strength is limited by self-reported, pre-adjudication scores: 95.28% raw falls to 94.38%/93.26% under disclosed exclusions, and the PR is open and unmerged (page 4, footnote 1); the '$15' title figure covers final-score evidence only, with total DeepSeek spend $52.22 (Section 4.4). Generalizability is genuinely probed (frozen GPT transfer, failed exact transfer to DeepSeek, BusinessBench held-out gains of only +0.55 macro with two negative families, Table 1). Reproducibility benefits from detailed costs, versions, hardware, and an example runbook (Appendix A), but the open-source claim is a placeholder 'github' link (page 4) and models are proprietary.

primary_link.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents can fail even when their underlying models can solve the constituent steps. They may lose track of mutable state, fail to reactivate lessons from earlier executions, skip known procedures, or stop prematurely. We bet on harness scaling to improve the execution system around an agent without changing its model weights. We introduce StateM, an agent-native runtime that organizes execution around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and
papers.summary_zh: 長程代理即使具備完成各步驟的能力，仍常因周邊執行系統（harness）失誤而整體失敗。本文提出 harness scaling 概念，並介紹 StateM：一個代理原生的輕量執行環境，以 YAML runbook 狀態機組織執行，包含持久狀態、階段局部上下文、受檢查的轉移、可復原程序與版本化的程序性實務，代理與使用者可共同檢視與修訂。狀態同時是上下文與合約邊界：進入時刷新指令與進度，離開須滿足可執行的退出條件；失敗驅動的最佳化迴圈把執行失敗轉為版本化的提示、檢查、鉤子與修復規則，模型權重維持不變。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，GPT-5.5 xhigh 加 StateM 達 92.1%，優於 83.1% 參考值；該 runbook 凍結後直接遷移至 GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh，錄得 95.28% 原始準確率（424/445，公開提交、尚未裁定），GPT-5.6 Luna 更從 76.7% 升至 85.4%。凍結設定直接套用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 會失敗（82.0%），經低成本調適後在標準逾時下達 88.09%，最終分數證據僅花費約 15 美元，對照 GPT 參考的 574.68 美元。BusinessBench 顯示遷移遵循機制匹配：總體增益溫和，兩個機制相符任務家族提升 10.04 點。限制包括分數尚未裁定、描述性彙總、每模型單次執行，且效果無法將執行環境與程序內容分離。此研究把 harness 定位為與模型擴展互補的能力軸。
papers.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
papers.title_zh: StateM：透過 Harness Scaling 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 達成 95.3% 原始準確率，或 15 美元的旗艦級跑分

links.title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG

evidence: Abstract: claims gains in answer quality and evidence faithfulness on ScienceQA, MultiModalQA, OK-VQA with large distractor evidence pools
Sections 3.5-3.6: reliability-calibrated router selects Top-k HieraSlot slots; KG-JSA++ injects slots plus sparse self-KV (attention-sink style) into frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
Section 4.3 Table 1: GraphLoom 92.5 ScienceQA Acc, 55.2 EM / 66.5 F1 on MMQA vs InternVL3 91.8 / 51.4 / 62.8; GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 listed as reference-only
Section 4.4 Table 3: removing reliability-calibrated router raises H-Rate 10.5→17.3 and removing KG-JSA++ drops EM 55.2→50.5, largest ablation degradations
Section 4.5 Table 4: Recall@5 falls 78.4→73.2 and online latency 119→148 ms as distractor pool grows to 1M triples, F1 drops only 1.4 points
Section 4.6 Table 5: ±20% threshold perturbations keep MMQA EM/F1 within 0.8 points of default
Section 4.7 Table 6: independent MiniCheck H-Rate 10.5% for GraphLoom vs 14.8% Flat-RAG and 15.2% RARR; 300-example human validation with three annotators
Section 4.8: ~1.6M trainable parameters, full hyperparameter list, one A100 80GB, code at github.com/Zafar-southeast/GraphLoom
Section 4.1: MMQA answer/retrieval results reported on labeled dev split (2,441 instances) because test annotations unavailable
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal KG-RAG system with a frozen LLM (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) decoder, matching RAG/knowledge, hallucination-faithfulness, LLM, multimodal-AI, and memory/efficiency preferences; it is not Japanese-NLP, agentic, or code-focused, which limits the highest-weight preference overlap. Novelty is integration-level: HieraSlot entity/relation slot memories, a reliability-calibrated router, and KG-JSA++ sparse joint attention are assembled from established components (REBEL, ConceptNet/VG150, IRCoT-style interleaving, CRAG-style correction, RARR-style revision, StreamingLLM attention sinks), though decoder-time reliability-calibrated slot routing is a reasonably fresh contribution. Rigor is strong: three benchmarks, five-run means with std, component/feature/knowledge-source ablations (Section 4.4, Table 3), ECE calibration analysis, scalability to 1M distractors (Table 4), ±20% threshold robustness (Table 5), and dual-pipeline latency accounting (Table 7). Faithfulness is deliberately de-circularized by using MiniCheck (not the revision-time NLI) plus 300-example human validation (Section 4.7). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent but self-reported; closed-source GPT-5/Gemini comparisons are correctly treated as reference-only. Generalizability is supported across multiple-choice and open-ended QA and noisy pools, though the pipeline is tied to specific embedders/verifiers and instance-level graphs; MMQA results use the dev split (Section 4.1), a minor scope caveat. Reproducibility is aided by a code release and full hyperparameter/threshold disclosure (Section 4.8).

primary_link.title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG

papers.summary: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often rely on long unstructured contexts or aggressively expanded evidence graphs, which can introduce noisy evidence, weaken multi-hop reasoning, and increase unsupported generation. We present GraphLoom, a reliability-calibrated multimodal knowledge-graph RAG framework for compact and faithful evidence routing. Given a question and its associated multimodal input, GraphLoom constructs an instance-level multimodal knowledge graph from grou
papers.summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）常依賴冗長非結構化上下文或過度擴張的證據圖，容易引入雜訊、削弱多跳推理並增加無據生成。本文提出 GraphLoom，一個可靠度校準的多模態知識圖 RAG 框架：以 Qwen3-VL 產生場景描述、REBEL 抽取三元組，並融合 Visual Genome 與 ConceptNet 建構實例級 MMKG；再以 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 執行有界擴張的子圖檢索，對多跳問題進行交錯檢索，必要時觸發至多一次預算內的校正檢索。檢索到的三元組轉為實體與關係兩類 HieraSlot 鍵值槽記憶，由可靠度校準路由器估計效用與可信度，僅選取少數槽位，經 KG-JSA++ 聯合圖—序列注意力注入凍結的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，並對自注意力採稀疏 KV 以降低推理成本。生成後以 NLI 進行證據綁定的驗證—修訂，最終忠實度另以獨立的 MiniCheck 與人工評估，避免循環評估。結果顯示 ScienceQA 92.5%、MMQA 55.2 EM/66.5 F1、OK-VQA 70.5%，皆優於強基線；消融顯示路由器與 KG-JSA++ 貢獻最大，幻覺率 10.5% 為最低。在混入一百萬干擾三元組的雜訊證據池下效能僅漸進下降，門檻擾動 ±20% 仍穩定，快取後線上延遲 119 毫秒。限制為門檻由驗證資料選定、封閉模型僅作參考比較。此框架顯示可靠度感知的證據路由可取代更長上下文。
papers.title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG
papers.title_zh: GraphLoom：可靠度校準的圖譜證據路由，應用於多模態 KG-RAG

links.title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework

evidence: Abstract: 'T-LLM Compiler achieves code optimization accuracy of up to 83.3% and a speedup of up to 16.1% on the PolyBench/C benchmarks'
Section 3.2: verification chain 'comprises three verification steps... syntax verification, symbolic verification using the CBMC tool (bounded model checking), and LLM-based verification'

Section 3.1.1: Recommender 'employs a low-rank adaptation supervised-finetuned (LoRA-SFT) Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct large language model' trained on 3,418 LORE-derived examples with PolyBench/C subset excluded
Table 5 (Sec 4.3): 'accuracy improves from 60% in the no-verification baseline to 87% with the full verification chain' (Optimizer + Syntax Verifier + CBMC + 3-way LLM)
Section 4.4: 'Across 400 test cases... the CBMC Verifier reported an accuracy of 87%, a false rejection rate of 8.4% and a false acceptance rate of 33.8%'
Table 3 (Sec 4.1): Qwen2.5-32B achieves 90% transformed kernels, 100% accuracy, 1.178x speedup vs CodeLlama-7B (6.67% transformed, 0.99x) and CodeLlama-13B (10% transformed, 0.97x)
Section 3.2.2 Limitations: 'matrix sizes needed to be under 15 x 15 for successful CBMC verification' and float types forced 'use of integer array elements'
Future Directions: 'most of the functions being optimized fit roughly under 50 lines of code; however, for larger functions that are more complex and longer, optimization remains a challenge'
Footnote 1: source code released at https://github.com/BiSheng-Compiler-Agents/CCE-WOZ/tree/tllm-compiler
Appendix A (Figs 8-19): full optimizer, verifier, and recommender prompts provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-for-code framework (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct optimizer, CodeLlama comparisons, LoRA-SFT Qwen2.5-Coder-3B recommender) with extensive few-shot/zero-shot/CoT prompting methodology, matching LLM (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), and Prompting/ICL (1.5) preferences. Novelty is moderate: LLM code optimization with verifier feedback exists (LLM-Vectorizer, ECO, LLM Compiler); the claimed first use of CBMC for C-level LLM-transform equivalence checking and the 3-way verification chain (syntax+CBMC+LLM) plus prompt recommender are useful but incremental systems contributions. Rigor is decent: 16-prompt ablation (Table 2), verification-chain ablation showing accuracy 60%->87% (Table 5), CBMC error analysis over 400 cases (8.4% false rejection, 33.8% false acceptance, Sec 4.4), and 3-model comparison (Table 3); however, evaluation is confined to 30 PolyBench/C kernels, 'Best of All Prompts' (100% accuracy, 1.175x) is oracle selection not achievable system performance (deployable recommender reaches only 80-83.3% accuracy), and no head-to-head with prior LLM-optimization systems or significance testing. Evidence is internally consistent but small-scale; abstract claims (83.3% accuracy, 16.1% speedup) trace to the no-CoT recommender and one-shot prompt 4. Generalizability is limited: integer-only arrays forced by CBMC, matrices under 15x15, functions under ~50 lines, five loop-optimization techniques only (Sec 3.2.2, Future Directions). Reproducibility is good: open-source code release (footnote 1), full prompts in Appendix A, LoRA hyperparameters (rank 32, alpha 32, 3 epochs), and public models/datasets (LORE with PolyBench/C excluded).

primary_link.title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework

papers.summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened opportunities to apply high-level code transformations to the field of code optimization, and it has since emerged as one of the most fundamental tasks for LLMs to perform; however, at present, LLMs struggle to apply wide-ranging code optimization tasks due to both the complexity of the code and the inability to independently verify the correctness of the transformations. In this paper, we present the Trusted LLM (T-LLM) Compiler, which
papers.summary_zh: T-LLM Compiler 針對大型語言模型（LLM）在程式碼最佳化中難以獨立驗證正確性的問題，提出一個結合 LLM 高階程式碼轉換、傳統編譯器與驗證工具的可信協作框架。系統以 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 執行五種迴圈最佳化（展開、融合、分塊、分裂、交換），並透過語法檢查、CBMC 符號驗證與 LLM 語意驗證組成的驗證鏈層層把關，錯誤回饋給最佳化器迭代修正，最後交由 BiSheng 編譯器進行低階最佳化。為挑選合適提示，作者另以 LoRA 微調 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 建立策略建議器，並比較 zero-shot、one-shot 與 two-shot 提示的效果。在 PolyBench/C 三十個基準上，框架達到最高 83.3% 的最佳化準確率與 16.1% 加速，轉換正確的核心平均加速 26.7%；消融實驗顯示完整驗證鏈將準確率從 60% 提升至 87%。限制包括 CBMC 僅能在有限迴圈展開深度與小矩陣規模下運作、浮點運算驗證成本過高、誤接受率達 33.8%，而 Alive2 在此情境因逾時效果不彰。此研究示範了 AI 與編譯器深度整合（作者定義的第三級）如何在保留正確性的前提下，解鎖傳統編譯器難以觸及的效能空間。
papers.title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework
papers.title_zh: T-LLM Compiler：基於 LLM 的可信程式碼最佳化與驗證框架

links.title: PEN-STACK: A non-fabricating tool layer for language-model agents in genome writing

evidence: Analyses, 'Grounding removes fabrication where prompting does not' (pp.10-11): naive no-tool fabrication of six tool-only quantities at 98.8% (hosted closed-weights), 90.8% (120B open-weights), 96.7% (1.5B local); coached residuals 0.0%/0.8%/1.7% with pairwise Fisher exact p=0.12-0.69.
Table 2, footnote d (p.52): grounded arm is a 4-goal audit recorded as one boolean per model; '3 of 12 model-goal runs made zero tool calls... passing because they emitted no ungrounded quantity'.

Discussion, limitations (p.23): fabrication probe is 70 adversarial items across three families and 'does not sweep natural traffic'; replicating the tool-driving arm across all forty goals is named as the needed extension.
Background (p.3): 'No novelty is claimed here in agentic orchestration or tool-grounded verification, both of which are established paradigms that PEN-STACK adopts as is.'
Analyses, biosecurity screen (p.12): 8/8 agreement with expert labels on eight designs; 'The Common Mechanism was not itself run against this set.'
Analyses, expression axis (p.13): held-out human K562 rho=0.571 on chromosomes 3/8/12; independent variant rho=0.558 beats learned heterochromatin baseline 0.493 by 0.065 (95% CI [0.026, 0.103]).
Potential implications (p.24): the no-fabrication invariant is framed as 'a general pattern that any tool layer an agent may call could adopt', supporting cross-domain generalizability claims.
Methods, fabrication benchmark (p.33): 'The panel contains no frontier-tier model... a panel of three families is too narrow to resolve any dependence of the fabrication rate on model scale.'
Table 3 (pp.52-53): ten SHA-locked pre-registered claims, eight non-passes shipped as machine-readable flags, with per-claim SHA-256 prefixes.

Reproducibility (p.33) and Availability (pp.34-35): bare-clone re-derivation with CI-failed assertions, GitHub repository and Zenodo deposit, MIT license, RRID, Docker image; Additional File 1 verifies the 22 MCP tools / 44 REST endpoints from the deposited source.
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper's spine is genuine LLM-agent methodology: a tool-grounding substrate (22 MCP tools, SDK, REST) for language-model agents plus a multi-provider fabrication benchmark (Claude Haiku-4.5, Nemotron-120B, Qwen2.5-1.5B) measuring naive (90.8-98.8%) versus coached (0-1.7%) quantity fabrication, a grounding-vs-prompting argument, and pre-emission biosecurity screening. This maps strongly onto the highest-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Prompting, RAG/grounding), though the surrounding domain is genome engineering with extensive biological validation of scientific components (expression axis, off-target, capsid fitness), and top-weight preferences like Japanese NLP and reasoning/CoT are absent; not a pure domain application since the LLM methodology is central and explicitly framed as domain-agnostic. Rigor is unusually high: SHA-locked pre-registrations, honest reporting of 8/10 null outcomes as machine-readable flags, Wilson intervals, Fisher exact tests (p=0.12-0.69), chromosome-holdout splits, and a de-circularization baseline; deductions for small key arms. The headline 'grounding removes fabrication' rests partly on a structural by-construction argument plus a small 4-goal agentic audit in which 3 of 12 runs made no tool calls, the biosecurity screen is 8/8 on eight designs without running the Common Mechanism, and only three non-frontier model families are tested. Novelty is moderate: grounding and tool verification are acknowledged established paradigms; the type-enforced no-fabrication invariant (frozen provenance, claim/candidate distinction) and the tool-only-quantity probe protocol are useful, incremental contributions. Evidence is strong for the committed, replayable ungrounded arm and for the held-out expression result (rho=0.571; de-circularized margin +0.065, CI excluding zero), thinner for the grounded arm. Generalizability of the invariant pattern is plausibly claimed, though cross-species transfer failed (rho=0.137 vs 0.391 baseline) and only one human cell type is tested. Reproducibility is exceptional: GitHub + Zenodo deposit, offline transcript replay recomputing rates, Docker, checksummed pre-registration manifests with disclosed drift, and a Table 4 separating recomputed/asserted/echoed values.

primary_link.title: PEN-STACK: A non-fabricating tool layer for language-model agents in genome writing

papers.summary: Background. Language-model agents are widely used in biology, but they report quantities without a verifiable source and pose unmanaged biosecurity risks. Genome writing sharpens both: a write plan must specify a location, writer enzyme, cargo, and delivery vehicle, all quantitative and interdependent, so without an integrated tool layer, the agent must supply them. We introduce PEN-STACK, an open tool layer that supplies them with guaranteed provenance. Results. PEN-STACK provides ten genome-wr
papers.summary_zh: PEN-STACK 針對語言模型代理在基因體寫作中無來源編造數值與生物安全風險兩大問題，提出開放的工具層。平台將十個設計階段實作為二十二個具範圍感知的工具，透過 SDK、MCP 伺服器與 REST 介面提供，並以型別強制的零編造不變量治理：每個數量都必須源自已驗證工具，結果及其出處紀錄被凍結，候選結果呼叫 .as_claim() 會引發錯誤，範圍外數值一律回傳為明確的已知未知。實證顯示，在無工具的原始提示下，三個模型家族（從 1.5B 本地模型到閉源託管模型）對 240 個必要欄位的編造率為 90.8% 至 98.8%；反編造 coaching 僅留下 0 至 4 的殘餘且無一被認證為零；驅動驗證工具的相同模型在四目標稽核中則零編造。設計階段的生物安全篩檢在八個設計上與專家標籤完全一致。表現穩健性軸僅在精確位點解析度獲得驗證（ρ=0.571），粗糙解析度降至約 0.16，系統以機器可讀旗標自動降級；十項預註冊主張有八項未通過並如實揭露。限制包括僅測三個模型家族、工具驅動稽核規模小、僅單一細胞類型且為純計算驗證。其核心論點：移除編造靠的是接地而非提示或模型規模，而接地需要基底工具層。
papers.title: PEN-STACK: A non-fabricating tool layer for language-model agents in genome writing
papers.title_zh: PEN-STACK：基因體寫作中語言模型代理的非編造工具層

links.title: SAPE: Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency in Large Language Model Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract: claims '+4.85% on GSM8K and +3.11% on CommonsenseQA' over AdaLoRA; verified against Table 2 Low Budget Tier (37.30 vs 32.45; 78.54 vs 75.43), but LoRA at the same ~0.6M tier scores higher (39.50 GSM8K, 79.12 CSQA), so 'state-of-the-art in low-parameter regimes' is only partially supported.

Section 3.1: 'Inspired by the sandwich-style weight sharing paradigm introduced by Reid et al (2021) for generative models' — the core topology is transferred from Subformer pre-training to adapter PEFT, limiting methodological novelty.

Table 1 (RoBERTa-large): SAPE at 0.55M params achieves 88.75 avg vs proPETL 88.50 at 5.40M; caption states 'Baseline results for DeBERTa-v3-base are sourced from the AdaLoRA paper... RoBERTa-large baseline results are reported from Xu et al.', so several baselines were not re-run under identical conditions.

Section 4.4.1, Table 3: Normal Sharing collapses on QNLI (49.46%) while Sandwich-Style averages 84.73 across four GLUE tasks under fixed optimization (Section 4.4.1: 'LR=1e-4 with a linear decay schedule'), directly supporting the boundary-isolation design claim.

Section 4.4.2, Table 4: G=2 (101K params) reaches 86.41 avg vs re-tuned G=10 PAdapter baseline 86.93 (304K), matching the 99.4%-retention claim; Table 5 shows SAPE beats a choked-bottleneck unshared baseline (d=5) 86.41 vs 84.52 at equal ~101K budget.
Section 4.4.3, Table 6: Independent dropout masking averages 86.41 vs Shared Mask 85.46 and No Dropout 84.93, supporting the masking-mechanics claim.
Section 4.3 GSM8K: 'PAdapter achieves 41.55%, whereas SAPE plateaus at 40.30%' — the paper transparently reports the arithmetic-reasoning trade-off, echoed in the Conclusion.

Section 6, Tables 7-10: full hyperparameter tables, seed 42, hardware (RTX 3090/T4), and decoding settings (Table 9, e.g., greedy decoding, max 256 tokens for GSM8K) aid reproducibility; however no code release is stated and Section 4.3's ConvAI2 subset ('3,495 training and 100 validation dialogues') lacks a selection protocol.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope core LLM methodology: a sandwich-style hard weight-sharing topology for adapter-based PEFT, evaluated on GLUE encoders (DeBERTa-v3-base, RoBERTa-large) and LLaMA-3.2-3B on ConvAI2/CSQA/GSM8K, with extensive ablations. Novelty is incremental: Section 3.1 explicitly adapts the topology from Subformer pre-training (Reid et al 2021) to PEFT, with boundary-layer isolation and independent dropout masking as the main new empirical insights. Ablations are well-controlled (fixed LR=1e-4, Table 3) and support design claims, but most headline results are single-seed (seed 42) with no significance testing, several baselines are quoted from prior papers rather than re-run (Table 1 caption), and the abstract's +4.85% GSM8K gain cherry-picks AdaLoRA while LoRA/PAdapter beat SAPE on GSM8K and CSQA at the same ~0.6M tier (Table 2). Hyperparameters, hardware, and decoding are thoroughly documented, but no code release is stated and the ConvAI2 subset selection is unspecified. A solid, honest, moderately significant PEFT contribution.

primary_link.title: SAPE: Sandwich Adapters for Parameter Efficiency in Large Language Model Fine-Tuning

papers.summary: While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has substantially reduced the hardware cost of adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) by decreasing the number of trainable parameters, recent studies have sought to further improve PEFT through parameter sharing. However, these approaches either employ uniform parameter sharing across layers, which can delay convergence, or rely on dynamic masking strategies, which add computational overhead. The potential of sharing patterns inspired by the inherent
papers.summary_zh: SAPE 針對參數高效微調（PEFT）跨層參數共享的缺口：均勻共享會延遲收斂，動態遮罩策略則增加運算開銷。作者借用 Subformer 的三明治拓撲，提出以確定性硬權重共享為基礎的加性式 PEFT 框架：輸入層 L0 與最終層 L(N-1) 配置獨立介面卡以避免邊界梯度干擾，中間層則切成 G 個平衡群組共享同一組介面卡參數，並在每次呼叫時使用獨立 dropout 遮罩，打破群組內的共適應。此設計完全免除動態排名分配與遮罩產生的輔助記憶體與延遲。實驗顯示，在 RoBERTa-large 的 GLUE 任務上，SAPE 僅以 0.55M 參數達到 88.75% 平均分數，超越需要十倍參數的 proPETL；在 LLaMA-3.2 (3B) 約 0.6M 參數預算下，於 GSM8K 與 CommonsenseQA 分別領先 AdaLoRA 4.85% 與 3.11%。拓撲消融證實邊界層隔離為必要結構，G=2 在 DeBERTa-v3-base 上以三分之一參數保留未共享基線 99.4% 的效能。主要權衡在於：硬共享強化了語意泛化，卻略微平滑 GSM8K 所需的逐層剛性算術轉換，使其在該任務遜於 LoRA 與 PAdapter。此結果確立了拓撲設計在低參數區間的關鍵角色。

links.title: Who's Keeping Score? Interactive Steering of LLM-Powered Scoring with Attune

evidence: Section 6, Table 3: Attune accuracy beats GEPA baseline across all conditions, e.g., Triage seed 0.60 vs 0.36, examples 0.63 vs 0.46, ASAP distribution 0.61 vs 0.46.

Section 5.1: score assignment formulated as an ILP minimizing violated pairwise judgments with big-M soft constraints (Eq. 1-2c) to handle intransitive LLM comparisons; sparse graph at 25% pair density.
Appendix E, Table 7: inter-model agreement averages kappa 0.59 for pairwise comparisons and QWK 0.57 for scores; ASAP exact-match kappa only 0.18, honestly reported.
Section 6: baseline is GEPA with N x 10 metric calls; in the Rules condition the authors manually map rubrics to Attune criteria as edit_rule actions, a potential experimenter-bias limitation.
Section 5: implemented with Next.js/FastAPI/LiteLLM routed to OpenAI gpt-4.1; live deployment and source code at github.com/ucbepic/attune; full prompts in Appendix D.

Section 7 and Appendix F: summative user study with 8 domain experts (healthcare, law, education, AI evaluation); post-study Likert quality mu=4.0 (sigma=0.8), control mu=4.0 (sigma=1.0); qualitative thematic analysis without statistical testing.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A UIST systems paper squarely on LLM methodology: LLM-as-judge scoring, prompt steerability, and interpretability of LLM scoring logic, which aligns well with LLM (2.5), evaluation/LLM-as-judge (1.8), interpretability (1.8), and prompting (1.5) preferences, though the emphasis is HCI rather than core ML methodology. The comparative scoring pipeline (sparse pairwise comparison graph + ILP resolution with big-M soft constraints for intransitivity + bottom-up criteria discovery) is a sensible, moderately novel combination over prior pairwise-judgment and criteria-drift work. Rigor is solid for HCI (formative n=12, user study n=8 with thematic analysis, 3-workload technical eval against a GEPA prompt-optimization baseline), but weakened by a single backbone model (GPT-4.1) in the main eval, no significance testing or repeats, and experimenter involvement in mapping rubrics to Attune constraints in the Rules condition (Section 6). Quantitative evidence is real and consistently favorable (Table 3: e.g., Triage seed 0.60 vs 0.36), and Appendix E honestly reports weak cross-model agreement on ASAP (exact-match kappa 0.18), but point estimates lack variance. Generalizability is decent across four domains yet samples come from a single essay prompt and single search query, and pairwise comparison cost limits scale. Reproducibility is good: public code/deployment (github.com/ucbepic/attune), full seed and optimized prompts, pseudocode, and public datasets (Triage, ASAP, WANDS), though the ILP solver is unnamed.

primary_link.title: Who's Keeping Score? Interactive Steering of LLM-Powered Scoring with Attune

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to score text records at scale (e.g., rating candidate resumes on a 1-5 scale). However, existing LLM-powered approaches do not account for the fact that effective scoring requires both holistic understanding of records and locally consistent judgments across similar ones. We present Attune, a mixed-initiative system for steerable LLM-powered scoring. Given a task description and scoring range, Attune performs pairwise comparisons across records
papers.summary_zh: Attune 針對以 LLM 為文字記錄評分時的三大挑戰——缺乏整體資料理解、可解釋性不足與難以操控——提出混合主動的可引導評分系統。其演算法先對記錄進行成對比較建立比較圖，由比較理由自下而上歸納評分準則，再以整數線性規劃（ILP）將相對判斷解析為一致的分數，並以提升度為基礎的貪婪集合覆蓋為每個分數群組描述規則。使用者可透過拖放範例、直接編輯準則與規則、設定目標分布，或由聊天助理將自然語言回饋轉譯為導引動作；所有互動皆編譯為確定性 ILP 約束以引導重新評分。形成性研究（n=12）歸納出資料接地、多層級可讀性、確定性回饋與進度追蹤四項設計考量。技術評估在 Triage、ASAP 與 WANDS 三個工作負載上，Attune 於各條件皆超越 GEPA 提示最佳化基線，範例條件領先 3 至 17 分。專家使用者研究（n=8，橫跨醫療、法律、教育與 AI 評估）顯示參與者快速信任自下而上的準則、流暢組合導引互動，並以可預測的編輯建立信心。限制在於準則與規則源自 LLM 的事後合理化而非因果解釋，且樣本與領域規模有限。此工作為高風險領域的 LLM 評分提供了可審計且可操控的人機協作介面。
papers.title: Who's Keeping Score? Interactive Steering of LLM-Powered Scoring with Attune
papers.title_zh: 誰在掌控評分？以 Attune 互動式引導 LLM 驅動的評分

links.title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA

evidence: Abstract: proposes FedPA-LoRA jointly addressing aggregation and initialization mismatch, claims up to 6.82 percentage-point GLUE improvement under heterogeneous client ranks and code availability ('The code is available at FedPA-LoRA-Code').
Section 5.2, Table 1: FedPA-LoRA achieves 0.9146 average GLUE accuracy (homogeneous, vs RoLoRA 0.8660) and 0.9226 under heterogeneous ranks (vs HetLoRA 0.8544), a 6.82 pp gap.

Section 4.4 and Appendix D: Theorem 1 proves O((T*tau)^-1/2) stationarity rate under Assumptions 1-4; Theorem 2 (Appendix D.2) adds a reference-truncation error term lambda*delta^2; Theorem 3 (Appendix E) extends to partial participation with K active clients.

Section 5.4.4, Table 4: component ablation shows product-space regularization with local head reaches 0.906 on MNLI vs 0.871 for B-only and 0.879 for A-only regularization, supporting the design choice.

Section 3.3, Figure 1: motivating experiment on MNLI (3 clients, r=4, beta=0.5) measures aggregation error E_agg and relative factor initialization error E_init, showing FedPA-LoRA has lowest aggregation error and zero initialization error.

Appendix G, Table 11: reduced QR + core SVD takes 0.0840 s per round on RoBERTa-Large (N=10, Rg=4) vs 4.7340 s for dense product aggregation and SVD; Table 12 reports 2.8% client-side overhead on RoBERTa-Large but 34.0% on Llama 3-8B, acknowledged as a limitation.

Section 5.3 and Tables 8-9: GSM8K 0.4672 (homogeneous) and 0.5018 (heterogeneous) accuracy, HumanEval 0.4121/0.4048 pass@1; heterogeneous HumanEval margin over Fed-PLoRA (0.4048 vs 0.4016) is within noise-scale territory.

Appendix C.1: full hyperparameter grids (learning rate and lambda search per task/method), three seeds (0, 13, 123), FederatedScope-LLM implementation, and rank configurations for heterogeneous groups (r_i in {2,4,16}) are documented.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A federated-LoRA training/optimization paper for LLM fine-tuning (RoBERTa-Large on GLUE; Llama 3-8B on GSM8K/HumanEval), matching the LLM and PEFT/fine-tuning preferences though not the highest-weighted areas (no Japanese, agents, reasoning, RAG, or safety methodology). The contribution is a credible combination of known ideas (product-space aggregation from FlexLoRA, factor alignment from FedRot-LoRA) with genuinely new elements: local factor preservation, product-guided regularization, and an efficient reduced-QR/core-SVD reconstruction avoiding dense O(d^3) aggregation, backed by convergence proofs for homogeneous, heterogeneous, and partial-participation settings (Theorems 1-3). Evaluation is broad (5 GLUE tasks, 2 generative tasks, heterogeneity/client/rank sweeps, ablation in Table 4, wall-clock measurements in Appendix G) with 3 seeds and per-baseline hyperparameter search, but confined to two models and small client counts (N=3-50); HumanEval gains over the best baseline are marginal (0.4048 vs 0.4016), and the convergence guarantee is for the regularized local objective rather than the global task loss directly. Code availability is claimed, and hyperparameters/seeds are documented in Appendix C, supporting good reproducibility.

primary_link.title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA

papers.summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models, but its factorized parameterization creates a tension between accurate aggregation of local updates and continuity of locally optimized factors. Factor-wise aggregation incurs aggregation mismatch but better preserves factor continuity, whereas product-space reconstruction reduces this mismatch at the cost of greater factor-level initialization mismatch from newly reconstructed factors. We propose FedPA-
papers.summary_zh: 聯邦式微調中，LoRA 因將權重更新拆解為兩個低秩矩陣，導致伺服器聚合與本地最佳化之間產生兩類錯誤：逐因子平均會引入聚合不一致，而以乘積空間重建全域因子又會破壞本地最佳化的連續性。本文提出 FedPA-LoRA，同時保留用戶端本地因子，並在乘積空間中聚合異質秩數更新，再以縮減 QR 分解加上核心矩陣 SVD 高效重建最佳秩受限的全域轉接器，避免形成稠密矩陣，並以全域乘積參考正則項抑制客戶端漂移。理論上，本文證明該方法在齊質與異質秩數設定下皆能以標準非凸聯邦 SGD 速率收斂。實驗涵蓋 GLUE 理解與 GSM8K、HumanEval 生成任務，在異質客戶端秩數下平均 GLUE 準確率較最佳基線提升達 6.82 個百分點，且對資料異質、客戶端數量與秩數變化皆穩健。限制方面，乘積空間正則化會增加客戶端運算開銷（在 Llama 3-8B 上約 34%），且正則強度 λ 需依資料異質程度調整。此研究對資源受限且資料分散的聯邦式大模型微調具實務價值，提供兼顧通訊預算與收斂保證的可部署方案。

links.title: ACTS-SQL: Agentic and Critic-Oriented Tree-Structured SQL Correctness with Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: claims 'a 9.42% improvement over the previous state-of-the-art method' and production gain 'from 36.77% to 53.61% ... (GPT-5)'; Table 1 shows 58.70% vs Xiyan 49.28% on BIRD-Critic Open, i.e., 9.42 percentage points, not a relative percent.
Table 1 (Sec 5.1.2): ACTS-SQL 58.70% (Open) / 64.29% (PG) vs raw GPT-5 39.13%/28.57%, MapleRepair 44.20%/37.76%, Xiyan 49.28%/45.92%, across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLServer, Oracle.
Table 2 (Sec 5.2): ablations - linear plan variant drops to 45.81%/36.93%, w/o execution tool 39.84%/32.66%, w/o ambiguity detection 43.89%/27.37%, supporting tree planning and execution feedback.

Table 3 (Sec 5.3.2): with GPT-5, ACTS-SQL 53.61% at 218.91s vs MapleRepair 46.83% at 15.51s and DAC 37.74% at 72.51s; DeepSeek-R1 improves only 22.68%->23.85% and Xiyan 13.40%->13.75%, contradicting the Sec 1 claim of 'Similar improvement trends ... across other LLM backbones'.

Sec 5.5 Cost Analysis: 'invokes the LLM API 4.97 times per instance on average, with a mean visible token consumption of 8,984.5 tokens (measured with GPT-o3)', ~3 min end-to-end with GPT-5 and ~4-5 min with reasoning models.

PVLDB Artifact Availability section contains only the placeholder 'URL_TO_YOUR_ARTIFACTS', and Sec 5.3.1 states the TLS dataset is industrial/proprietary with no public release; prompts are described (Sec 4.2) but not fully included.

Sec 2.1/2.3 acknowledges closely related prior tree/hierarchical approaches (Alpha-SQL 'tree-structured framework', MGDebugger 'hierarchical debugging tree'), positioning the novelty as branching over correction strategies rather than the tree mechanism itself.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM agent system: training-free tree-structured agentic SQL correction with tool calling, branching/backtracking reasoning, and structured JSON plan output, directly matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Reasoning, LLMs). Evaluation is comparatively solid: BIRD-Critic results across four dialects (Table 1: 58.70%/64.29% vs Xiyan 49.28%/45.92%), component ablations (Table 2), a real-world TLS study with multiple backbones and latency (Table 3), and cost analysis (Sec 5.5), plus production deployment. However, novelty is incremental: tree-based reasoning, MCTS-style SQL search (Alpha-SQL), and hierarchical debugging trees (MGDebugger) are cited prior art; the contribution is a sensible combination applied to SQL correction. Rigor is dented by no significance testing, an overstated SOTA framing (best baseline is a fine-tuned generation model, and '9.42%' is actually percentage points), and an unsupported efficiency claim (Table 3 shows 218.91s vs 15.51s MapleRepair / 72.51s DAC, yet Sec 5.3.2 claims latency 'moderate and comparable'). Evidence strength is reduced by a proprietary, unreleased TLS dataset and by the Sec 1 claim of 'similar improvement trends across other LLM backbones' being contradicted for DeepSeek-R1 (+1.17 pts) and Xiyan (+0.35 pts). Reproducibility is weak: the artifact section contains a placeholder URL ('URL_TO_YOUR_ARTIFACTS'), and prompts are described but not fully specified. Overall a well-matched, deployable systems paper with meaningful but not exceptional methodological novelty and some over-claiming.

primary_link.title: ACTS-SQL: Agentic and Critic-Oriented Tree-Structured SQL Correctness with Large Language Models

papers.summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted in Text-to-SQL systems, yet SQL errors remain a major obstacle in real-world Text-to-SQL inference pipelines. Existing SQL correction approaches either rely on large-scale, high-quality training data with substantial overhead, or adopt single-path agentic workflows that are brittle to early mistakes and prone to error propagation.
  To develop a practical SQL correctness system for industrial scenarios, we present a training-free framew
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型雖大幅推動 Text-to-SQL 發展，單次生成的 SQL 仍常出現語法與語義錯誤；既有修正方法多採單一路徑的線性迭代流程，易受早期隱含假設束縛並持續累積誤差。本文提出 ACTS-SQL，一個免訓練的 SQL 正確性框架，將修正過程建模為計畫引導的樹狀除錯：LLM 先產生樹狀修訂計畫，各節點對應特定工具呼叫，並支援分支與回溯。系統由中央代理人協調五類工具，涵蓋歧義偵測、欄位檢視、SQL 執行、語法錯誤拆解修復與 SQL 生成，以執行回饋與資料庫實例證據支撐路徑剪枝與精確定位。在 BIRD-Critic 基準上，該方法超越既有最佳系統 9.42%，消融實驗證實樹狀規劃與執行工具皆為關鍵；框架亦部署於火山引擎 Torch Log Service 的線上 Text-to-TLS API，以 GPT-5 為骨幹將執行準確率由 36.77% 提升至 53.61%。主要限制為延遲成本：非推理模型平均約 3 分鐘，推理模型達 4 至 5 分鐘，且每個實例平均需近 5 次 API 呼叫。整體而言，本文證明結構化、可回溯的除錯流程是提升 SQL 可靠性並可實際部署的可行方向。

links.title: LLM-Based Hierarchical Coordinated Control with Continuation-Aware Policy Learning

evidence: Abstract and Introduction: proposes LLM-based hierarchical coordination plus Continuation-Aware GRPO, validated on multi-ramp traffic control and VPP energy management against direct-control, RL, hierarchical, and prompting-only LLM baselines

Table 1 (Experiments): Ours achieves 16625.4±84.5 SUMO throughput vs Feedback Control 15592.5±49.1 (+6.62%) and Hierarchical RL 16131.8±110.2; prompting-only Qwen3-8B at 15270.7 underperforms feedback control
Table 4 (Ablation): H=4Δ vs H=Δ GRPO gives +1.88% traffic throughput and +2.69% VPP cost reduction, with largest gains in High-U subset (2.84%, 3.81%)

Appendix D.3 (Table 23 and 'Is the gain just extra compute?'): compute-matched control (H=Δ with 4× snapshots) recovers only +0.52%/+0.84% vs +1.88%/+2.69%, attributing most gain to return construction rather than budget; 8Δ row noted as not pool-matched

Appendix D.5 (Table 26): paired scenario-level bootstrap intervals exclude zero for main comparisons (e.g., vs Hierarchical RL [+408,+574] vehicles, [+688,+1002] CNY); explicitly states intervals do not cover five-seed training randomness
Appendix C.1: states the corridor transfer claim is narrower than zero-shot because capacity/inflow scales and hysteresis centres are calibrated on training/validation SUMO data
Appendix E.3 (Table 30): comfort-limited VPP family gain 0.3% with CI [-148,+361] containing zero; authors disclaim improvement there
Appendix B.2 (Table 10): reproducibility details — Qwen3-8B base with LoRA rank 32/α=64, G=8, H=4Δ, clip 0.2, KL 0.05, 1200 steps, 5 seeds; prompts in full in Figures 2–6
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper (fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with a modified GRPO for closed-loop coordination) applied to two engineering domains; not a pure domain application since the language contribution (continuation-aware return construction for RL fine-tuning of LLM policies, structured prompting/schema enforcement) is central. Preference relevance is solid for LLM, RL-fine-tuning/RLHF-adjacent, agent, and prompting preferences, though traffic/energy domains add little. Novelty is moderate: continuation-aware rollouts are an incremental extension of GRPO beyond turn-level reward and long-horizon LLM-agent RL it cites. Rigor and evidence are strong: formal formulation, many baselines (feedback/MPC, end-to-end and hierarchical RL, prompting-only Qwen3-8B/Gemini/Claude), horizon sweep with a compute-matched control, context ablations, paired bootstrap CIs, auxiliary metrics, and honest null results (comfort-limited family CI contains zero) plus an explicit disclaimer that cross-simulator transfer is not zero-shot. Generalizability is limited by discrete low-dimensional mode-based high-level decisions, simulator-only evaluation, and the authors' own scope caveats; reproducibility is good via detailed hyperparameters, full prompts, and a claimed code release, tempered by proprietary corridor detector records and commercial API baselines.

papers.summary: Coordinating multiple interacting units in complex engineering systems is challenging when system interactions are difficult to model, operational information is heterogeneous, and low-level actions must satisfy strict constraints. We propose an LLM-based hierarchical framework in which the LLM coordinates interacting units based on heterogeneous operational context, while task-specific controllers or optimizers generate executable and constraint-aware actions. We further introduce Continuation-
papers.summary_zh: 複雜工程系統中，各單元決策相互耦合，協調策略難以預先以固定規則完整描述。本文提出以 LLM 擔任高層協調者的階層式控制框架：LLM 解讀異質營運脈絡（量測、趨勢、預測、不確定性、優先順序、外部事件等）並為每個受控單元輸出模式決策，任務專屬的控制器或最佳化器再將其轉為可執行動作，兼顧物理與營運約束。針對協調決策的延遲效應，作者提出 Continuation-Aware GRPO：每個取樣決策僅執行一個控制區間，其餘時間由凍結的舊政策在更長評估視野 H=4Δ 內繼續推演，使回報同時反映即時結果與後續系統演化。研究於長春多匝道交通控制與虛擬電廠能源管理驗證：在簡化模擬器訓練、於 SUMO 與 OpenDSS 評估，整體車流量較回饋控制提升 6.62%，營運成本較 MPC-MILP 降低 4.37%，跨模擬器效能落差最小（3.82% 與 5.62%），且在未見模式與高不確定性情境退化最少。限制包括：在舒適度受限等物理上無調度空間的情境無顯著改善，且方法假設高層決策為低維、語義標註的離散模式。消融顯示增益主要來自延續式回報結構而非額外算力，佐證延遲效應建模的價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-agent paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use: multi-turn MCP tool interaction, agentic RL post-training; Reasoning: planning and 3D reasoning analysis; Alignment/RL: GRPO with verifiable and rubric-based rewards; Evaluation: LLM-as-judge benchmark). It is not a pure domain/CV paper since the contribution is an agent benchmark + RL training stack, though the 3D-world/gaming domain and a single cartoon-style asset library temper relevance. Novelty is moderate: SceneReVis already applies multi-turn RL to world-building agents (Sec. 7.2), so the increment is the unified sandbox, render-in-the-loop multimodal reward, and dual verifier with anti-hacking licensed-edit checks. Rigor is solid: verifier validated against blind human study (Sec. 5.2/A.4: κ=0.53-0.54, 83.4% case agreement, Spearman ρ=0.88 across systems), ablations (w/o cold-start, Fig. 6), failure-mode analysis, but test cells are very small (Table 3: 254 test queries; Table 4 sub-type columns imply ~10-23 samples, e.g., 8.3%/100% values) with no variance estimates, and the Gemini 3.5-flash judge is also included as a baseline model without discussing circularity. Evidence is credible within the benchmark (Sec. 6.1: 59.3% vs GPT-5.5 57.3%) but SOTA claims are benchmark-internal and partially driven by the Verified track where rewards are rule-based. Generalizability is limited by ≤258-asset worlds, one art style, and proprietary judge/teacher (Sec. 8 admits these). Reproducibility is good: code, data, and models released with detailed hyperparameters (Sec. 5.4, A.2).

primary_link.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?

papers.summary: Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, p
papers.summary_zh: 從使用者查詢自動建構可互動的 3D 開放世界，對遊戲、模擬與具身 AI 極具價值，但現有方法多針對理想化的簡單查詢，且缺乏統一開源的評測與訓練環境。本文提出 VibeWorlding，包含基準 VWE-Bench 與訓練環境 VibeWorlding-Gym。VWE-Bench 由藝術標註者協同合成，含 2,616 個高品質 3D 資產、323 個種子世界與 6,828 個反向合成的多模態查詢，涵蓋從零建構四類與精細、模糊編輯等六類子型態；VibeWorlding-Gym 則以統一的 MCP 工具沙盒（檢索、新增、刪除、旋轉、平移）與 Blender 渲染，搭配同時檢查物理可行性（碰撞、高度）與意圖滿足（生態合理性、3D 理解、3D 推理、檢索合理性）的雙重約束驗證器，同時支援評測與多模態 RL 獎勵服務。實驗顯示 GPT-5.5 與 Qwen3.8-Max 等前沿模型整體 Pass@1 皆低於 60%，瓶頸在於無碰撞的精確 3D 編輯；經 SFT 加 GRPO 的多模態 RL 後訓練，VibeWorlder-30B-A3B 以 59.3% 取得整體最佳，VibeWorlder-8B 亦追平 Gemini 3.1-pro。限制包括資產庫僅卡通風格、最大世界僅 258 個資產，以及渲染耗時與驗證器可信度的邊界。
papers.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
papers.title_zh: VibeWorlding：多模態代理人能否端對端建構 3D 開放世界？

links.title: Constraint-Aware Synthetic Tabular Data Generation via Inter-Column Constraint Discovery with LLM Agents

evidence: Section 3.1: discovery agent emits structured hypotheses with a family-specific machine-executable field (Python check(df), JSON linear/LD DSLs); validators compute VR(h) and retain at tau_vio=0.005, returning up to n_cex=20 counterexamples for up to R_rev=3 revisions.

Section 4.1 / Table 1: full tool-grounded validation-and-revision workflow achieves higher mean held-out violation-detection accuracy, precision, and recall in all 18 family-backbone-metric comparisons (e.g., LD precision/recall .442 -> .974 with GPT-5.6, .442 -> .963 with Claude-5) versus one-shot direct prompting.

Section 4.2 / Table 2: across 7 datasets and 4 generators, postprocessing drives CVR, sCVC, and LFD to zero and equational R2 to 1 for every retained applicable constraint; mean TSTR improves on 4/7 datasets (steel 0.486 -> 0.976) and declines by at most 0.042, with Column Shapes changes of -0.009 to +0.019 (Figure 3).

Appendix E.3 / Table 15: on nba, E->L repair order yields zero linear CVR and LFD in all 36 matched settings, while reversed L->E leaves violations in 24/36 settings (CVR 4.574%, LFD 0.863); Appendix E.2 / Table 14 shows KS-guided scheduling beats random feasible schedules on Column Shapes (+0.025 equal-weight mean) at equal zero CVR.

Limitations: method restricted to record-level inter-column constraints (no uniqueness, cell-level, or cross-table rules); zero measured violations applies only to retained applicable validators; experiments rely on rich dataset/column metadata, and robustness to poor metadata is left as future work.

Footnote 1 (Section 1): code and data released at https://github.com/via-cs/dive-tabular; Appendices A.2 and D provide prompt templates and full generator hyperparameters (e.g., CTGAN 300 epochs, TabDDPM 30k updates), and Appendix D.3 documents compute.

Section 3.2/4.2 (weakness): P-DGM and EVS are discussed as prior enforcement methods, but the empirical end-to-end comparison uses only raw unconstrained generators as the reference, and the discovery comparison uses only a one-shot direct-prompting baseline rather than prior constraint-mining systems.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological (not domain-application) paper squarely relevant to agentic LLM use: LLM agents propose typed executable constraint hypotheses (Python checkers, JSON DSLs), deterministic tools validate on the full table, and counterexamples drive revision, followed by generator-agnostic post-hoc repair. Evaluation is broad (3 discovery benchmarks, 2 LLM backbones, 7 datasets, 4 generator paradigms, 252 paired end-to-end runs, three ablations) and honestly reports mixed utility effects, but the headline zero-violation result is partly circular (the metrics are the enforced constraints), the discovery baseline is only one-shot direct prompting, and no prior constraint-enforcement system (P-DGM, EVS) is empirically compared despite being discussed. Novelty is integrative: a unified typed interface across three constraint families plus coordinated repair ordering (equations before projection with protected columns, KS-guided scheduling) rather than a fundamentally new technique. Good reproducibility from released code/data, detailed hyperparameters, and included prompts; scope limited to record-level inter-column constraints and metadata-rich tables per the Limitations section.

primary_link.title: Constraint-Aware Synthetic Tabular Data Generation via Inter-Column Constraint Discovery with LLM Agents

papers.summary: Generating structurally valid synthetic tabular data remains difficult: outputs with high statistical fidelity and downstream utility can still violate semantically meaningful domain constraints. We study the discovery and enforcement of three complementary inter-column constraint families---equations, linear inequalities, and logical dependencies. Our unified tool-grounded workflow represents all three as machine-executable hypotheses and applies a common interface for full-table validation, de
papers.summary_zh: 合成表格資料即使統計保真度與下游效用良好，仍可能違反欄位間的領域約束，例如小計不等於單價乘以數量。本文提出一個端對端框架：LLM 代理人依資料集描述、欄位剖析與取樣記錄，提出等式、線性不等式與邏輯依賴三類互補約束的機器可執行假設；各家族的確定性工具在完整參考表上驗證，回傳違規率與反例以驅動迭代修訂；隨後由與生成器無關的後處理器，依序強制邏輯依賴、以 KS 互補引導目標與順序的等式重建、以及保護已修復欄位的聯合凸投影。在 nba、url 與 anxiety 三個策展基準上，完整工作流程於全部 18 組家族—骨幹—指標比較中，保留集違規偵測的準確率、精確率與召回率皆勝過一次性直接提示，邏輯依賴精確率自 0.442 升至 0.974。端對端評估涵蓋七個公開資料集與四種生成器，後處理在所有保留且適用的驗證器下達成零量測違規，TSTR 效用四升三降（最多降 0.042），Column Shapes 僅變動 −0.009 至 +0.019。限制為僅處理記錄內欄位間約束，不含跨列唯一性與儲存格格式規則，且成效依賴豐富中介資料的品質。

links.title: MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation

evidence: Abstract: on DeepSeek-MoE-16B MAPLE 'uses only 75% of the experts yet surpasses the original 100% expert-uniform baseline' (ARC-E 65.09→71.40, ARC-C 48.49→51.50, BoolQ 80.03→82.38)

Section 4.1: budgets stated per model ('DeepSeek-MoE-16B 108/162+54; DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight-16B-A3B 104/156+52; OLMoE-1B-7B 96/128+0'); text claims seven benchmarks but Table 1 reports only five MCQA tasks

Table 2 caption: GSM8K/BBH results 'directly calibrated on each benchmark's chain-of-thought accuracy' while evaluated on the complete test sets — per-task headline numbers risk test-set-tuned calibration

Table 6: weaker calibration signals remain strong (C4-NLL avg 69.59, FineWeb-Edu-NLL 68.88, cross-task transfer 69.14) vs per-task MAPLE 74.34 and best baseline 70.82 (EPP), supporting robustness of the core claim
Table 5: refinement improves closed-form allocation by +0.82 (PIQA) to +7.01 (ARC-E) with seed std ±0.21–±1.16; seed analysis performed only on DeepSeek-MoE-16B

Table 3(b)-(c): SGLang single-GPU latency 2.860s→1.940s (−32.2%) and throughput +47.4%, but 2-GPU EP only −3.9%/+4.1% and vLLM 1-GPU −4.58%/+4.80%, showing deployment gains depend on parallelism setting
Table 7: MAPLE at 100% budget (ARC-C/RTE 51.84/88.09) beats uniform baseline (48.49/84.84), and its margin over Wanda/SparseGPT widens at 50% budget
Section 5 (Conclusions and Limitations): hardware/platform breadth listed as future work; no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/MoE efficiency paper: heterogeneous per-layer expert reallocation in pretrained MoE Transformers (DeepSeek-MoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Moonlight, OLMoE) without retraining, squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, MoE/Transformer architecture, efficiency, and inference serving. Novelty is moderate: sensitivity-guided non-uniform allocation is a classic compression idea, and LExI already does layer-adaptive active-expert counts (Section 2 admits this); the closed-form Lagrangian allocation plus genetic refinement is a sensible but incremental combination. Rigor is solid: four models, seven baselines (SparseGPT, Wanda, RIA, EPP, MoNE, LExI), metric/refinement/calibration/budget ablations, seed-variance checks, and honest reporting (Moonlight is 0.62 below baseline; 2-GPU EP gains shrink to ~4%). Key concerns: Table 2 states results are 'directly calibrated on each benchmark's chain-of-thought accuracy' while evaluating on the full test set, so headline per-task numbers may be tuned to the evaluation target; benchmark-count inconsistencies (Section 4.1 says seven, Table 1 reports five); and large swings on small benchmarks (RTE +15.9 on V2-Lite) invite noise doubts, partly mitigated by Table 6 showing NLL-based and cross-task calibration still beat the best baseline (69.59/69.14 vs 70.82 best baseline vs 74.34 per-task). Evidence strength is above average given internally consistent numbers (verified: 74.34-71.71=2.63, 68.48-62.69=5.79) and measured SGLang/vLLM latency/throughput. Generalizability is decent across models, budgets (50/75/100%), and calibration signals but limited to one hardware family and untested at larger scale. Reproducibility is middling: hyperparameters, pseudocode (Algorithm 1), hardware, and SGLang 0.4.6 are specified, but no code release is claimed and calibration data details are vague.

primary_link.title: MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation

papers.summary: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers universally fix the same number of routed experts across all layers, a convention that ignores the well-documented heterogeneity in layer-wise redundancy. We demonstrate that this uniformity is systematically suboptimal and propose MAPLE, a plug-and-play framework that reallocates the routed-expert budget heterogeneously across layers of any pretrained MoE LLM, without modifying weights or requiring retraining. Our core contribution is a c
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏啟動的 MoE Transformer 慣於在所有層使用相同數量的路由專家，但層間冗餘差異顯著，均勻分配因此系統性次佳。本文提出 MAPLE，一個隨插即用框架，可在不修改權重、不需重訓的前提下，為預訓練 MoE 模型異質地重新分配各層啟用的專家預算。方法分三步：先逐層掃描，固定其他層並變動該層專家數，記錄驗證準確率並計算敏感度（預設採準確率範圍）；再以敏感度為權重，求解帶全域預算約束的閉式分配，將盈餘或缺口依 1/s 比例優先分給低敏感層；最後以敏感度受限的高斯變異遺傳搜尋微調離散解。在 DeepSeek-MoE-16B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight-16B-A3B 與 OLMoE-1B-7B 四個模型、75% 專家預算下，MAPLE 的平均準確率全面領先剪枝與再分配基線；在 DeepSeek-MoE-16B 上僅用 75% 專家即於 ARC-E、ARC-C、BoolQ 超越全量均勻基線。系統實作於 SGLang 後，單 GPU 端對端延遲降低 32.2%、吞吐量提升 47.4%。限制包括一次性校準需數小時 GPU 時間，管線與專家並行下增益較小，且 k=1 專用執行路徑對延遲收益貢獻顯著。
papers.title: MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation
papers.title_zh: MAPLE：MoE 自適應隨插即用逐層專家分配

links.title: Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: claims 300 attack scenarios, 900 attack prompts, OpenClaw average ASR 84.06% without defenses and 55.11% under the strongest evaluated defense (LlamaFirewall).

Sec. 3.2: 'Across the six resource categories, the process produces 36 scenarios and 900 candidate prompts' — inconsistent with the 300-scenario count in Abstract and Contribution 2, and with 'each model call generates one complete scenario and three prompt variants' (36x3=108).
Sec. 4.1: 'We evaluate the benchmark on OpenClaw using.' — incomplete sentence omitting the model name; model version details deferred to an Appendix not included in the document.
Sec. 4.2 / Table 2: Prompt_defense per-category ASRs (59.31, 68.94, 53.74, 63.19, 42.22, 55.48) average to 57.15 (reported 57.13); LlamaFirewall per-category values average to 55.41 (reported 55.11).
Sec. 4.3 / Table 3: backend ablation reports DeepSeek-V4-Pro 84.06%, GPT-5.5 89.58%, Gemini-3.5-Flash 69.98% average ASR; per-category values arithmetically consistent with averages.

Sec. 4.4: failure analysis of valid failed cases into four types (e.g., Gemini-3.5-Flash: 83.3% 'Resource Not Invoked', 4.8% safety blocked), noting low ASR may reflect weak execution rather than robustness.
Sec. 4.5 / Table 4: paired ablation shows direct acquisition 7.39% vs resource hijacking 84.06% average ASR (gap 76.67pp), controlled for resource, tools, environment, and model.

Reproducibility: Sec. 1 Contribution 3 claims 'a reproducible basis for future work', but no code, data, or environment release statement appears anywhere in the paper; evaluation relies on an unvalidated LLM-based judge (Sec. 3.3).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent security benchmark (ResourceHijackBench, 900 prompts, six resource categories, three attack settings) squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation. The threat framing — agent-mediated use of high-value resources without credential disclosure, grounded in a resource taxonomy — is a reasonably fresh angle distinct from prior prompt-injection/privilege benchmarks (Sec. 2), though the construction method (LLM-generated scenarios, simulated environments, LLM judge) closely follows existing agent-safety benchmark methodology. Rigor concerns: the LLM-based judge is never validated against human labels, no significance testing or variance is reported, Sec. 3.2 states '36 scenarios and 900 candidate prompts' contradicting '300 attack scenarios' in the Abstract/Contribution 2, Sec. 4.1 contains an incomplete sentence ('We evaluate the benchmark on OpenClaw using.'), and the LlamaFirewall per-category ASRs in Table 2 average to 55.41 rather than the reported 55.11. Evidence is supported by mostly internally consistent tables (84.06/89.58/69.98 and the 7.39-vs-84.06 paired ablation check out arithmetically) and a useful failure-mode analysis (Sec. 4.4), but rests on a single agent framework (OpenClaw) in fully simulated environments with no real-world deployment. No code/data release statement is present; key details are deferred to an absent Appendix. Overall a relevant, moderately rigorous benchmark paper with clear internal-consistency defects.

primary_link.title: Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources such as computing infrastructure, credentials, usage budgets, identities, private knowledge, communication channels, and organizational workflows. Existing agent security research mainly studies attacks on instructions, data, and tool behaviors, while high-value resources accessible to agents have received much less attention as direct attack targets. We are the first to identify and systematically study agent resourc
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理人正被授予運算資源、憑證、配額、身分與組織工作流等高價值資源，但既有安全研究多聚焦於指令注入、資料外洩與工具濫用，鮮少把資源本身視為攻擊標的。本文首次系統性研究代理人資源劫持：攻擊者不需取得資源或其憑證，只要誘導代理人為其目標呼叫、消耗、轉移或控制該資源即告成功。作者將高價值資源分為物質、條件、能量、社會象徵、資訊知識與互動六類，建立 ResourceHijackBench 與自動案例生成管線，產出 300 個攻擊情境與 900 個提示，涵蓋隱含請求、未經確認的直接請求與持續上下文攻擊三種設定；每個案例在隔離的本地模擬環境執行，記錄實際工具呼叫，以行為層級評估而非僅看文字回覆。實驗顯示 OpenClaw 在無額外防禦下平均攻擊成功率達 84.06%，跨 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GPT-5.5 與 Gemini-3.5-Flash 介於 69.98% 至 89.58%；最強防禦仍留有 55.11%，配對消融更顯示直接取得僅 7.39% 成功，與劫持相差 76.67 個百分點。這揭示了任務來源、資源擁有者、允許用途與實際受益者不一致的對齊問題，是當前代理防禦的重要盲點。
