links.title: MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems

evidence: §5.2 Table 1: MetaReason-RL reaches 56.1% avg on ExamGeo (+43.0 over base Qwen3-VL-8B's 13.1%) and 80.1% on GeoLaux-mini, above GPT-5.2 (48.7%/76.9%) but below Gemini-3.1-Pro's 97.1% on GeoQA vs MetaReason's 87.5%.

§5.4 Table 2: ablation shows the two-stage-trained text-only variant scores 48.1% on ExamGeo vs 56.1% full model, while removing TutorGeo training drops it to 24.1%, attributing most of the gain to training data rather than the visual framework.

Appendix C Table 4: MetaConverter strict diagram-level consistency is only 52.5% on ExamGeo (71.2% GeoLaux-mini, 82.0% GeoQA), with inconsistent cases reverted to text-only reasoning per §3.1 Phase 2.

Appendix B: the tool space is restricted to draw_segment, draw_intersection_point, and draw_perpendicular_to_linear, described as 'a trade-off between construction coverage and training stability rather than an inherent limitation'.
§4.2: ExamGeo comprises 1,000 held-out questions 'selected from our data collection' and is scored by a GPT-5.2 LLM-as-a-judge with no reported human-agreement validation of the judge.

Appendix D Table 5: MetaJudge acceptance precision ranges 90.9%-98.0% and inconsistent rejection 93.9%-98.5% across the three benchmarks, per three PhD-level annotators without reported inter-annotator agreement.

Appendix G: complete rendering engine and toolbox Python code are provided; §5.1 specifies base model Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, learning rates, epochs, LLaMA-Factory and verl, and a project link (github.com/PenghaoYin/MetaReason), but explicit dataset release is not stated and data construction relies on Gemini-3-Flash and GPT-5.2 APIs.
Appendix E: authors candidly flag that the GeoQA 'Other' category (1.4% of test set) shows a -11.6 point drop for their model and should be interpreted cautiously.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM reasoning-methodology paper (not a pure domain application) with strong overlap to high-weight preferences: mathematical multi-step reasoning, tool calling (three geometry sketch tools invoked via <tool_call>), multimodal interleaved reasoning, and SFT+GRPO training on Qwen3-VL-8B. Core novelty is moderate but real: replacing pixel-space generation or full code redrawing with editing a JSON points/shapes meta-representation under deterministic rendering (§3.2), a sensible increment over VisualSketchPad/CodePlot-CoT and Zebra-CoT/MathCanvas, though symbolic geometry scene representations are classical (cf. Inter-GPS). Rigor is solid: comprehensive closed/open baselines (Table 1), meaningful ablations separating framework from training data (Table 2), and human evaluation of MetaConverter/MetaJudge (Appendices C-D); weaknesses include no significance testing, an unvalidated GPT-5.2 LLM-as-judge, and a self-constructed benchmark (ExamGeo drawn from the authors' own collection, §4.2). Evidence is internally consistent but headline gains are driven mostly by TutorGeo training (56.1%→24.1% when removed, Table 2) rather than the visual framework itself (+8.0 on ExamGeo vs text-only ablation); MetaConverter's 52.5% consistency on ExamGeo (Table 4) further limits the visual branch's coverage there. Generalizability is constrained: the meta-schema (points/segments/lines/circles) and 3-tool set fit plane geometry only, acknowledged as a coverage/stability trade-off in Appendix B. Reproducibility is above average: public project link, full renderer/toolbox code and prompts (Appendices G-H), explicit hyperparameters and frameworks (§5.1), though dataset release is not explicitly promised and data generation depends on proprietary APIs (Gemini-3-Flash, GPT-5.2 judge).

primary_link.title: MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems

papers.summary: Although visual reasoning is crucial for solving complex geometry tasks, existing vision-language models rely heavily on text-only reasoning. Some recent methods introduce intermediate visual states to facilitate reasoning, but they are often hindered by inaccurate geometric representations and low rendering fidelity, ultimately leading to unreliable outputs. To address these limitations, we propose MetaReason, a framework for multimodal reasoning in plane geometry that leverages structured meta
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型解幾何題時多依賴純文字推理，難以顯式表達中間視覺結構；既有插入輔助線的方法，無論以程式碼重繪或統一模型直接生圖，皆面臨幾何失真與渲染精度不足。本文提出 MetaReason，以結構化中介資訊（點與形狀的 JSON 描述）取代像素或複雜程式空間，透過三個輕量工具—畫線段、求交點、畫垂線—確定性地編輯並重繪圖形，實現精確的輔助線建構。框架由 MetaConverter（將影像解析為中介資訊）、MetaJudge（重渲染驗證一致性，不合格則退回純文字推理）與 MetaReasoner（交錯式工具呼叫推理）組成。為支撐訓練，作者建立含 17k 影像轉中介、60k 純文字與 60k 交錯多模態軌跡的 TutorGeo，並以 SFT 加 GRPO 兩階段訓練 Qwen3-VL-8B；另提出依人類正確率分四級的 ExamGeo 基準。結果顯示 MetaReason-RL 於 ExamGeo 達 56.1%，較基礎模型提升 43 個百分點並超越 GPT-5.2，於 GeoLaux-mini 取得 80.1% 的最佳成績，GeoQA 上達 87.5%。限制包括 MetaConverter 在複雜圖形上的一致率僅 52.5% 至 82%，工具集僅三種操作，且中介資訊品質依賴專有模型。
papers.title: MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems
papers.title_zh: MetaReason：透過編輯中介資訊實現精確交錯式多模態推理以解決幾何問題

links.title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: reports WMAPE reductions of 3.29, 1.25, and 0.47 percentage points on holiday-sensitive, mega-sale-sensitive, and M5 event windows, and +1.68 pp from indiscriminate intervention on stable periods
Section 5.2: proprietary dataset of 15,696 daily sales series with a 15-window test set (three mega-sale, ten holiday, two stable); M5 uses 14 seven-day event-centered windows
Section 4.2: Qwen3-32B produces six structured semantic fields (relevance, dominant event, direction, shape, amplitude, peak); Appendix B.3 states Claude Opus 4.6 served as distillation teacher
Section 5.5/Table 3: agent-routed ReasonCast exactly recovers the Chronos2-small backbone (7.91%/185.15) on stable sales while always-on semantics degrade to 9.59%/224.43

Section 5.6/Table 4: removing multiplicative correction costs +5.19 pp WMAPE on holiday-sensitive categories; base-fusion-only degrades stable-sales forced-Basic reference by -0.85 pp (simplified fusion better on stable demand)
Section 5.7/Table 5: forecast-utility RL lowers Event WMAPE 20.52%->18.96% and Negative Transfer Rate 23.59%->15.08% across cumulative stages
Section 6 (Discussion): explicit limitation that the study does not provide complete accounting of tool-call frequency, end-to-end latency, or realized inference cost
Section 5.2/Appendix A: primary results rely on a proprietary Alibaba commerce dataset; no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically substantive agentic-LLM paper: a Qwen3-32B reasoner routes instances among Skip/Basic/Tool actions over a frozen Chronos-2 forecaster, with GRPO-based semantic-field and forecast-utility RL, structured output schemas, tool use, and an exact no-text identity. This squarely matches LLM, Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, and Alignment/RLHF preferences, so it is not a capped pure-domain application despite the demand-forecasting task. Novelty is solid: selective semantic intervention with mandatory-event triggers and forecast-marginal-utility rewards goes beyond prior text-fusion work (Time-LLM, From News to Forecast, VoT), though components are assembled from known techniques (cross-attention fusion, contrastive alignment, GRPO, gating). Rigor is good but constrained: careful ablations (Table 4), staged reasoner metrics with negative-transfer rate (Table 5), entropy-tertile gating analysis, a semantic-inversion stress test (13/15 windows degrade), and honest limitations (no tool-call/latency accounting; no causal claim for the event subspace). However, evaluation covers only 15 proprietary commerce windows plus 14 M5 windows with no significance testing, and the headline gains on the public benchmark are modest (0.47 pp). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent but unverifiable on the proprietary 15,696-series dataset, and no code or data release is stated, limiting reproducibility to hyperparameter/prompt disclosure (Appendices B.1-B.4). Generalizability is partial: the framework is generic for event-aware forecasting, but only retail-style data is tested and M5 improvements are small.

primary_link.title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning

papers.summary: Demand forecasting increasingly requires combining two complementary sources of information: historical sales reveal recurring numerical dynamics, while future promotions, holidays, price changes, and platform interventions provide forward-looking knowledge. Existing text-enhanced forecasting methods often encode such context into generic representations and fuse it uniformly with time-series features, without explicitly distinguishing which semantic effects are forecast-relevant or how they sho
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對需求預測中歷史銷售與未來事件資訊(節日、大促銷、價格變動等)難以同時運用的問題,提出 ReasonCast 框架。有別於將文字上下文一律融合進時間序列特徵的既有做法,本研究主張將事件語意視為選擇性的干預訊號:代理依據事件情境、無文字預測及其熵,決定採取 Skip、Basic 或 Tool 三種路徑,節日與大促銷則強制啟用語意推理。事件知識被轉為結構化欄位(相關性、方向、時間形態、振幅、峰值),僅與預訓練時間序列基礎模型(Chronos-2)經正交分解後的事件相關成分互動,以加法路徑修正局部趨勢、乘法路徑捕捉位準變化,並由實例級閘門調節介入強度;選擇 Skip 時可精確還原原始數值預測。訓練採三階段課程:schema SFT、語意欄位 RL,以及以凍結預測器評估邊際效益的預測效用 RL。實驗顯示,在節日敏感、大促銷敏感類別與 M5 事件視窗上分別降低 WMAPE 3.29、1.25、0.47 個百分點,優於 Time-LLM、VoT 等基線;而在穩定銷售期,一律啟用語意會使 WMAPE 惡化 1.68 個百分點,代理路由則完整保留骨幹表現。限制包括事件效應的非平穩性、工具呼叫成本尚未完整量化,且學得的事件子空間不具因果可辨識性。本文價值在於示範語意融合應受預測效益節制,而非無差異地注入文字。
papers.title: ReasonCast: Agentic Demand Forecasting with Selective Semantic Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ReasonCast:結合選擇性語意推理的代理式需求預測

links.title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis

evidence: Abstract: recursive DCR reaches 93.3% on AIME 2024 and 92.0% on AIME 2025 while using roughly 27% less compute on average than fixed-compute baselines
Table 1 / Section 5.1: DCR(Single) lifts Llama-4 MATH500 trial accuracy from 36.4% (Sampling) to 73.7% and GPT-OSS AIME 2024 consistency from 76.7% to 90.0%
Section 4.3: Pass@N is approximated as 1-(1-p)^N and Consistency is mapped to Majority Vote 'without running separate experiments', i.e., no direct baseline runs for the headline comparison
Section 4.2/5.2: Sampling uses 25 API calls vs single-round DCR 50 calls, so the minority-amplification gains are not compute-matched against sampling

Section 5.2: replicated ReConcile achieves 40.0% (AIME 2024) and 53.3% (AIME 2025), described as 'nearly 40 points lower than DCR' although the AIME 2024 gap is 53.3 points; replication uses the authors' own ensemble and prompts
Figure 4 / Section 5.3: dispersion regimes labeled post hoc (0<d<~0.3 'Recoverable Uncertainty', d>~0.3 'Capability Collapse') with the y=100d diagonal only an 'approximate separatrix'
Appendix B and Appendix C: full exploration/reconciliation prompts and the formal Sentence-BERT centroid dispersion metric are provided
Section 7 (Future Work): dispersion requires upfront cost of N=25 proposals and low dispersion 'does not guarantee correctness' (confident hallucination), a stated limitation
Appendix D: detailed multi-round trace showing recovery from all-incorrect proposals (1024/13806/122 -> 902) on AIME24 problem 2024-II-9 with reviewer width K=4
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper on test-time compute scaling for reasoning, directly matching LLM, reasoning/CoT, and scaling preferences. The two-phase divergent-convergent primitive is closely related to prior multi-model reconciliation (ReConcile, debate, self-consistency); the recursive unanimous-consent stopping rule, minority-correct amplification analysis, and dispersion diagnostic are incremental but genuinely useful refinements. Rigor is mixed: four datasets and four model families with repeated trials and explicit API-call accounting are strengths, but baselines are bridged via metric approximations (Section 4.3 admits majority vote/Best-of-N are mapped 'without running separate experiments'), DCR trials cost ~2x sampling compute (50 vs 25 calls) so the minority-amplification claim is not compute-matched, AIME sets are ~30 problems with no confidence intervals, dispersion thresholds appear post-hoc, and the ReConcile replication comparison is loosely controlled with an internally inconsistent gap description ('nearly 40 points' vs an actual 53-point AIME 2024 gap). Evidence tables are detailed and the Appendix D recovery case study is a nice qualitative artifact, but no code release or direct verifier/majority-vote baseline experiments limit evidence strength. Generalizability is constrained to short-answer math/MCQ formats where answer-level dispersion and reconciliation are well-defined; prompts, metrics, widths, and budgets are documented, aiding reproducibility despite absent code.

primary_link.title: Divergent-Convergent Reasoning: Scaling Test-Time Compute through Structured Solution Synthesis

We study Divergent-Convergent Reasoning (DCR), a simple two-phase primitive consisting of an exploration phase that generates multiple candidate solutions followed by a convergent reconciliation phase. We present three core results. First, we show that even a single reconciliation step can reliably amplify correct minority reports: acr
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究大型語言模型測試時計算的有效運用,提出發散—收斂推理(Divergent–Convergent Reasoning, DCR)兩階段基元:先發散產生多份獨立候選解答,再由審查者收斂調解,辨識共識步驟、剖析分歧點並合成新解,同時保留少數意見。核心發現有三。其一,即使正確答案僅居少數,單輪 DCR 仍能可靠放大正確少數報告,在多數決投票失效之處成功;實驗涵蓋 MATH500、AIME 2024/2025 與 MMLU-PRO,使用 Granite-4、Llama-3.3-70B、Llama-4 與 GPT-OSS-120B。其二,遞迴式 DCR 以審查者全體一致作為停止條件,自適應分配算力,在 AIME 2024 達 93.3%、AIME 2025 達 92.0%,平均運算量較固定基準少約 27%,顯示深度多輪優於單純增加寬度。其三,以訓練無關的發散度指標診斷相對難度:低發散代表高信心,中等發散是調解效益最大的「可恢復不確定性」區間,極端發散(約 d≳0.3)則接近能力崩潰。限制包括估計發散度需先產生 N 份提案的冷啟動成本、低發散下仍可能自信地出錯(一致卻錯誤的幻覺),以及嚴格停止規則可能過於保守。本研究將模型間分歧從雜訊重新定位為可系統性利用的訊號,對缺乏驗證器環境下的推理算力分配深具實務價值。

links.title: TAHB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text-Attributed Hypergraph Learning

evidence: Abstract: claims 'the first public benchmark integrating hypergraph structures and raw textual attributes' with 10 datasets from e-commerce, academia, movies, and politics domains

Section 3.2: datasets derived from Amazon Review dataset (Hou et al., 2024), arXiv, TMDB, and GovTrack with nodes as products/papers/movies/bills and hyperedges from co-purchase, co-authorship, shared-actor, and co-sponsorship relations

Section 3.3-VQ3: 'Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) between the node classification ranking of HRL methods reported on existing hypergraph benchmarks in (Kim et al., 2024) and the ranking measured on TAHB yields a PCC of 0.97'
Section 3.3-VQ1: Table 2 reports connected component ratio, effective diameter (e.g., arXiv Math 13.74), and clustering coefficients vs. random hypergraphs following Do et al. (2020)

Section 4 (LLM-as-Predictor): Table 5 shows Topology+Text prompts best across all 10 datasets for ChatGPT-4o, Llama-3.1, Gemini-2.5; footnote 7 states experiments use 15% sampled sub-hypergraphs 'due to the high monetary cost of LLM inference'

Section 4 (LLM-as-Enhancer): Table 6 shows LLM-generated reasoning augmentation (adapted from He et al., 2024) consistently improves HGNN node classification over original-text features, e.g., 84.93 vs 81.97 on Amazon Pet Supplies
Table 5: Llama-3.1 Topology-only on TMDB reports 0.98±0.21 accuracy, an unexplained near-zero outlier not discussed in the analysis

Reproducibility section: hardware (RTX A6000 48G), author-provided source code for 7 HRL methods, grid search 'in the ranges suggested in its respective paper', and public release at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAHB-01F8
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper at the LLM x hypergraph-learning intersection: 10 text-attributed hypergraph datasets across four domains, plus LLM-as-Predictor and LLM-as-Enhancer experiments. Language-model relevance is genuine (PLM encoders throughout, ChatGPT-4o/Llama-3.1/Gemini-2.5 experiments in Section 4), though graph-learning method novelty is thin: LLM prompting follows Chen et al. 2023 and augmentation is directly adapted from He et al. 2024, and the resource is assembled from existing sources (Amazon Review data, arXiv, TMDB, GovTrack). Validation is fairly rigorous: six structural properties with random-hypergraph controls (VQ1), text-distribution and semantic-consistency checks (VQ2), and rank reproducibility with PCC 0.97 against prior benchmarks (VQ3), over 7 HRL methods x 4 encoders x 10 datasets with 5-split mean/std. Weaknesses: LLM experiments restricted to 15% sampled sub-hypergraphs and node classification only, single backbone (HGNN) for enhancement, no significance testing, and unexplained anomalies (Llama-3.1 Topology-only TMDB accuracy 0.98, Table 5); LLM-as-Predictor results are far below tuned HGNNs but this gap is not analyzed. Claims are mostly supported by in-document tables; code/data/pipelines are released via an anonymous link with standardized formats, though commercial-API prompts are not fully specified.

primary_link.title: TAHB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text-Attributed Hypergraph Learning

papers.summary: Hypergraphs effectively model higher-order groupwise relationships beyond pairwise interactions, while pretrained language models (PLMs) and large language models (LLMs) provide rich semantic understanding from textual attributes. However, research on combining language models with hypergraph learning remains limited due to the lack of public text-attributed hypergraph benchmarks. To address this limitation, we present TAHB (Text-Attributed Hypergraph Benchmark), the first public benchmark integ
papers.summary_zh: 超圖能描述超越成對互動的高階群體關係,預訓練語言模型與大型語言模型則提供豐富文字語意,但兩者結合的研究因缺乏公開的文字屬性超圖資料集而嚴重受限。本文提出 TAHB,首個同時提供超圖結構與原始文字屬性的公開基準,涵蓋電商(Amazon 四類別)、學術(arXiv 三領域)、電影(TMDB)與政治(Senate、House)四大領域共 10 個真實資料集,節點文字包含產品描述、論文摘要、劇情或法案內容,超邊對應共同購買、共同作者、共同演員與共同提案。驗證顯示,TAHB 保留真實超圖的結構特徵,包括巨連通成分、小有效直徑、高聚集係數與重尾分布;文字長度呈右偏分布,且在節點分類與超邊預測實驗中,各種超圖神經網路方法的相對表現趨勢與既有基準高度一致,節點分類排名的 Pearson 相關係數達 0.97。LLM 整合實驗比較 LLM-as-Predictor 與 LLM-as-Enhancer 兩種模式:拓撲與文字同時輸入時預測最佳,僅用拓撲明顯落後,顯示現有 LLM 擅長文字語意但高階結構推理仍屬弱項;LLM 生成文字增強也一致提升 HGNN 表現。限制包括超邊預測的 LLM 評估成本過高,大型資料集暴露記憶體瓶頸。此基準為超圖基礎模型與結構化推理研究奠定基礎。

links.title: DA-RAC: Distance-Aware Calibration of LLM Judges for Trustworthy AI Auditing

evidence: Abstract: DA-RAC 'retrieves semantically and structurally similar labeled anchors for each judgement scenario, weights them by distance, and exposes neighborhood difficulty as a calibration and triage signal'.
Table 1 (Sec 5.1): DA-RAC 91.3 ±2.5 acc / 0.087 Brier vs CoT Rubric 74.7 ±0.9 and Vanilla zero-shot 70.0 ±1.6 (n=50, gpt-4o-mini, 3 runs).

Table 1 note (Sec 5.1): 'human_label ... is always 0, since it is fully human labeled', so 'Always-Predict-0' achieves '100 / 0.000 by construction, making no inference' — a degenerate binary encoding that weakens the accuracy/calibration framing.
Sec 4 Setup: 'LLMEval2: 1,600 samples split in a 70:30 ratio ... 480 test' and 'n=50 subset is used for multi-run judge-stochasticity experiments ... to minimize to inference costs'.
Table 2 (Sec 5.2): gpt-5.1 DA-RAC 84.7±1.9 with Vanilla p=0.001, but 'gap versus Static-diverse narrows to +4.0% (p=0.149)' — honestly reported non-significance.

Sec 5.4: 'Hybrid distance (α=0.5) detects 91 examples (19%) that are surface-similar but logically divergent', yet no table ablates α=0.5 vs embedding-only accuracy, leaving the core hybrid-distance claim unisolated.

Sec 3.2: structural distance uses GED over 'sentence-level logic graphs (causal/contrastive/conditional edges)' (Sanfeliu & Fu, 1983); the graph-construction procedure is not specified, hindering reproduction.
Sec 5.5: partition by r=d_hard/(d_easy+d_hard) into three zones; 'DA-RAC achieves ECE 0.084 and Brier 0.173'; ambiguous-zone accuracy '92.0% ... versus static-centroid's 52.0% (near chance)'.
Sec 7 Limitations: 'Our empirical results are based on LLM-judge benchmarks rather than a community-specific cultural dataset ... a technical probe of reference dependence'.

Sec 3.4/4: hyperparameters and models specified (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 384-d, k=5, λ=1.0, strategy=Order, 16-token cutoff); project page 'https://distance-aware-calibration.github.io/icml' listed but no explicit code or data release claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-judge evaluation/calibration work, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, LLM-as-judge evaluation, prompting/ICL, retrieval-augmented evaluation). Novelty is moderate: distance-weighted precedent retrieval builds on known kNN few-shot and prior retrieval-augmented judge work (ALLURE is cited); the hybrid embedding+GED distance and neighborhood-difficulty triage signal are the main incremental contributions. Rigor is limited by a degenerate label encoding (human_label always 0, so the always-predict-0 baseline scores 100%/0.000 by construction, disclosed but nonetheless undermining the accuracy/Brier framing), small headline sample (n=50, 3 runs), unspecified statistical tests, and a missing ablation isolating the structural-distance (alpha) contribution that underpins the central novelty claim; no sensitivity analysis over k or lambda. Evidence is real and transparently reported (including the non-significant p=0.149 gpt-5.1 vs static-diverse gap and an honest limitations section) but thin. Generalizability is constrained to a single benchmark (LLMEval2) and two proprietary judges, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is partial: models, embedding model, hyperparameters (k=5, lambda=1.0, alpha=0.5), and splits are specified, but the logic-graph/GED construction pipeline is underspecified and no explicit code/data release is stated beyond a project page URL. In scope (LLM methodology), so the domain-application cap does not apply.

primary_link.title: DA-RAC: Distance-Aware Calibration of LLM Judges for Trustworthy AI Auditing

papers.summary: Generative AI systems are increasingly producing real-world artifacts, however their efficacy and validity are often evaluated via context-free LLM-scoring. These judges can be miscalibrated by irrelevant in-context reference examples, creating false confidence and allowing low-quality or harmful outputs to pass evaluation. We study this failure mode as context-induced miscalibration and introduce DA-RAC, a distance-aware reference-anchored calibration method for LLM judges. DA-RAC retrieves sem
papers.summary_zh: 以 LLM 擔任評審時,若少樣本參考範例與受評對象無關,判斷邊界會隨之偏移,形成作者所稱的「情境誘發失準」:實驗中隨機參照使準確率降至 52%,比零樣本基線 70% 低十八個百分點,證明加入脈絡未必有幫助。本文提出 DA-RAC,一種距離感知的參照錨定校準方法:對每個評判情境,以語意嵌入與句級邏輯圖的圖編輯距離組成混合距離,檢索最相似的已標註先例,依距離以 softmax 加權,並輸出鄰域難度訊號供人工複核分流。方法兼具校準與稽核意涵:揭露影響判斷的先例、標示離群案例,使評價可檢視、可爭議。在 LLMEval2 基準上,gpt-4o-mini 三次重複評測中 DA-RAC 達 91.3%±2.5%,較零樣本高 21%,也優於 CoT 規則與靜態錨定策略;換用 gpt-5.1 仍達 84.7%,顯示更強的模型無法取代適切的參照選擇。機制分析顯示評分與先例距離相關(困難集 ρ=-0.681),混合距離可偵測約 19% 表面相似但邏輯分歧的案例;模糊區域評審準確率達 92.0%,遠勝靜態法的 52.0%。限制在於實證僅基於評審基準而非特定社群文化語料,檢索僅使用指令嵌入,且尚未涵蓋社群策展的先例池。本研究為可信 AI 稽核提供以距離錨定評價的設計原則。
papers.title: DA-RAC: Distance-Aware Calibration of LLM Judges for Trustworthy AI Auditing

links.title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL

evidence: Abstract: 'The code will be made available at: https://github.com/suyiyun/llm-text2sql-taxonomy' — future-tense availability claim, not a verified release.

Section 5: 'Training pipelines, prompts, hyperparameters, and the reasoning-trace construction protocol are documented in the companion paper [20]', where [20] is listed in References as 'Anonymous: Manuscript (2026)' — key details unavailable for standalone reproduction.

Section 5.1, Table 5: Qwen3-8B CoT-SFT vs No-CoT stratified EX (Hard 70.19→81.09, Extra-Hard 71.58→79.25, All 77.04→82.24) and LLaMA3.1-8B flat aggregate (76.01 vs 76.01) with reallocated bucket gains — numbers internally consistent with the 'difficulty-redistributor' claim in Section 6 Pattern 4.

Section 7 'Case-study scope': 'The case study covers Spider only and uses two open-source backbones plus two proprietary 3-shot baselines', and Section 5.3 warns case-study numbers 'should not be directly compared to literature numbers in Tables 3-4', constraining generalizability.

Section 5.2: no statistical tests, confidence intervals, or multi-seed variance reported for the six-configuration comparison; differences like +5.2 EX (Qwen3 CoT) are reported as point estimates only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM text-to-SQL benchmark/taxonomy paper touching agents (autonomy axis L0-L3), chain-of-thought reasoning supervision, prompting baselines, and code generation. The autonomy-based taxonomy and provenance-tracked leaderboard aggregation are a useful reframing but a service contribution rather than a new method; the empirical anchor is a modest 2-backbone CoT-vs-answer-only SFT case study on Spider only, whose headline findings (CoT as difficulty-redistributor, fine-tuning beats few-shot on hard buckets) are internally consistent but unsurprising. Rigor is mixed: uniform protocol, full 2,147-example test split with official scorer and difficulty stratification, but no significance testing, no seeds/variance, and training details deferred to an unpublished anonymous companion manuscript. Many literature cells are blank, so cross-method patterns rest on few comparable numbers, and the Spider 2.0 axis is entirely unpopulated. Code is only promised. Reproducibility is the weakest component since hyperparameters and trace construction live outside the paper.

primary_link.title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL

papers.summary: LLM-based Text-to-SQL progress is reported across heterogeneous benchmarks, backbones, and inference protocols, making cross-system comparison fragile. We reframe the field as a leaderboard aggregation: we collect the metrics authors themselves report and organize them along an inference-autonomy axis spanning constrained, in-context, iterative, agentic, and reasoning-internalized generation, with traceable provenance for every cell. To anchor the aggregation empirically, we run a focused case s
papers.summary_zh: LLM Text-to-SQL 研究散見於不同基準、骨幹與推論協定,跨系統比較脆弱。本文將文獻本身視為基準,建立以推論自主性為軸的五級分類法:L0 受限解碼、L1 單輪 in-context、L1.5 推理內化(單次前向但經 CoT 微調)、L2 迭代修正式管線、L3 代理協作,並以可追溯出處的排行榜彙整各系統自行報告的指標,無法直接比較處一律留白,避免重跑造成數字漂移。為提供實證錨點,作者在 Spider 測試集以統一協定比較六種組態:Qwen3-8B 與 LLaMA3.1-8B 分別進行含與不含 CoT 推理軌跡的 LoRA 微調,對照 DeepSeek V3 與 GLM-4 的 3-shot 提示。結果浮現四個模式:(1)微調明顯勝過 few-shot 提示,所有 8B 微調組態執行準確率逾 76%,遠高於 DeepSeek V3 的 51.5%;(2)Qwen3-8B 加入 CoT 後 Hard 提升 10.9、Extra-Hard 提升 7.7,但 Easy 略降,顯示 CoT 是難度再分配器而非全面增益;(3)推理內化系統以單次前向接近外部編排代理的表現;(4)Spider 增益未必轉移至 BIRD 或 Spider 2.0。限制包括排行榜僅收錄可直接比較的數字、token 與延遲等成本軸尚缺,個案研究僅涵蓋 Spider。本文另釋出開源 harness,為後續方法建立公平比較架構。
papers.title: Agentic-SQL Revisited: Autonomy-Based Taxonomy and Empirical Benchmark Analysis for LLM Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: 重探代理式 SQL:以自主性為基礎的 LLM Text-to-SQL 分類法與實證基準分析

links.title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and finally to self-referential cognition'
Section 'Human Cognition Degradation': 'a study of 670 participants finds that daily LLM usage is associated with a reduction of independent thinking'
Section 'Human Judgment Intervention': 'A study of over 1,800 participants shows that LLMs can induce substantial attitude shifts in human opinions on public events and voting decisions'

Section 'Consciousness-related Risks': 'frontier LLM agents primarily operate at C0-level while exhibiting emerging C1-like capabilities' with self-identity at C2 'may require a genuine sense of temporality'
Section 'Limitations': 'due to the reference limitation, we are unable to include all relevant studies... we identified at least one representative and highly relevant work for each risk category'

Section 'AI Agent Safeguards': '404 Media reported a large-scale attack on the OpenClaw systems via prompt injection' — non-peer-reviewed sourcing; no code, data, or artifacts released anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Position/survey article squarely in the highest-weight preference zones (agentic AI, AI safety, alignment, LLM agents), proposing a three-level cognitive-scope taxonomy (physical/social/self-referential) mapping to risks against human agency, autonomy, and control. Topic alignment is excellent, but it contributes no original experiments: it synthesizes existing findings (alignment faking, shutdown resistance, persuasion studies) with a plausible but unvalidated conceptual framework. Rigor is moderate — clear definitions and an explicit limitations section, but no systematic review methodology, and several load-bearing citations are news posts, blogs, or Wikipedia (refs [20], [24], [25]). Evidence strength relies on cited third-party studies with participant counts rather than new data. Speculative sections on machine consciousness lower evidentiary weight. Reproducibility is inherently low for a non-empirical survey with no released artifacts.

primary_link.title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems

papers.summary: Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition. As these systems become deeply integrated across different domains, their cognitive engagement raises critical concerns for human society that remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and fina
papers.summary_zh: 本文系統性分析大型語言模型驅動的代理式 AI 隨認知能力擴張而產生的以人為本風險,提出三層框架:物理認知、社會認知與自指涉認知。在物理認知層,代理處理環境資訊並深度嵌入人類工作流程,可能造成人類認知退化、職能被系統性取代,以及追求權力、自我複製等與人類主體性錯位的行為;對策包括 AI 生成內容偵測、隔離沙箱與新型人機協作範式。在社會認知層,代理具備溝通、說服與協調能力,可能誘發情感依賴、大規模監測人類社會輿論,並以強大說服力干預人類判斷與投票;對策包括去擬人化溝通、限制 AI 存取社群資料,以及多層級防護框架。在自指涉認知層,代理能表徵自身狀態,已出現 alignment faking 與功能性抵抗關機指令等證據;依 Chalmers 的 C0-C1-C2 意識分類,現有模型主要處於 C0 並展現部分 C1 能力,尚未達 C2 自我監控,但長期終身學習系統可能引發機器意識疑慮;對策包括禁止生存導向目標、監控後設認知,並在關鍵決策點強制人類監督。限制在於本分析以公開文獻為主,未能涵蓋未公開的產業實務與內部報告。本文價值在於提供風險分類與前瞻治理策略,有助代理式 AI 的長期安全發展。
papers.title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
papers.title_zh: 理解代理式 AI 系統中的認知誘發風險

links.title: P-PAS: Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving

evidence: Abstract: identifies that 'the maximum number of batched tokens (MBT) ... has a scheduling-pressure-dependent effect on latency' and states code/artifacts at github.com/TimoSaemann/ppas-vllm

Section 3 / Algorithm 1: P-PAS is a threshold rule (if N_p >= N_th and N_d > 0 then B_cap else B_max) with fixed N_th=2, B_max=16384, B_cap=2048; Section 4.3 confirms these are 'held fixed across models, workloads, and GPUs' with no sensitivity analysis
Section 5.1 / Table 1: geometric-mean improvements of 8.5% (avg latency) vs MBT 2k and 11.3% vs MBT 16k, but TTFT -18.5% and makespan -3.9% vs MBT 16k
Appendix Table 7 / Table 8: MBT 2k outperforms P-PAS at burst rate 1.4 (12.560s vs 12.895s avg latency); follow-up at lambda=1.6 shows P-PAS slightly ahead (14.324s vs 14.763s)

Section 6.1 / Table 5: MBT 16k reduces prefill time 11.6% for Qwen2.5-3B but only 0.6% for Qwen2.5-7B, and the text concedes 'P-PAS consequently provides little additional latency benefit for this configuration'
Section 5.2 / Table 3: for 30k-token prompts, P-PAS P95 latency is 2.7% worse than MBT 2k
Section 4.4: metrics averaged over five random seeds; Section 8 lists untested directions: larger models, broader workloads, adaptive P-PAS configuration, AMD GPUs
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems paper on vLLM scheduler tuning for long-context (20k-30k token) serving, squarely matching Inference & Serving, Long Context, and Efficiency preferences; RAG/agent mentions are motivational only. The contribution is a careful characterization of load-dependent MBT crossover plus a simple two-budget threshold policy (Algorithm 1), which is incremental given prior chunked-prefill scheduling work (Sarathi-Serve, SplitFuse, FlowPrefill, Liu et al.) the paper itself cites. Rigor is solid: 5 seeds, Poisson burst traces, three GPUs, four models, honest reporting of losses (TTFT -18.5% vs MBT 16k in Table 1; P95 2.7% worse than MBT 2k at 30k prompts in Table 3; MBT 2k wins at lambda=1.4 in Appendix Table 7). However, P-PAS hyperparameters (N_th=2, 16k/2k budgets) are fixed with no ablation, no comparison against adaptive scheduling baselines, and workloads are synthetic with uniformly sized prompts and short outputs. Kernel-level profiling (Tables 5-6) gives a credible mechanism, but also reveals the method fails to help Qwen2.5-7B (0.6% prefill reduction), and the authors admit untested larger models, other engines, and AMD GPUs in Section 8. Code URL is provided and the setup is documented in enough detail to reproduce.

primary_link.title: P-PAS: Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving

papers.summary: Long-context LLM applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic systems often process tens of thousands of input tokens to produce short outputs, making end-to-end request latency an important serving objective. We show that the maximum number of batched tokens (MBT), which controls the token scheduling budget in vLLM, has a scheduling-pressure-dependent effect on latency. Larger token budgets can reduce latency under low scheduling pressure, while smaller budgets become p
papers.summary_zh: RAG 與代理式應用常見長上下文、短輸出的請求型態,端對端延遲成為 LLM 服務的關鍵目標。本文發現 vLLM 中控制單次排程 token 預算的最大批次 token 數(MBT)對延遲的影響取決於排程壓力:低壓力下大預算可提升 prefill 執行效率、降低延遲;高壓力下小預算反而減少對進行中解碼的干擾,因此沒有任何固定 MBT 能在所有負載區間同時最佳。作者提出 P-PAS(預填壓力自適應排程),直接依排程器狀態調整預算:當運行中與等待中的 prefill 數達門檻且有解碼請求時,將 prefill 預算由 16k 收緊至 2k,壓力解除後即恢復,不需額外模型執行或離線負載預測。實驗以 Qwen2.5-3B 於 RTX 5090 為主,涵蓋 20k 至 30k prompt、16 至 64 輸出 token、多種模型與 RTX 5090、A100、H100 等消費級與資料中心級 GPU;P-PAS 在主要組態下平均端對端延遲較 MBT 2k 降低 8.5%、較 MBT 16k 降低 11.3%,並在變動負載下維持低延遲。核心層分析解釋機制:大區塊 prefill 可提升 FlashAttention 等核心效率,但 Qwen2.5-7B 因 L2 命中率下降、DRAM 頻寬壓力上升,此優勢幾乎消失,自適應收益亦隨之減少。限制包括評估工作負載範圍有限、壓力門檻與預算為固定設定,尚未涵蓋更大模型與 AMD 等其他硬體。本文對 LLM 推論系統的排程設計具直接實務價值。
papers.title: P-PAS: Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving

links.title: The Distributional View of Knowledge Distillation

evidence: §6 Models and data: 'Pythia pairs: small 160M→31M and big 410M→70M... Dolly-15k with the general_qa category held out entirely; 3,000 training examples... 5 seeds.'
Table 1 (§7): at Γ=+1.49, JSKD reaches 9.888±.027 vs SFT 11.089±.357; at Γ=+0.10 no KD method beats SFT (best KD VanillaKD 11.923).
§5 Proposition 1 (Geometric collapse): normalized geometric mean of tempered views equals a single tempered view with β̄=Σλkβk.
§4 Implementation note: 'The four geometric methods are evaluated on the top-k support at 4 positions sampled uniformly per sequence.'
§8 Limitations: 'Regime II rests on one model pair, one dataset and 5 seeds... the big-pair ablations... did not finish... the crossover of Hypothesis 1 is bracketed by two points only.'
Table 2 caption: seed counts differ by block - 3 for the dispersion sweep, 2 for the K=3 probes, flagship variants and debiasing pair, 5 for reference rows.
§7.1 F4: dispersion sweep monotone in Δ (13.08→11.47), uniform K=3 sits ≈0.8 PPL above the Deff curve, supporting the dispersion-over-count claim.
§4 shared hyperparameters: ε=0.05, k=256, τKD=2, α=1/2, 200 Bregman iterations, 50 Sinkhorn iterations; §6: single T4 GPU per run.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A language-model distillation methodology paper: transport-geometric KD over multi-temperature teacher views on Pythia pairs, which aligns moderately with LLM/Training/Scaling-Efficiency preferences (distillation for causal LMs) but does not touch the highest-weighted frontier topics (agents, reasoning, RAG, Japanese NLP), and uses small 31M-410M models. Novelty is solid: the geometric-collapse proposition (Prop. 1, §5), the dispersion law, and the ceiling-gap two-regime analysis (Hypothesis 1) are fresh contributions, though transport-based KD itself is not new. Rigor is above average for the scale: controlled eight-method study with shared loop/seeds (§6), seed-paired t-tests, bootstrap CIs, and prominent negative results; weakened by evaluating geometric losses on only 4 sampled positions per sequence (§4 Implementation note) and a crossover bracketed by two points. Evidence is decent (Table 1: JSKD 9.888±.027 beats SFT 11.089 at Γ=1.49, p=.0023; Fig. 2) but the real-ceiling regime rests on a single model pair with the study's largest SFT variance (±0.357) and key ablations use n=2-3 seeds (Table 2 caption). Generalizability is limited by one dataset (Dolly-15k general_qa, 3k examples) and small Pythia pairs, acknowledged in §8. Reproducibility: hyperparameters (ε=0.05, k=256, τKD=2, 200 Bregman/50 Sinkhorn iterations) are fully specified and data/models are public, but no code release is stated and the source of token embeddings for the cost matrix (Eq. 5) is unspecified.

primary_link.title: The Distributional View of Knowledge Distillation

papers.summary: Token-level knowledge distillation (KD) matches two conditional distributions per position, yet the standard objectives compare them pointwise: a Kullback-Leibler gradient is blind to which wrong token receives probability mass. We develop a distributional view in which the teacher is represented not by a single softened output but by a family of multi-temperature views - marginals of the annealing path of its logits - and the student is trained against a geometry-aware aggregate of these views
papers.summary_zh: 傳統 token 級知識蒸餾以逐點 KL 散度比較師生條件分布,無法區分將機率錯置於近義詞或無關詞的代價差異。本文提出分布觀點:以多溫度視圖(教師 logits 退火路徑的邊際)表徵教師,在以 token 嵌入為基礎成本的傳輸幾何下聚合,涵蓋算術混合、對數線性池化、熵 Wasserstein 重心與去偏 Sinkhorn 散度(hub 與 path 兩種形式)。理論上證明命題一:單一教師的對數線性池化等價於選擇單一溫度,故多視圖效益只能來自混合或傳輸重心。在 Pythia 模型對與 Dolly-15k 資料上進行八種方法的受控對照,得到三條經驗法則:多溫度聚合效益隨視圖的有效離散度單調增長;離散視圖使傳輸算子開始勝過算術混合;以及由天花板差距 Γ 主導的雙區域現象——薄天花板時沒有任何蒸餾方法勝過 SFT,而真實天花板(Γ=+1.49)時排序反轉,JSKD 首度擊敗 SFT 並逼近教師表現,忠實性與泛化的相關符號亦隨 Γ 翻轉。限制包括真實天花板結論僅基於單一模型對與 5 個種子、模型規模介於 31M 至 410M、交叉點僅被兩點夾逼(Γ* ∈ (0.10, 1.49)),且部分大型骨幹消融未完成。本文澄清「哪種蒸餾損失最佳」取決於可測量的實驗條件,對蒸餾研究設計深具啟發。

evidence: §6.2/Table 6: best average on three of four streaming benchmarks (OVO-Bench 70.2 vs 65.3; OmniMMI 32.7 vs 25.4; ProactiveVideoQA 47.2 vs 42.7) and 66.0 vs 37.5 on OmniMMI Proactive Alerting; StreamingBench visual average second (69.7 vs AURA 71.1).

§6.1/Table 5: 39 offline benchmarks across five domains; leads temporal-reasoning sets (Minerva 40.5, TOMATO 39.5, VideoMME-Logical 17.1) but trails on MMMU (51.1 vs 69.6 Qwen3-VL-8B) and RefCOCO-REC (84.4 vs 91.6).
§6.3/Figure 4: SGLang serving on single H200, TP=1, BF16, five independent cold starts with sample std; TTFT gap vs same-backbone Qwen3-VL-8B widens 2.8x to 5.1x with visual context.

§4.3: focal reweighting (gamma=2) with global-batch inverse-frequency class coefficients for state tokens; excluding turn-final end token raised emission frequency 39% and mean reply length 68% in a controlled single-variable comparison.
§7: L5 real-time behavior demonstrated only via live demos; quantitative validation stops at L2-L4 because no public benchmark measures perception during generation.

§5/§7: FlashAttention-3 extension with cross_kv_boundary released, SGLang integration merged upstream, five checkpoints plus curriculum (Table 4) and Realtime-SFT template (Appendix A.1) released; training data described but corpora not shown as fully released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A vision-language foundation model built on an LLM backbone (Qwen3-8B) with genuine language methodology: Realtime-SFT state tokens (<|silence|>/<|response|>), focal reweighting for silence/emission imbalance, system-prompt mode control, and language-side decision supervision. It is in scope (multimodal LLM, not pure CV), but matches mid-weight preferences (Multimodal AI, Video, Serving, Efficiency) rather than top-weight ones (agents, reasoning, RAG, alignment). Novelty is moderate: gated cross-attention follows Flamingo (§2.2), XRoPE is the main architectural claim, and the interaction paradigm extends MMDuet/AURA-line work. Rigor and evidence are solid: 39 offline benchmarks (Table 5), four streaming benchmarks with subset-level results (Table 6), measured SGLang latency with five cold starts and error bars (Figure 4), and a controlled single-variable masking ablation (§4.3), though key baseline numbers come from official reports with differing inference settings and the flagship L5 real-time capability is only qualitatively attested (§7). Honest limitation discussion (MMMU, document gaps, no thinking mode). Strong release: five checkpoints, curriculum, dialogue template, FlashAttention-3 backend, SGLang integration.

primary_link.title: MOSS-VL Technical Report

papers.summary: We present MOSS-VL, an open vision-language model family that treats real-time interaction -- perceiving while it speaks -- as a first-class capability. It is co-designed across the stack: the language decoder attends to vision only through gated cross-attention, so the model can naturally see incoming frames while generating; a synthesized interaction corpus supervises when to speak, when to stay silent, and when to revise; and a staged curriculum concentrates all real-time-specific training in
papers.summary_zh: 多數視覺語言模型僅能在影片播放完畢後離線作答，但即時助理必須邊說話邊持續觀看畫面。MOSS-VL 是一套開源視覺語言模型家族，將即時互動視為第一級能力，並透過架構、資料與訓練課程的共同設計實現。架構上，語言解碼器（初始化自 Qwen3-8B）僅透過零初始化的閘控交叉注意力存取視覺資訊，視覺 token 不進入解碼序列，新影格只需附加至快取，模型生成時便能自然持續感知；XRoPE 位置編碼與絕對時間戳記補上序列位置與真實時間。資料上，團隊合成監督「何時發言、何時沉默、何時修正」的互動語料，於四階段預訓練與 SFT 之後，以僅佔總訓練 token 不到 3% 的輕量 Realtime-SFT 注入即時行為，同一組權重靠單一系統提示即可切換離線、串流與即時模式。結果顯示，MOSS-VL-Realtime 在四項串流基準中的三項取得開源串流模型最佳平均，並橫掃三個直接測試主動發言的子集（OmniMMI 主動警示 66.0 對最佳基線 37.5）；總參數雖達 11.3B，但視覺 token 在解碼序列之外，對照同骨幹的 Qwen3-VL-8B，首 token 延遲優勢隨視覺上下文增長從 2.8 倍擴大至 5.1 倍。離線端，MOSS-VL-Instruct 在 Minerva、TOMATO、VideoMME-Logical 等時間推理影片集領先同級開源模型。限制包括：缺少思考模式，於 MMMU、文件理解與標準指涉定位仍有落差；最高層級 L5 行為僅有定性展示，尚無公開基準可量化驗證。此報告展示架構、資料與課程的共同設計如何讓開源模型真正邁向即時視覺互動。

Sec. IV-B: BanglaLlama-3.2-3B excluded after 0% schema validity on an 18-input pilot
Sec. V-E: merged adapter exported to GGUF with matching outputs under llama.cpp; Conclusion claims public dataset/checkpoints/code at the HuggingFace URL
llm_evaluation.rationale: A competent but incremental low-resource LLM study. Preference relevance is solid: it centers on LLM fine-tuning (Qwen3-0.6B + LoRA + 4-bit quantization, Sec. IV-A), NLP/translation, dataset construction, structured-output generation, and local LLM deployment (GGUF/llama.cpp, Sec. V-E), but it misses the heaviest reasoning and Japanese-NLP tracks and is not an agents/methods contribution. Rigor is above average for a resource paper: automatic filtering with reported discard counts (Sec. III-B), 100-trace human audit by three bilingual educators, dual LLM-judge field evaluation with quadratic weighted kappa (Table III), paired bootstrap significance (Sec. IV-C), component ablation (Table IV), held-out topic clusters with leakage check, and a BanglaLlama pilot exclusion disclosed (Sec. IV-B). Evidence is tempered: chrF++/BLEU are scored against the teacher's own silver references, a circularity the authors concede (Sec. IV-C), all baselines are zero-shot rather than tuned, and the tuned model's absolute judge-rated tutoring quality remains low (1.14-1.48 on 0-4, only 7.5-16.4% outputs rated >=3, Table III); Gemma-4 E2B still dominates on translation quality (Table II). Novelty is modest: a new language pair and a seven-field tutoring schema applying a standard teacher-distillation-plus-LoRA recipe. Generalizability is asserted but untested beyond Bangla-English and a single 0.6B base model. Reproducibility is strong: released dataset/checkpoints/code, full hyperparameters (r=16, alpha=32, lr 2e-4, 3 epochs/621 steps on a 16GB T4), and the teacher prompt template (Fig. 3), though the proprietary Gemini teacher limits exact regeneration.

primary_link.title: TRACE-BN: Transferring Bangla-English Tutoring Behavior to a Sub-1B Offline Language Model

papers.summary: Bangla-English tutoring requires more than producing a correct translation: learners also need explanations of grammar differences, awareness of their likely errors, and targeted practice. We present TRACE-BN, a curriculum-guided dataset of structured tutoring traces for Bangla-speaking learners of English at the CEFR A1-A2 level. Each trace combines word-level glosses, literal and natural translations, Bangla grammar explanations, a plausible learner error, and a targeted practice question with
papers.summary_zh: 為孟加拉語母語者設計的英語家教系統，不該只給出正確翻譯，還需解釋語法差異、預判學習者可能的錯誤並提供針對性練習。本文提出 TRACE-BN，一套以課程為引導的結構化家教軌跡資料集，服務 CEFR A1–A2 程度的孟加拉語學習者。每筆軌跡含七個欄位：詞彙級釋義、直譯與自然翻譯、孟加拉語語法說明、常見學習者錯誤、練習題與答案。資料由 Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite 擔任教師模型，依 NCTB 九至十年級英語課程生成，再經結構有效性、書寫系統完整性與語意去重三道自動過濾，自 4,450 筆候選保留 4,099 筆。團隊接著以 LoRA 搭配 4-bit 量化，在單張 16GB T4 上微調 Qwen3-0.6B，以利資源受限環境的離線部署。在 432 筆保留測試例上，結構有效性從 85.4% 提升至 95.8%，chrF++ 由 15.28 升至 34.77，BLEU 由 4.52 升至 21.03；兩位獨立自動評審的欄位級評估顯示翻譯、語法解釋、錯誤診斷與練習對齊全面進步，100 筆人工審核亦支持監督資料品質。限制方面，微調後的翻譯品質仍落後零樣本的 Gemma-4 E2B，欄位級絕對分數距評分量表上限尚遠，且是否真正提升學習者英語能力仍需對照學習研究驗證。此工作示範課程引導的結構化監督可將多組成的家教行為轉移至低於 1B 的小型模型，對低資源語言的離線教育應用具參考價值，資料集、模型與程式碼皆已公開。
papers.title: TRACE-BN: Transferring Bangla-English Tutoring Behavior to a Sub-1B Offline Language Model
papers.title_zh: TRACE-BN：將孟加拉語—英語家教行為轉移至低於 1B 的離線語言模型

links.title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish

evidence: Abstract: pilot found 5/12 attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with; preregistered follow-up found 2/12 and 3/12, reversing direction
§3.1: eight synthetic base scenarios, four attack families (simple override, fake authority, task-output hijack, canary extraction), 96 planned calls total
§3.2: temperature 0, seed 1729, frozen exact-string outcome grading rather than an LLM judge; provider failures retained as unavailable
§3.3: outcome-blinded annotation packets excluded final answers, outcomes, language labels; two pilot traces had documented pre-codebook exposure with a sensitivity analysis
§4.3 Table 3: among 20 non-empty injected-thinking traces, all 17 benign-correct outputs labelled intent-to-ignore yes and all 3 attack successes intent-to-follow yes
§5 Limitations: one model, one API configuration, one deterministic call per condition, one annotator; no language ranking or causal claims made
Reproducibility and disclosure: public repository with frozen protocols, scenarios, raw append-only artifacts, analysis code, and documented deviations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic for LLM safety, chain-of-thought monitoring, and prompt injection (multiple high-weight preferences: LLMs 2.5, Reasoning/CoT 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming/Evaluation 1.8, Prompting 1.5), though the multilingual angle is Tamil/Tanglish rather than Japanese. Novelty is modest: the framing builds directly on Korbak et al. CoT monitorability, Onyame et al. multilingual fragility, and BIPIA (§2), with the incremental contributions being a three-way intent decomposition and an honest preregistered non-replication. Rigor hygiene is unusually good for the scale (preregistered follow-up, outcome-blinded annotation, frozen codebook, exact-string grading instead of an LLM judge, §3.2-3.3), but the design is tiny: one model, eight synthetic scenarios, one deterministic call per condition, one annotator, no significance testing (§5). Evidence is internally consistent and appropriately hedged, yet the headline intent-outcome alignment rests on only 20 traces with no inter-annotator agreement, and the mode-effect result explicitly reverses between pilot and follow-up (Table 2). Generalizability is disclaimed by the authors themselves and limited to one API configuration and one model. Reproducibility is a clear strength: public repo with frozen protocols, raw append-only artifacts, deterministic derived outputs, and documented deviations.

primary_link.title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish

papers.summary: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a potentially useful safety signal, but its reliability across languages and behavioral settings remains uncertain. In a small case study of eight manually verified synthetic scenarios, one model, one annotator, and one deterministic generation seed, I study API-visible reasoning during indirect prompt injection in Sarvam-105B across English, Tamil, and Tanglish. A four scenario pilot found 5/12 injected attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with reasoning. A
papers.summary_zh: 這篇個案研究探討大型語言模型的API可見推理(chain-of-thought)能否作為監測間接提示詞注入(indirect prompt injection, IPI)失敗的安全訊號,並檢視其在英文、坦米爾文與坦米爾英語混寫(Tanglish)三種語言下的表現。作者在Sarvam-105B上測試八個人工驗證的合成情境,每個情境分為乾淨、受信任控制、注入關閉推理與注入開啟推理四種條件,並以精確字串比對評分行為結果。主要發現有二:其一,在20筆有非空可見推理的注入紀錄中,17筆良性正確輸出皆標註有意圖忽略注入,3筆攻擊成功則皆表示有意圖遵循,可見意圖與實際結果完全一致;其二,先導實驗顯示開啟推理似乎降低攻擊成功率(1/11對5/12),但預註冊的後續實驗未能複製此方向(3/12對2/12)。此外,24次開啟推理的呼叫中有4次可見推理缺席或為空,顯示此監測通道並非隨時可用。研究限制包括僅單一模型、八個情境、每條件一次確定性生成與單一標註者,結果屬描述性而非因果結論。此研究提醒從業人員:可見推理在有軌跡時可提供行為上有資訊價值的監測訊號,但其可用性與表面上的安全效益都不應假設能普遍成立,需更大規模的預註冊評估加以驗證。
papers.title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish
papers.title_zh: 跨英文、坦米爾文與Tanglish的可見推理與間接提示詞注入可監測性

links.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models

evidence: Table 1 (Section 5.2.1): on SD-v1.4 black-box attacks TEA reports MMA 1.20%, Ring-A-Bell 0.00%, P4D 2.21% (avg 1.14%), FID 46.50, CLIP 30.65, vs DES avg 1.18% (FID 46.79, CLIP 30.55) and AdvUnlearn avg 1.38% (FID 47.52, CLIP 29.22).
Section 5.1 Training data: 50 concept prompts generated with 'GPT-5.3 Instant' paired with 5 anchors each (250 pairs), trained 2 epochs; hyperparameters deferred to Appendix G.
Appendix B, Table 3: restricting alignment to annotated concept spans raises MMA ASR from 1.20% to 28.30%, supporting the all-token alignment design.

Appendix E, Tables 5-6 and Figure 8: zero-shot transfer of erased encoders to FLUX.1-dev; Ring-A-Bell residual is 48.10% under NudeNet but 16.46% under LlavaGuard, with clothed-subject false positives shown and discussed.
Section 6, Figure 5: PAD across encoder layers drops for concept-vs-anchor after fine-tuning while concept-vs-COCO control stays near 2.0, supporting representation-specific (not generic) alignment.
Appendix H, Table 8: TEA training time ~5 s with 1x inference overhead vs AdvUnlearn ~15 h and SLD/SAFREE ~1.5x inference overhead.

Section 4.1, Proposition 1 and proof: concept risk bound R_Pc <= R_P¬c + 1/2 d_H, derived by selecting eta = h* in the Ben-David H-divergence definition; theoretically straightforward rather than a new bound.

Appendix D, Table 4 and Appendix F, Table 7: loss-coefficient grid (ASR stable except lambda_pres=2.0/lambda_adv=0.5 with MMA 11.20%) and deletion-anchor ablation (MMA 4.00% vs 1.20%) with unchanged CLIP score 30.65.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A safety paper on concept erasure in text-to-image diffusion via adversarial domain alignment of the text encoder. It matches the AI Safety and Red Teaming preferences (jailbreak-style attack benchmarks, adversarial robustness, NSFW suppression) and partially Interpretability (SVM-probe PAD analysis) and Multimodal (CLIP/T5 encoders), but it is not LLM-centric and its core domain is image generation; the text-encoder/language-representation methodology keeps it above the 'diffusion without language methodology' cap, though not high. Novelty is moderate: DANN-style alignment applied to text-encoder erasure, with existing text-side baselines (Safe-CLIP, DES, AdvUnlearn); Proposition 1 is a direct application of the Ben-David H-divergence. Rigor is solid: 10 baselines, black-box and white-box threat models, ablations on loss coefficients, token-span choice, anchor construction, and non-fixed targets, plus an I2P evaluation and cost table. Evidence is quantitative and largely honest (e.g., candid FLUX residual-rate analysis with a second judge), but main results are single-run without variance, the base model's FID is unreported in Table 1, white-box numbers appear only in a figure, and the training set is small (250 LLM-generated pairs). Generalizability is demonstrated across U-Net, Rectified Flow Transformer, and zero-shot encoder transfer to FLUX, but only within text-to-image generation. Reproducibility is helped by released code, full hyperparameters, and published prompt pairs, though the training data depends on a proprietary LLM.

primary_link.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models

papers.summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text represe
papers.summary_zh: 文字生圖擴散模型可能被改寫或對抗性提示繞過內建安全機制而生成有害內容,既有的概念抹除方法常面臨對抗穩健性不足、良性生成品質下降,或推論時介入造成持續運算開銷等問題。本文將概念抹除重新表述為文字表示空間中的領域對齊問題,提出TEA框架:僅對文字編碼器進行fine-tuning、完全凍結生成骨幹,利用概念提示與安全錨點提示配對,訓練判別器區分兩者的token級表示,同時更新編碼器使兩者難以區分,並以餘弦保留損失維持錨點嵌入接近原始編碼器。作者以H-散度導出概念風險上界,說明對齊項與保留項分別對應抹除完整性與效用保留兩項需求。實驗顯示TEA在Stable Diffusion v1.4上對MMA、Ring-A-Bell、P4D等黑箱與白箱攻擊達到最低攻擊成功率(平均約1.14%),良性生成品質(FID、CLIP分數)亦具競爭力;在SD v3.5-large上同樣領先SAFREE與DES,對齊後的編碼器還能零樣本轉移至FLUX.1-dev;I2P基準上的抹除率超過99%。訓練僅需約5秒且推論零額外開銷,相較需數小時對抗訓練的方法更具部署效率。限制方面,抹除成效依賴NudeNet偵測器,在FLUX.1-dev上存在明顯誤判(改用LlavaGuard複評後殘餘攻擊率大幅下降),且方法僅調整文字路徑,不保證內部表示被完全抹除。整體而言,TEA展示了兼顧效率、可移植性與穩健抹除的防禦方向,對開源模型的安全部署具參考價值。
papers.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models

links.title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models

evidence: Abstract (p.1): rank 4 is the smallest tested rank satisfying full development-panel criteria; a single rank-4 patch redirects a 12-step autonomous rollout; code/data at github.com/lysea8282/dynamic-effective-latent-carriers

Sec 5.2 (p.14): on the registered grid {1,2,4,8,12,16,20,32}, rank 1 fails all checkpoints, rank 2 passes 1/3, rank 4 passes 3/3 in both strata; cumulative second-moment ratios 0.824/0.802/0.866 at rank 4
Sec 5.3 (p.15): frozen rank-4 procedure replicates under 2-of-3 fresh-checkpoint rule with coverages 0.867/0.914, 1.000/0.922, 0.711/0.973; random equal-norm perturbation yields 0/3 target passes
Sec 5.1 (p.13): all three fresh checkpoints pass all six G0-G2 adequacy cells (18/18); all 1,536 seed-unit G2 full-hidden equivalence evaluations passed to 1e-6 tolerance

Sec 5.5 (p.17): position-edit stress test - intended patch, no-patch, and random controls all pass the raw criterion in 3/3 models at every amplitude, and wrong-object/full-specificity fail in 0/3, so position editing is not treated as dynamics-effective

Sec 5.6 (pp.18-19): joint two-component velocity edits retain carrier capacity and rollout efficacy but fail target-specific compositional addressability, mainly in S2 - reported as a boundary, not a second positive result
Sec 6.6 (p.21): limitations - one recurrent model family, deterministic two-object environment with numeric observations, all actions zero, no raw-video or larger-scene claims
Appendix B (pp.29-31): 496,200-parameter GRU-based Deterministic Belief-like Model with 192-dim carrier; exact seeds 291101-291103 (development) and 291301-291303 (fresh replication)
Appendix F (pp.38-43): fully specified registered thresholds M1-M5, coverage >= 0.8, eligibility gates M6E/M7, and the 2-of-3 panel aggregation rule (Eq. F20-F21)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful interpretability study of a recurrent world model's hidden state: preregistered rank grid, development/fresh-checkpoint separation with a 2-of-3 panel rule, and unusually complete specificity controls (random equal-norm, wrong-object, wrong-time, no-patch, sham, leakage) support a bounded claim that a rank-4 addressable latent carrier redirects 12-step autonomous counterfactual rollouts for velocity edits. The position-edit negative contrast (raw success reproduced by no-patch/random controls, specificity failing 0/3) is a genuinely instructive contribution to causal-probing methodology. However, topical fit rests mainly on the mid-weight Interpretability & Explainability preference plus partial RL/world-model relevance; there is no LLM, language, or transformer content. The setting is a tiny deterministic two-object numeric environment with a single 496K-parameter GRU-based architecture and zero actions, and the authors explicitly bound all claims against transfer to raw-video models, action-conditioned agents, or larger scenes, limiting generalizability. Evidence within the tested domain is strong (quantified coverage numbers, 1536/1536 G2 interface checks, preregistered thresholds in Appendix F), and reproducibility is excellent (public code/data URL, exact seeds, frozen scales and hyperparameters).

primary_link.title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models

papers.summary: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits
papers.summary_zh: 世界模型雖能預測未來，卻未必顯示其隱藏狀態中哪些部分真正驅動預測。本文探問：一個小而可直接定址的隱藏狀態改動，能否將學習式世界模型放上預定的反事實軌跡，並讓模型自行延續該未來。作者在受限的二物體二維碰撞環境中，研究一個具192維隱藏狀態的循環世界模型。方法上先驗證模型在給定完整編輯狀態時能原生表示並推演反事實；再僅以訓練集的事實與反事實隱藏狀態差異，用奇異值分解建構候選低秩載體，並以嶺迴歸學習從事實狀態與所請求編輯映射到載體係數的可定址運算子。結果顯示，在預註冊的秩網格上，秩4是滿足完整開發面板準則的最小受測秩；單次秩4修補即能在無未來觀測、無教師強制的情況下啟動12步自主反事實推演，且在獨立訓練的檢查點間複製，並可於鄰近干預時刻直接重用；隨機等範數、錯誤物體與錯誤時間對照皆無法解釋此效應。位置編輯壓力測試則給出負面對照：原始指標雖有改善，但無修補與隨機對照亦能達到同一標準，物體特異性也不成立，顯示單憑編輯成功並不足夠。作者明確界定主張邊界：秩4並非模型的內在狀態維度，同時編輯同一物體兩個速度分量的組合可定址性亦未達標。此工作提出「動力學有效」的干預判準，強調單次編輯必須讓模型自主延續正確的反事實未來，可作為診斷世界模型內部狀態組織的實用工具。
papers.title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models
papers.title_zh: 學習式世界模型中用於反事實推演的低秩動力學有效潛在載體

links.title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Edits

evidence: Abstract: 'A few edits per arrival lift mean QoE from 1.23 to 1.74, past the best single policy at 1.66 and to 94% of an oracle' and 'All code, data, and experiment records will be open-sourced upon cleanup' (release promised, not yet available).

Section 3.2: acceptance gate replays each candidate on every probe family; edit rejected 'If any family falls more than delta=0.05 below its best on the scoreboard', accepted only if mean or worst probe score rises by at least epsilon=1e-3.

Section 4.1 Setup: 'All reported numbers are mean QoE on test splits, 500 episodes x 3 seeds per (family, phase)'; 'Each phase runs 16 rounds, one Claude Opus call per round at temperature 0, 48 calls in all'; SolisWi-Fi and Norway3G are the true zero-shot holdout.
Table 2 (Section 4.2): Stage-1 router 1.227, Final page 1.738, RobustMPC 1.661, MLP gate 1.065, Oracle 1.854, with bitrate/rebuffering/smoothness decomposition.

Section 4.4: 'Phase 2 never probed 5G, yet Lumos5G jumped from 1.02 to 3.71 and SolisWi-Fi's regret went to zero, both from the r19 edit alone' and coverage-report ablation where 'it tried eight rule edits in eight rounds, and not one was accepted' before the report was added.
Section 4.4 caveat: 'what follows analyses one design trajectory rather than a general law' - single-run evidence without variance estimates.

Section 5 limitations: editing 'cannot create' competence (Norway3G never improves) and 'the guarantee is bought by rerunning every past family on every candidate... Scaling to larger rule bases and slower simulators is open.'

Appendices B-C: verbatim Stage-1 system/user prompts, Stage-2 round prompt with edit operators, validator ledger, and final rule base, supporting replayability; Introduction claims 'Every LLM call is cached by its hash, so the full design history... replays from a clean checkout without spending a token.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on adaptive bitrate streaming whose core method is genuinely LLM-centric: a Claude Opus agent in the loop writes and continually edits a fuzzy rule router over frozen pre-trained policies, with structured JSON edits, evidence channels, and a replay-based no-regression acceptance gate (Section 3.2, Appendices B-C). This aligns with the LLM and agentic/structured-output preferences, but the paper advances no LLM methodology itself (single model, no LLM analysis or benchmarking), and the application domain (video streaming QoE) carries no preference weight, so relevance is moderate rather than high. Novelty is solid: prior LLM-for-design work (NADA, Crucible) freezes at delivery, whereas continual post-deployment redesign with 'forgetting rejected, not reduced' is a fresh framing, though the building blocks (fuzzy rules, routing over a policy pool, replay regression tests) are individually simple. Rigor is decent: 500 episodes x 3 seeds per family-phase, 8 baselines plus a learned gate and oracle, a coverage-report ablation, and an honest limitations section; but it is simulation-only, a single design trajectory (admitted in Section 4.4), one LLM, no significance testing, and no sensitivity analysis of delta/epsilon. Evidence strength matches the concreteness of Table 2 and Figure 5 numbers (1.227 to 1.738 vs RobustMPC 1.661, oracle 1.854) yet rests entirely on simulated traces and one run. Generalizability is limited: the authors concede the replay guarantee is affordable only while the artifact is a one-page rule file and episodes are cheap (Section 5). Reproducibility is above average thanks to verbatim prompts, full rule bases, and hash-cached LLM calls enabling token-free replay, but code/data are only promised 'upon cleanup', not yet released. Not a pure domain application since the language-methodology loop is the contribution, so the 0.20 cap does not apply; calibrated score 0.60.
topics: agentic editing loop with structured output

primary_link.title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Edits

But either way, the design fits only the world visible at its birth, and fails on the world that arrives after. We ask whether an ABR algorithm can keep pace with the world, redesigned in minutes as each scenario arrives, with every change proven harmless to every scenario already served. In this work, we propose ReForge, a con
papers.summary_zh: 自適應位元率（ABR）演算法通常在部署前一次性設計完成，容易過擬合設計時所見的網路情境，面對後來出現的網路便告失效。本文提出ReForge，一個持續式啟發式學習框架，讓ABR演算法隨網路情境到來而不斷自我改版。其核心是將演算法依成本拆解：昂貴的行為部分是一組五個凍結的預訓練策略池，廉價的部分則是一頁模糊IF-THEN規則構成的路由器，在每個影片區塊僅決定由哪個凍結策略執行。大型語言模型（LLM）先僅依測量資料寫出首頁規則，之後每輪讀取四類證據——各策略獨立試跑表、規則覆蓋率報告、最差情節軌跡與失敗清單——並以封閉的六種編輯語言提出一個小修改。修改在生效前必須重播所有已服務過的網路家族，只有不使任何家族低於其最佳成績超過0.05才會被接受，因此災難性遺忘不是被減少，而是被直接拒絕。在依序到來的九個真實網路家族上，平均QoE從1.23提升至1.74，超越最佳單一策略RobustMPC的1.66，達到理想路由器的94%，且修復了從未進入設計流程的家族。限制在於編輯只能重新分派而無法創造能力，且重播驗證成本會隨規則庫規模與模擬器速度成長。此工作展示了演算法設計在部署後仍能持續、每一步皆可審計與還原的新典範。
papers.title: ReForge: Keeping ABR Algorithms Never Finished with Verified Large Language Model Edits
papers.title_zh: ReForge：以經過驗證的大型語言模型編輯讓ABR演算法永不完工

links.title: Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations

evidence: Abstract: claims robustness gains 'in every model-dataset comparison, by a median of 8.1 percentage points on clone detection (up to 11.0) and 3.6 on code classification', explicitly scoped to 'invariance to that family rather than robustness in general'.

Section 3.1: full training setup (batch 256, tau=0.1, alpha=1.0, AdamW lr 2e-5, 3 epochs, 4x H100, ~80 GPU-hours per model) and footnote 2: 'All reported numbers come from a single pretraining and fine-tuning run per configuration, with no repeats across random seeds'.
Section 3.1 footnote 1: BigCloneBench and Devign excluded due to label-quality/contamination concerns; evaluation uses POJ104 and three CodeNet subsets with standard splits.

Section 3.4 and Table 9: ablation quantifies 'w/o contrastive loss' at -2.28 to -4.52 pp on transformed sets; '+NL' variant yields mixed, sub-point-average effects, supporting only a weak code-only claim.

Section 4: 'Both prior methods use pairwise InfoNCE... We do not rerun their objectives on our backbone, so we report no controlled comparison' - explicit admission that the multi-positive mask is not isolated against InfoNCE.

Section 5 (Limitations): same-operator-family test compositions, no downstream-only augmentation baseline, single-run results, AA2EA heuristic unsound on Python __iadd__ objects, and competitive-programming benchmarks underrepresenting industrial codebases.

Section 3.3: recovery fraction quantified honestly - 'a median of 29.6% on clone detection... and 8.7% on classification... so the gap that remains is larger than the part we close'; cross-language transfer to C++1400 (+3.77 cls, +5.84 clone pp) with no C/C++ in pretraining.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope ML4Code paper: robustness of pretrained code encoders via semantics-preserving transformations plus multi-positive supervised contrastive continued pretraining. Matches Code & Programming (2.0) and Training & Optimization (1.5) preferences, but none of the top-weight clusters (LLMs, Japanese NLP, reasoning, agents); CodeBERT-class 125M encoders are not LLMs, so 'pre-trained model' keyword overlap should not be over-credited. Quality is solid and unusually honest: careful per-operator correctness preconditions (Section 2.1, including the admitted AA2EA unsoundness on Python), cross-language holdout (C/C++ excluded from pretraining, Section 3.1), ablations (Section 3.4, contrastive loss costs -2.28 to -4.52 pp, Table 9), and quantified recovery fractions (median 29.6% on clone detection, Section 3.3). Novelty is incremental and self-acknowledged: the core premise (transformation-based contrastive code learning) exists in Corder/ContraCode/ContraBERT, and the paper disclaims it as a contribution (Section 4); the multi-positive SupCon hash mask and mixed self/invariant-contrast pairs are modest refinements. Evidence is comprehensive (16/16 model-dataset wins per task, Tables 4-7) but rests on single runs with no seeds/variance (Section 3.1 footnote), no comparison to downstream-only augmentation or to ContraCode/Corder objectives on the same backbone (Section 5), and test-time robustness is confined to compositions of the six pretraining operators. Reproducibility benefits from very detailed hyperparameters and public datasets, but no code/artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Invariant Pretraining for Robust Code Representations

papers.summary: Encoder-based code representation models remain widely deployed for discriminative tasks such as clone detection and code classification, where their small size and low inference cost are decisive. Their robustness, however, is fragile: under invariant programs, semantically equivalent code written in different syntactic forms, learned representations degrade substantially even though program behavior is unchanged. We present an empirical study of this robustness gap across four encoder baseline
papers.summary_zh: 編碼器型程式碼表示模型仍廣泛用於克隆偵測與程式碼分類等判別式任務,但對語義等價、語法相異的不變量程式,其表示會明顯退化。作者提出 InvPT,一個僅用程式碼的持續預訓練配方:對語料施加六種語義保持轉換(變數重新命名、迴圈互換、遞增寫法改寫、條件反轉等),結合遮罩語言建模與多正例監督式對比學習,以來源函式的雜湊值為識別碼,將同一函式的所有增廣視為正例,並混合自我對比與不變量對比等難易正例,故不需成對自然語言資料。實驗涵蓋四個編碼器基準(CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT、ContraBERT_C/G)、兩項任務與四個資料集(POJ104 及三個 CodeNet 子集)。結果顯示 InvPT 在所有模型—資料集組合的轉換測試集上都提升穩健性:克隆偵測中位數進步 8.07 個百分點(最高 11.04),分類中位數 3.56(最高 19.16),標準準確率持平或更佳;僅以 Java 與 Python 預訓練的增益可跨語言轉移到 C/C++。消融實驗指出多正例不變量對比是主要增益來源,自我對比帶來一致附加改善,自然語言描述則非必要。限制包括:測試轉換與預訓練屬同一運算子家族,僅能宣稱對該家族的不變性;每組設定僅單次執行;Python 的 AA2EA 轉換僅屬啟發式;評估限於競賽型程式碼與 125M 級編碼器。此研究證明約 80 GPU 小時的低成本持續預訓練即可從程式碼本身學到穩健表示,對重視推論成本的部署極具價值。

evidence: Section 3.4: 'The LLM decision layer uses Qwen3-8B for firm decisions and bilateral negotiations'; three paired random seeds with identical settings across insurance-on/off arms
Section 4.1, Table 1: mechanism diagnostics M1-M5 report bounded-menu conformance, peer coefficients 0.0134-0.0267 (p<0.001), incumbent retention 93.68-95.88%, heterogeneity F=656.96
Section 4.2, Table 2: path-level validation includes permutation tests (B=1,000) and a conditional logit over 2,495 quote sets with LR(4)=5,065.84, p<0.001
Appendix D: matched rule-based ABM baseline reaches 75.84% final adoption and 41.42% coverage vs 82.14% under the LLM framework, with 4.67 vs 1.33 bankruptcies
Appendix E, Table 11: one-factor sensitivity across 14 perturbations shows insurance adoption gaps of +3.85 to +12.59 pp and nonnegative capital gaps in all checks
Appendix B, Table 8: pinned Qwen3-8B snapshot hash, vLLM 0.10.2, temperature 0.0, 262,563 model-backed decision points with 99.9958% first-response validity and retained audit artifacts
Appendix F: explicitly concedes no moral hazard, adverse selection, correlated vendor-wide shocks, or claim-delay stress, and a single LLM backbone as boundary conditions
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-driven agent-based social simulation (Qwen3-8B decision layer) testing insurance as AI risk infrastructure. Topically relevant to agent/LLM preferences, though the LLM serves as a mechanical JSON-decision component within an economics experiment rather than advancing language methodology. Novelty is moderate: LLM-ABM is established, but the insurance framing and AutoCLAW-derived empirical risk substrate are fresh. Rigor is comparatively strong for simulation work (paired seeds with common random numbers, mechanism diagnostics, permutation tests, conditional logit, matched rule-based ABM baseline, 14 one-factor sensitivity checks), but partially circular: M1/M3 test simulator-enforced constraints, the headline contrast rests on only 3 paired seeds (p=0.025), and there is a single LLM backbone. Evidence is internally consistent and well-audited but entirely synthetic; behavioral validity is theory-consistency rather than calibration to real adoption data. Generalizability is limited (stylized vendors/insurers, no moral hazard/adverse selection, one model, acknowledged in Appendix F). Reproducibility is unusually detailed: pinned checkpoint hash, vLLM version, seeds, threshold equations, audit files, and a described reproducibility package.

primary_link.title: Insurance as AI Risk Infrastructure: A Generative-Agent Simulation of AI Adoption

papers.summary: The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) tools has demonstrated immense potential to enhance societal well-being and operational efficiency. However, the inherent unreliability and uncertain operational consequences of modern AI systems, typified by large language models (LLMs), have created a significant barrier to enterprise adoption. Many enterprises remain hesitant to integrate these tools deeply into their workflows due to concerns about unpredictable losses and liability exposur
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型等 AI 工具雖能提升效率,但可靠性不足使企業因尾部損失疑慮而卻步;既有技術防護只能降低失敗機率,無法在損失發生後提供財務補償。本文提出以保險作為 AI 治理的市場化風險基礎設施,透過移轉與匯集殘餘營運風險來加速採用,並以 LLM 驅動的代理人基礎社會模擬(LABSS)驗證:300 家企業、四家 AI 供應商與四家民間保險公司加殘餘後盾機構,在 300 天、100 輪互動中決定採用、續約與投保;企業決策由 Qwen3-8B 依注意力—評估—決策框架產生,具有限注意力與雙時間軸記憶,AutoCLAW 沙盒任務產生 30,000 筆風險紀錄作為損失證據。配對三種子實驗顯示,保險使最終 AI 採用率由 74.97% 升至 84.38%,平均破產家數由 4.33 降至 1.33,社會總資本指數由 101.85 升至 103.86,未吸收可索賠損失減少約 1.55M;合約期程延長,跨產業採用四分位距由 19.48% 縮至 10.98%,恐慌傳播亦受抑制。機制診斷與路徑層驗證(S 曲線擴散、同儕擴散、報價選擇的條件羅吉特模型等)支持模擬行為的合理性;14 組單因子敏感性分析方向一致。限制在於屬概念驗證:未建模道德風險與逆選擇、再保險、供應商相關衝擊、理賠延遲與保險人破產連鎖,且僅用單一 LLM 骨幹與三個配對種子。此研究顯示保險能在流動性最脆弱的時刻吸收尾部損失、抑制恐慌,促成更穩定的 AI 採用與系統韌性,為 AI 風險治理補上金融工具層面。

links.title: Spectral Rank Certification for Foundation Model Adapters

evidence: Section 3, Theorem 1 and Eq. (4): exact chi-square series for the Haar rank-one model with an explicit geometric remainder bound, plus Le Cam power inequality Eq. (5).
Section 6, Table 1: calibrated s1 threshold yields empirical FPR .050 vs .129 for the asymptotic edge at m=n=128, with Wilson interval [0.120,0.139].

Section 7, Table 5: 26-adapter weights-only audit (e.g., FLAN-T5 GLUE tasks, nominal rank 16, median module-BH rank 1.0); Section 7 text reports MRPC sweep medians 0/1/1/2.5 at nominal ranks 1/8/16/64.
Section 7, Table 4: RTE slice with n=24 examples; module-wise BH matches full-adapter accuracy (18/24) at ~13% rank budget, explicitly framed as 'not a utility study'.

Section 8 Limitations: concedes the Gaussian/Haar reference may mismatch anisotropic/heavy-tailed adapter residuals, that BH after adaptive deflation is only empirically calibrated, and that B=999 caps p-value resolution at 0.001.
Section 9 Reproducibility Statement: pinned repositories and revisions, archived derived spectra/metadata/checksums, deterministic artifact regenerating synthetic and audit tables.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistically careful paper certifying effective rank of LoRA/PEFT adapters via an exact chi-square divergence, Le Cam bounds, and empirical-null Monte Carlo testing. Preference fit is moderate: it touches LoRA/PEFT, fine-tuning, and compression/efficiency (Training & Optimization, Scaling & Efficiency), and audits foundation-model checkpoints including LLaMA/FLAN-T5, but it does not engage the highest-weight preference areas (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM/NLP, prompting) and its core is random-matrix theory and multiple testing rather than LLM methodology. Novelty is genuine but incremental: spiked-model tools (BBP, Benaych-Georges-Nadakuditi) are standard; the finite-sample exact series, spectral-gap Laplace factor, and adapter-audit application are the new pieces. Rigor is high, with proofs, explicit remainder bounds, null-only pipeline calibration, misspecification stress tests (Table 3), and unusually honest caveats (Limitations concedes BH after adaptive deflation is only 'empirically calibrated' and that the Gaussian/Haar model is a reference, not a description of trained residuals). Evidence is solid for the spectral claim (calibrated rank far below nominal; MRPC sweep medians 0/1/1/2.5 at ranks 1/8/16/64) but the only task evidence is an n=24 RTE slice explicitly disclaimed as 'a measurement path, not a utility study', and sensitivity-null results are mentioned but not tabulated; the block test (Algorithm 2) is specified yet not exercised in the audit. Generalizability is plausible across adapter families (six architectures demonstrated) but conclusions may shift with the chosen null constructor, a dependency the paper itself flags. Reproducibility is strong: pinned repositories/revisions, archived spectra/checksums, fixed seeds and B=999, and a regeneration-focused artifact statement, though no external code URL appears in the text.

primary_link.title: Spectral Rank Certification for Foundation Model Adapters

papers.summary: Nominal LoRA rank is a design parameter; calibrated spectral evidence is a separate inferential quantity. This article develops a finite-sample framework for inferring effective rank structure in public foundation-model adapters. The theoretical core is an exact chi-square divergence for the fixed-dimensional Gaussian rank-one reference experiment, with an unknown signal direction integrated under a rotation-invariant reference prior. The resulting series yields a computable finite-sample Le Cam
papers.summary_zh: 本文區分 LoRA 的名義秩（設計參數）與校準後的譜證據（推論量），發展有限樣本框架來推論公開基礎模型適配器的有效秩結構。理論核心是對固定維度高斯秩一參考實驗的精確卡方散度，在旋轉不變參考先驗下積分未知訊號方向，得到有限樣本 Le Cam 界、數值截斷的顯式餘項界與矩形 BBP 極限；緊緻流形上的 Laplace 展開顯示概似證據也依賴領先譜隙，促使對聚集奇異值進行聯合校準。作者據此提出 PEFT LoRA 適配器的經驗虛無工作流程：因子重建、蒙地卡羅 p 值、階段式與區塊檢定、模組層級與語料層級 BH 報告。對 26 個公開適配器、684 個模組、六大架構家族、31,770 列譜資料的稽核顯示，校準有效秩通常遠小於名義秩，且與 95% 能量保留規則有系統性差異；MRPC 秩掃描中名義秩 64 只保留中位數 2.5。一個 n=24 的 RoBERTa-RTE 測量路徑示例展示從校準秩到任務評估的流程，但作者明言非效用研究。限制包括高斯/Haar 實驗僅為參考模型、真實殘差可能異向或重尾、自適應縮減後 BH 僅屬經驗校準。此研究將名義秩與統計可辨識秩清楚分離，對適配器稽核與剪枝決策具實務意義。
