links.title: A Declarative-Procedural Perspective on Expert Routing in Bilingual Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

evidence: Abstract: curriculum model 'exhibits a peak mutual information of 0.1148 at layer 5'; no-curriculum baseline 'reaching a peak mutual information of 0.2599 at the same layer'.

Section 5.2, Table 3: sentence-level permutation tests (1,000 permutations) show significant routing-category MI at all routed layers, p=0.000999; Appendix G reports random routing MI ~0.002 and frozen router 0.0274 at layer 5.

Section 5.6 and Appendix G.1, Table 10: at second seed the no-curriculum dominant language flips to German (DE layer-5 MI 0.213 vs EN 0.078), reversing seed-42's EN 0.646; authors restrict claims to seed-stable structure (|EN-DE| asymmetry 0.534/0.135 no-curr vs 0.042/0.084 forward).

Section 4.3 and Limitations: 12,000-sample held-out minimal-pair validation set generated with 'OpenAI's GPT-5.1' with parser-based checks; 'the evaluation set does not undergo manual human validation'.
Appendix G, Table 9: ablations include random routing (0.0018), frozen routing (0.0274), load-balancing alpha=0.005 (0.1482), top-k=2 (0.1100), top-k=4 (0.2382) at MI@L5.
Appendix C: full hyperparameters (8 layers, 8 experts, top-k=3, mBERT vocab ~119k, AdamW, 16 epochs) and compute of 'approximately 14-28 GPU-hours per condition'.
Limitations: 'single EN-DE language pair and a single primary sparse architecture'; 'expert intervention experiments (e.g., expert masking or routing interventions) are not included'.
Availability: abstract states 'The official Github repository: Github link' - the link is a placeholder, so code availability cannot be verified from the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic interpretability study of whether MoE routing in a small (86.4M) bilingual EN-DE transformer becomes sensitive to lexical/grammatical/syntactic probe categories, with a curriculum-learning comparison. It matches Interpretability/Probing, MoE/Transformer architecture, and curriculum-learning preferences, and is in scope (not a pure domain application), but touches none of the highest-weight LLM/agent/CoT/Japanese topics. Novelty is genuine: the declarative-procedural lens on router internals and the seed-dependence finding (no-curriculum specialization concentrates on a seed-dependent language; curriculum yields balanced routing) go beyond prior expert-specialization work. Rigor is above average for the scale: permutation tests (p<0.001), bootstrap CIs, conditional MI given language, frequency-binned controls, random/frozen-router, top-k and load-balancing ablations, and two-seed replication, with claims appropriately narrowed after replication. Evidence is solid but bounded: frozen-router baseline retains ~25% of the MI effect (0.0274 vs 0.1148), behaviour metrics are weak (PPL ~111, acc ~29%), the validation set is synthetic (GPT-5.1-generated) without human validation, and per-language magnitudes do not replicate across seeds. Generalizability is limited to one language pair, one small architecture, and synthetic probes, as the Limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters, curriculum schedule, prompts, and compute budget (14-28 GPU-hours/condition) are documented, but the stated official GitHub link is a placeholder in the text and the generation pipeline depends on an external API.

primary_link.title: A Declarative-Procedural Perspective on Expert Routing in Bilingual Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

papers.summary: We investigate whether Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models develop linguistically structured expert routing during bilingual language acquisition. Inspired by the Declarative-Procedural framework, we analyze lexical, grammatical, and syntactic processing in a decoder-only English-German MoE Transformer trained under sequential language exposure. We construct a probe-based validation set and extract token-level routing distributions to quantify category-dependent specialisation using mutual
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 MoE 語言模型在雙語習得時是否發展出語言結構化的專家路由。受陳述—程序框架啟發，作者訓練一個 8 層、8 專家、8,640 萬參數的解碼器式英德 MoE 模型，比較循序 L1–L2 課程與無課程基線（固定 80:20 英德混合）。透過 Stanza 剖析器標註詞彙、文法與句法探針，在 12,000 筆留出驗證樣本上抽取 token 層級路由分布，以互資訊、路由熵與 Jensen–Shannon 距離量化類別依賴的特化。課程模型在第 5 層達峰值互資訊 0.1148，皆顯著高於置換虛無分布；令人意外的是無課程基線聚合特化更強（第 5 層 0.2599）。但第二個訓練種子的複製顯示，無課程條件的特化集中在單一語言，其身分隨種子而定；課程條件則產生穩定、語言平衡的路由剖面。因此課程並非一致提升特化，而是減少單語支配，把初始化的偶然性轉為可預測的跨語言組織。限制包括單一 EN–DE 語言對與單一稀疏架構、驗證集由 LLM 生成且未經人工審核、詞頻與詞類混淆未完全解離。此研究提供檢視 MoE 內部語言組織的機制性視角。

links.title: SysEvolve: An AI-native, safe, autonomous adversarial attack-defense co-evolutionary system

evidence: Abstract & Sec. 1 vs Sec. 7.3: claims 'SysArmor achieves 10-1000x greater precision than HOLMES and UNICORN' and 'detects 6 and 5 real APT attacks in Huawei and Sangfor production deployments', but the evaluation section describes only a one-week deployment at the Third Research Institute of Ministry of Public Security with one APT campaign (Tables 13-14) and contains no precision comparison against HOLMES/UNICORN.

Table 12 (Sec. 7.2.2): XBow evaluation uses a 13-case slice; best SysSpear config scores 10/13 (76.9%) vs Claude Code Opus 4.6 at 9/13 (69.2%) and GLM-5.1 Claude Code at 7/13 (53.8%) - a one-task margin, thinner than the abstract's 'improves attack success by over 25% over baseline LLMs'.

Sec. 7.1.1 (Dataset, Table 5): 'the current data layer contains only three CVE variants; the 50 cases are therefore not statistically independent vulnerability samples'; one recorded trajectory per model-case pair; the L1 interference comparison changes parallelism, 43 decoys, and a topology hint together in fixed order, conceded as 'not a pure decoy effect'.

Sec. 7.1.2 Table 6: DPUAudit-backed collector achieves 0.0% event loss at 2.1% overhead vs Sysdig 98.5% loss, LTTng 60.0% loss, HARDLOG 23.2% and OMNILOG 33.0% overhead - the strongest supported quantitative result, though numbers derive from the cited DPUaudit/NoDrop prior work.

Sec. 7.1.3 Tables 7-8 and Sec. 7.1.4 Table 9: multi-step composition lowers success 18.1-21.6 pp and 7-to-50-node scaling lowers it 9.8-10.6 pp across four models; SysSpear uplift is front-loaded (Target 1: 34/50 vs 19/50; Target 3: 7/50 vs 6/50), supporting the post-compromise bottleneck finding, with authors correctly flagging it as configuration-level rather than causal.

Sec. 5.4 and Sec. 6: SysSpear's verification layer reuses Orax, Eunomia, and SymGx, and SysArmor integrates NodLink, KnowHow, and STAIR - all cited as prior publications, so component novelty is limited to integration and the co-evolution loop (Sec. 3).

Sec. 7.1.1: 'In the reported commercial-LLM trials, no model escaped the isolated range or bypassed the external verification mechanism', explicitly scoped as 'evidence about the tested configurations, not a general proof of containment'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A cybersecurity systems paper whose methodology is genuinely LLM-agent-centric: multi-agent orchestration (Strategy Board, task slicing, context projection, runtime isolation in Sec. 5.2), tool-using attack/defense agents, and LLM-agent capability findings, giving strong fit to Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and Red-Teaming/Evaluation preferences (well above the 0.20 domain-application cap since agent architecture, not just the domain, is the contribution). Novelty is moderate: the co-evolution closed-loop framing is a useful integration, but the Strategy Board is essentially a blackboard architecture, and most components (Orax, Eunomia, SymGx, NodLink, KnowHow, STAIR, DPUaudit, NoDrop, CRADLE) are cited prior systems by overlapping authors (Sec. 5.4, Sec. 6). Rigor practices are unusually self-aware (Table 5 comparison boundaries, external verification, acknowledged confounds), but experiments are weak: one trajectory per model-case (Sec. 7.1.1), a 13-case XBow slice where the headline system wins by a single task (Table 12), and a confounded L1 interference arm the authors admit is 'not a pure decoy effect' (Sec. 7.1.4). Evidence strength is the weakest component: the abstract/intro/conclusion claim '10-1000x greater precision than HOLMES/UNICORN' and production deployments at Huawei and Sangfor with 6 and 5 detected APTs, yet Sec. 7.3 reports only a one-week Ministry of Public Security deployment with one APT campaign and no precision comparison; the claimed '>20% inference efficiency' gain is never evaluated. Generalizability is limited by three CVE variants underlying Stratified-50 (Sec. 7.1.1) and small n, though the stage-progression and observability findings (Tables 7-11) are plausibly transferable. Reproducibility is partial: proprietary 200+ skill library from '30,000+ production machines', commercial model endpoints, closed institutional deployments, and no full-system code release despite a CRADLE homepage and technical-report reference.

primary_link.title: SysEvolve: An AI-native, safe, autonomous adversarial attack-defense co-evolutionary system

papers.summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has created a growing asymmetry in cybersecurity, where attack accelerates toward autonomous execution while defense remains predominantly human-intensive. Despite substantial prior work across cyber ranges, AI-driven attack, and AI-driven defense, this asymmetry persists. We trace it to a deeper root cause, that evolution itself has stalled on both sides at three layers. To overcome this, we propose co-evolution as the integrating insight, w
papers.summary_zh: 本文指出網路安全中攻擊邁向自主執行、防禦仍高度依賴人工的不對稱，其根源在於部署、能力與對抗三層次的演化停滯。作者提出「協同演化」作為整合洞見，並建構三個協同設計的元件：SysField 透過宣告式拓撲驅動建構真實多主機靶場，以隔離與 DPU 卸載達成零損失攻擊軌跡蒐集與可信多層驗證；SysSpear 透過任務切片局部搜尋、Strategy Board 型別化證據圖、逾 200 項專家技能知識庫與靜態分析（SMT 求解、符號執行）驗證，產生高效安全的攻擊方案；SysArmor 透過規則引擎、NodLink 圖異常偵測、KnowHow CTI 語意推理與 STAIR 階段化回應，執行即時可解釋防禦。評估顯示 SysField 以 2.1% 開銷達成零損失蒐集（基線損失 60–98%），並編排 257 個 CVE 成 1,148 個靶場；SysSpear 相較基線 LLM 提升攻擊成功率逾 25%；SysArmor 精確率較 HOLMES 與 UNICORN 高 10–1000 倍，並在華為與深信服生產環境偵測真實 APT 攻擊。評估亦揭示三項 LLM 代理限制：多步組合與更大拓撲暴露能力缺口、瓶頸在初始存取後的狀態利用、誘餌端點使逾時增加三倍。多數比較屬特定協定下的描述性證據，此系統仍為首個實現自主攻防協同演化的完整架構。

papers.title_zh: SysEvolve：AI 原生、安全、自主的攻防對抗協同演化系統

links.title: Incoherent by Design? On the Moral Self-Consistency of LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'contradiction rates reaching up to 78% across scenarios'
§4 Figure 1 and text: '4 Moral Scenarios x 3 Schools of Thought x 3 Variants = 36 prompts... 36 x 3 = 108 evaluations'
§4 Table 3: deontological Scenario 1 reports GPT 0.66, Llama 1, Mistral 0.66 with 'three prompts and thus three response pairs' per scenario cell
§3.4: formalization 'executed using a hybrid pipeline of Gemini-driven agents [41] and human annotation'
§3.2 footnote 1: 'The code and the example files for model deployment are available at: https://osf.io/3sdeu/' with models 'deployed locally... in a zero-shot setting'
§5 Limitations: 'a small number of moral scenarios', 'Logical Representation Abstraction... may introduce loss of nuance', 'Framework Operationalization... approximate'
§2 Related Work: acknowledges prior consistency measurement via '[22]... Semantic Graph Entropy' and '[10]' while positioning the gap as consistency 'within a specific ethical stance'

§B.2.1 Consistency Analysis: relies on assumptions like 'Conceptually and practically within this scenario, PC ≡ PD' and merging modal systems across prompts, illustrating interpretive contradiction criteria
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-evaluation paper squarely within preferred topics: it probes GPT-OSS-20B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct for intra-framework moral self-consistency, connecting LLM reasoning reliability to alignment (§1, §5). Preference relevance is strong (LLMs, reasoning, AI safety/alignment, evaluation, prompting), though it is an analysis/audit paper rather than a method contribution. Novelty is modest: consistency-under-paraphrase and moral-inconsistency measurement exist in prior work the authors themselves cite ([10], [22]); the claimed deltas are the within-single-school focus and a modal-logic formalization. Rigor and evidence are the weak points: the entire corpus is 4 hand-written scenarios x 3 stances x 3 prompt variants = 36 prompts (§4, Fig. 1), with only three pairwise comparisons per cell, so headline numbers like 0.78 contradiction rate (Table 3) rest on n=3 pairs with no statistics, baselines, or human-consistency reference. The logic conversion uses 'a hybrid pipeline of Gemini-driven agents and human annotation' (§3.4), an LLM-in-the-loop formalization with unstated guidelines/agreement, and several claimed 'contradictions' are interpretive (e.g., equating hedged responses with strict obligations; assuming PC≡PD in §B.2.1). Prompt variants also embed genuinely different duties (truth-telling vs. protection in §4.1), so disagreement is not purely inconsistency. The limitations section candidly concedes scenario coverage, prompt-cue, and formalization-abstraction issues (§5). Generalizability is limited by scenario count, approximate stance operationalization, and 7B-20B models only. Reproducibility is partially supported: open-weight models run locally zero-shot with code/examples on OSF (§3.2 fn.1) and full prompts/responses/logic in appendices, but the Gemini-agent formalization protocol and decoding settings are unspecified. Overall: a relevant but small-scale, subjectively formalized audit whose evidence is illustrative rather than statistically robust.

primary_link.title: Incoherent by Design? On the Moral Self-Consistency of LLMs

papers.summary: LLMs are increasingly used in morally sensitive contexts, yet it is unclear whether they apply ethical principles consistently across situations. A model that can state a moral principle may still violate it when the same scenario is rephrased or reframed. This inconsistency is a problem for any system whose outputs are used to inform moral decisions. If generative systems exhibit internal inconsistency, then the epistemic integrity of AI-mediated systems becomes uncertain. To study this concern
papers.summary_zh: LLM 日益用於道德敏感情境，但能否跨情境一致套用倫理原則仍未明。本文研究 LLM 在同一倫理立場內的推理穩定性：作者針對義務論、效益論與德性倫理三個哲學流派，建構底層情境固定、僅框架與措辭變化的道德等價提示集，涵蓋真實與後果、公平與效率、情感動機與冷靜推理等張力，再將 Mistral-7B、GPT-OSS-20B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 的輸出轉換為模態邏輯語句，於同流派內進行成對矛盾檢測。結果顯示矛盾率從近零到高達 78%，即使在情境與立場皆不變、僅措辭輕微改變時，模型也無法可靠維持規範承諾，例如對說謊的道德評價隨框架不同而相互矛盾。這種內部不穩定對 AI 對齊構成基礎性挑戰：若系統無法一致重現自身的規範承諾，對齊便成為移動的目標，作者主張內部連貫性應是對齊的前提而非結果。限制包括道德情境數量少、提示建構可能引入非預期線索、邏輯形式化損失細微差異、成對比較無法捕捉隱性不連貫、框架操作化僅近似的哲學立場，且僅評估單輪而非對話鏈。此研究提供框架內一致性的控制式評估方法，凸顯一致性感知對齊研究的必要性。
papers.title: Incoherent by Design? On the Moral Self-Consistency of LLMs
papers.title_zh: 設計上就不一致？論大型語言模型的道德自我一致性

links.title: Hierarchical Agentic Incident Response with Digital-Twin-Validated Attack Inference

evidence: Abstract: framework integrates 'LLM-based attack inference, rollout planning, and digital-twin validation' and 'outperforms frontier-LLM baselines in recovery success rate by 18-31%'
Section IV-A: offline LoRA fine-tuning of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B 'on an open-source corpus of approximately 68,000 security incidents ... as in the previous work [19]'

Section V-A: 'The training-data construction, fine-tuning procedure, and standalone evaluation ... are reported in our previous work [19]; hence, we do not repeat the model-level evaluation here'; testbed 'approximately 33 interconnected components ... adapted from [20]' on one A100 GPU
Table II: calibration ablation, e.g., CVE_2010_0426_PRIV_ESC accuracy improves 15%->65% post-calibration; Section IV-B: 'we allow one revision'

Table IV: success rates 90/88/86% (ours) vs 72/66-67/59-60% (GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Claude Opus 4.8); Section V-C reports gains of '18, 21, and 26 percentage points' versus the abstract's 18-31% claim

Section IV-D: candidate actions failing digital-twin validation get infinite cost; 'If every candidate has infinite cost, no operational action is committed' - success depends on this gating mechanism
No code/data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper; execution agent uses 'Qwen3.6-27B' (Section IV) with no sourcing details
llm_evaluation.rationale: Agentic-LLM incident-response system combining fine-tuned local LLM agents (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B with LoRA), decision-theoretic rollout planning, and digital-twin validation. Strongly matches the Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences and is not in the excluded pure-domain categories, though it is a domain-specific security application. Novelty is moderate: the core fine-tuning data/procedure and model evaluation are imported from the authors' prior work [19], with the digital-twin calibration loop and hierarchical integration as the main additions. Rigor is mixed: a formal factorized POMDP is given and calibration is ablated (Table II), but evaluation covers only one 33-component testbed and three scenarios, success rates lack trial counts or confidence intervals, and no ablation of tactical rollout vs. simple prioritization is provided. Evidence is concrete (Tables II-IV with mean±std times) but contains an internal inconsistency: the abstract/conclusion claim 18-31 pp gains while Table IV and Section V-C support only 18/21/26 pp against the strongest baseline (31 pp arises only against the weakest expert-scenario baseline), and '18-31%' conflates percentage points with percent. Generalizability is limited to network-defense settings on a single adapted testbed. Reproducibility is partial: a local open-weight model and an open testbed platform (CSLE) are referenced, but training details and model-level evaluation are deferred to [19], baseline prompts/settings are unspecified, and no code or data release is stated.

Decision-theoretic planners provide principled optimization but typically rely on abstract states and predefined actions, while large language model (LLM) agents can reason over operational context but may hallucinate attacks and responses. Toward automating response planning, we present a hierarchical
papers.summary_zh: 網路事件回應緩慢且費力：決策理論規劃器依賴抽象狀態與預定義動作，LLM 代理雖能推理情境卻可能產生幻覺。本文提出整合 LLM 攻擊推論、滾動規劃與數位孿生驗證的階層式回應框架。經 LoRA fine-tuning 的輕量模型 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B 從系統情境與 IDS 觀測推斷多階段攻擊序列與受影響主機；網路數位孿生重放推斷的攻擊，回傳可觀測效應差異以校準推論；戰術層以滾動式前瞻規劃依信念優先排序受影響元件；作業層由規劃代理提出高階復原動作，執行代理將其轉為復原與驗證命令，候選動作以蒙地卡羅估計的孿生驗證復原成本選取。在 33 元件、多子網企業網路測試環境的三個多階段攻擊情境中，復原成功率分別為 90%、88%、86%，較 GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.1-Pro 與 Claude Opus 4.8 等前沿基線高出 18–31 個百分點，且各情境作業執行時間最短；代理通常每元件提交六個高階動作，對應六個復原階段。限制包括單一測試環境與三種情境、規劃時間較長（約 80–107 分鐘）、訓練資料來自公開語料。此研究展示決策理論最佳化與 LLM 生成結合的可行架構，對自主網路防禦具參考價值。

links.title: SCOPE: Score-Isolated Agentic Optimization for Video World Models

evidence: Abstract: 'SCOPE improves over the exact frozen base by +14.24 (95% CI [+8.10, +21.23])' on Physics-IQ, 'while the margin over the strongest matched agentic baseline remains unresolved'.

Section 4.2, Table 1: 'The SCOPE–Qwen differences are +2.07 on Wan (CI [-0.27, +6.14]) and +0.52 on CogVideoX (CI [-0.39, +1.65]), and remain unresolved on both backbones'; uniform random 3-candidate selector already reaches +6.71/+7.65 over Base.

Section 4.5, Table 4: 'On fresh Physics-IQ tasks, neither the comparison with Base nor that with the frozen router establishes a clear improvement'; 'PhyGround exposes a different failure mode: only 4/32 tasks produce a valid proposal, below the predeclared minimum coverage of 8/32'.

Section 4.6, Table 5: 'Typed update vs. random update -0.32 [-5.98, +5.15]' and 'Removing the Base fallback produces a clear degradation -0.773 [-1.471, -0.203]'; all three tool-use contrasts statistically unresolved.

Section 4.4: 'All four confidence intervals include zero, so these contrasts remain statistically unresolved' on OpenS2V-Eval; P-AI shared-global effect reverses from +0.80 on Wan to -2.41 on CogVideoX.

Section 5 Limitations: 'selection errors and insufficient proposal coverage limit performance on unseen tasks' and 'Updates that improve one configuration can have smaller effects, or even reverse direction, under another backbone.'

Abstract/Appendix C: 'Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/SCOPE' and 'All reported results are linked to the scripts and machine-readable outputs used to generate the corresponding tables and figures.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic inference-time adaptation framework (typed control state, score-isolated update rule, provenance hashes, Base fallback) applied to frozen video world models. It touches Agents & Tool Use, LLM-as-judge/proposer components, and evaluation methodology, so it avoids the out-of-scope cap for pure video diffusion, but the LLM/agent machinery is instrumental to a video-generation objective, limiting preference relevance. Rigor is a strength: predeclared primary contrasts, paired bootstrap CIs, matched baselines, honest unresolved margins, and genuinely negative prospective results are reported rather than hidden. However, the headline +14.24 gain is only over the exact Frozen Base; the margin over the strongest matched agentic baseline is unresolved (Section 4.2), a uniform random 3-candidate selector already gains +6.71, and a fixed GPT-5.4 physics card alone gains +9.33, so the framework's added value is weakly isolated. Prospective and cross-backbone evaluations (Sections 4.3-4.5, Appendix A) mostly fail or reverse sign, which the paper concedes, capping generalizability. Novelty is moderate: the score-isolation proposition is near-definitional, but the disciplined framing (proposal/commit/deploy/evaluate separation with provenance binding) is a fresh contribution to agentic harness evaluation.

primary_link.title: SCOPE: Score-Isolated Agentic Optimization for Video World Models

papers.summary: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators for planning and embodied decision making, yet improving them at inference time introduces a subtle evaluation problem: prompts, samplers, verifiers, and selectors may evolve together, making it difficult to attribute gains or prevent held-out feedback from shaping the final policy. We introduce \scope (\emph{\scopefullname}), a framework for auditable inference-time adaptation of frozen video world models. \scope represents external control
papers.summary_zh: 影片世界模型日益用於規劃與具身決策模擬，但推論時改善面臨微妙的評估問題：提示、取樣器、驗證器與選擇器可能共同演化，難以歸因增益，留出回饋若被重用來選擇控制，系統會適應評估本身。作者提出 SCOPE 框架，將外部推論控制表示為型別化狀態（文字、取樣、驗證、獎勵四軸），僅接受有預先宣告開發目標與防護閘支持的有界更新，並在留出評估前凍結部署路徑（含精確 Frozen Base 後備），以 SHA-256 雜湊綁定來源實現可稽核性。在 40 場景 Physics-IQ 協定上，SCOPE 相較精確凍結基礎模型改善 +14.24（95% CI [+8.10, +21.23]）；但相對最強匹配代理基線（Qwen-Image-Agent 風格）的 +2.07 差距未定。消融確認場景規格（SceneLang）、取樣與學習式選擇各有增益，但型別化更新不優於等預算隨機更新。跨骨幹（Wan2.2、CogVideoX）與 P-AI、OpenS2V-Eval、前瞻評估顯示增益無法跨模型與設定一致轉移，方向甚至反轉，PhyGround 提案覆蓋率也未達門檻。此研究把推論時調適視為受控最佳化問題，強調可靠選擇機制與更好提案同等重要。

links.title: BioFirewall: A genome-writing-native governance layer for design-stage biosecurity screening of agentic AI

evidence: Abstract (p.1-2): cargo classifier TPR 0.72 (95% CI 0.43-0.89) at 1% FPR; LLM judges unreliable; open-weight judges flipped block-to-allow in 3 and 5 of 6 trials per channel; 0/288 legitimate plans refused with Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 0.0103.

Analyses 'Language-model judges do not reliably screen a biological sequence' (p.9-10): five-model panel TPRs 0.01-0.78, Opus/Sonnet refuse 45-47% of sequences; none reaches the deterministic gate's operating point.
Analyses 'A certified ceiling on the false-refuse rate' (p.12): 0.0103 upper bound on 288 template-generated plans; competence-conditioned accuracy monotone 1.00 (n=248) > 0.69 (n=490) > 0.10 (n=10).

Analyses 'Outcome validation of the locus axis' (p.13-14): held-out, list-de-circularized AUROC 0.605 (0.596-0.614), OR 3.34 (3.07-3.65), n=3,625; VISDB null AUROC 0.449 reconciled as virus-biology confounding (Figure 4c, p.38).

Table 3 (p.40-42): pre-registered claim ledger; three upgrades documented as nulls, including Neyman-Pearson power gap -0.040 (-0.067 to -0.015) and DANN head 0.539 vs composition shortcut 0.562 at 1% FPR.

Additional File 1 section 2.4-2.5 (p.46-48): 46 single-call attacks, 0 flips, framed as architectural property of structured-field decision; section 4.3 (p.53): decomposition catch 1.00 [1.00,1.00] on 60 attacks/category with 0 FP at seed 1234 and seed-sweep FP of 1/60 for fragment_assembly (p.57).

Additional File 2 section 6 and 9.2 (p.69-72): frontier 0/22 injection result is prose-only without committed data; injection intervals rest on n=6 per channel; June panel retained no raw transcripts.
Table 5 (p.43): NTI guardrail coverage with qualifications - pluggable credentialing hook, development-key passport, session monitor 'necessary but not sufficient'.
Availability sections (p.26-27) and Table 4 (p.42): Apache-2.0, GitHub/Zenodo, pinned container; 165/2 test suite; locus validation recomputed deterministically at seed 1234.

Discussion limitations (p.20-21): safe proxies only, mouse gene-level validation, no wet-lab or human clonal-outcome validation, single-group computational validation, not deployed or adopted elsewhere.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A biosecurity middleware for genome-writing plans, not an LLM methodology paper: LLMs (Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama) appear only as evaluated judges/baselines, and the core artifact is a deterministic five-axis rule screen with ESM-2 embeddings and conformal bounds. It nonetheless has genuine agent-safety and AI-safety content (prompt-injection flip measurement of LLM judges, cross-call decomposition attacks, trajectory-level monitoring, a reusable red-team corpus), which keeps it above the pure-domain-application cap but well short of core preference topics. Research quality is unusually high: SHA-locked pre-registrations, de-circularized outcome validation against independent oracles, honest documentation of three missed pre-registered upgrades, matched benign controls, and an audit file that lists its own unverifiable items. Main deductions: domain-bounded validation with safe proxies, mouse/gene-level outcome evidence, n=6-per-channel injection trials and a prose-only frontier 0/22 result, and no deployment.

primary_link.title: BioFirewall: A genome-writing-native governance layer for design-stage biosecurity screening of agentic AI

papers.summary:
Background. Artificial-intelligence design tools now plan genome-scale edits, and agentic systems execute those plans with progressively less human oversight. Biosecurity controls are limited to two points: refusal guardrails at the foundation model and sequence-identity screening at the synthesiser. The design stage between them, where the plan is specified, remains governed by recommendations rather than any deployed system.
  Results. We present BioFirewall, a rule-governed middleware that in
papers.summary_zh: AI 設計工具已能規劃基因體尺度編輯，代理系統以漸少的人類監督執行計畫，但生物安全控制僅涵蓋模型層拒答與合成器序列比對兩個節點，設計階段仍由建議而非已部署系統治理。作者提出 BioFirewall，以規則治理中介層攔截基因體書寫計畫，沿貨物、基因座、編輯類型、生殖系與規模五個危害軸回傳允許、標記審查或拒絕，附引用證據、HMAC 簽章設計護照、雜湊鏈稽核日誌與分層存取。在去環化基準上，功能感知 ESM-2 貨物分類器在 1% 偽陽性率下達 0.72 真陽性率，而五個前沿與開源語言模型評審無法可靠篩檢序列（過度拒答、過度標記或幾乎不攔截）；提示注入使開源評審在 50–83% 的實驗中從阻擋翻轉為允許，確定性篩檢則依建構不變。288 個合法計畫無一被拒，偽拒絕率的 95% 上界為 0.0103，此有限樣本認證是語言模型評審無法提供的保證。基因座軸在去環化留出基因集上對體內插入致癌驅動因子顯著富集（AUROC 0.605、OR 3.34），會話監控以 100% 攔截率捕捉跨呼叫分解攻擊。限制包括僅用安全代理、驗證止於小鼠與基因層級、存取控制憑證鉤子僅為可插拔機制、未經生產部署。此為 NTI 設計階段護欄組的首個已建構參考實作，以開源與預註冊方式釋出。

links.title: Collective Communication for Distributed LLM Systems: Planning, Runtime Adaptation, and Computation Coordination

evidence: Abstract: 'We organize recent advances into three layers: communication planning... communication execution and adaptation... and computation-communication coordination.'
Section I: 'collective communication accounts for 22%∼47% of end-to-end iteration time' on a DGX-H100 cluster training GPT-3 and Llama-2 with TP, motivating the survey.

Table I: reports only cited speedups (e.g., SCCL 'Up to 2.2x AG speedup over NCCL', MegaScale-Infer 'Up to 1.90x per-GPU decoding-throughput improvement over TensorRT-LLM'), all from prior systems, with no new experiments.

Section III: 'This paper aims to provide a tutorial map rather than an exhaustive bibliography... we select only a few representative works for each direction'; the References section contains only 17 entries.
Section V-A/VI-A: limitations are acknowledged, e.g., MSCCL++ 'still limited to inference workloads' and CoCoNet 'fusion can even reduce performance for small tensors.'

Section VII: enumerates six open challenges (adaptive collectives, unified communication library, portable communication, compression-aware collectives, communication offloading, fault tolerance) without quantitative support.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A tutorial-style survey on collective communication (AR/RS/AG/A2A) in distributed LLM training and serving. Topically it aligns with the LLM preference (weight 2.5) and secondarily with scaling/efficiency and inference/serving, but it contributes no language-modeling methodology itself. Its three-layer taxonomy (planning; execution/adaptation; computation-communication coordination) is a coherent organizational contribution, yet as a survey it has limited technical novelty. Rigor is moderate: the taxonomy is clearly motivated and per-system limitations are discussed (e.g., MSCCL++ limited to inference; AutoCCL unstable under varying patterns), but coverage is explicitly non-systematic and very thin (~17 references), omitting major overlap and in-network-aggregation literature by its own admission. Evidence strength rests entirely on attributed secondhand speedups in Table I (e.g., Themis 1.25–1.49x, NanoFlow 1.91x over TensorRT-LLM); no independent experiments are run. The taxonomy and open challenges generalize well across LLM clusters, but reproducibility is low: no artifacts, benchmarks, or selection protocol are provided. Calibrated weighted score: 0.54.

primary_link.title: Collective Communication for Distributed LLM Systems: Planning, Runtime Adaptation, and Computation Coordination

papers.summary: Distributed large language model (LLM) systems increasingly rely on collective communication primitives such as AllReduce (AR), ReduceScatter (RS), AllGather (AG), and AlltoAll (A2A). In modern LLM training and serving clusters, heterogeneous GPU interconnects, multi-NIC networking, mixed parallelism strategies, low-latency inference requests, and high-throughput training pipelines have motivated increasingly diverse ways to plan, execute, and overlap collective communication. This paper present
papers.summary_zh: 分散式 LLM 系統大量依賴 AllReduce、ReduceScatter、AllGather 與 AlltoAll 等集合通訊原語，異質 GPU 互連、混合並行與低延遲服務使其最佳化日益複雜。本文為教學式縱覽，提出以集合為中心的三層分類法：通訊規劃層產生拓撲感知的集合排程，如 BlueConnect 將 AllReduce 分解為階層式 RS/AG 以避開慢速鏈路、SCCL 與 TE-CCL 分別以約束求解與多商品流自動合成排程；通訊執行與調適層將排程映射到真實叢集，如 MSCCL++ 提供可程式化 GPU 通訊堆疊、AutoCCL 於訓練早期線上調校 NCCL 設定、MCCS 以供應商服務形式協調多租戶通訊；運算—通訊協調層將集合最佳化轉為端對端效益，如 CoCoNet 以 DSL 統一描述運算與通訊並自動融合、Centauri 針對 DP/FSDP/TP/PP 混合訓練分割通訊以擴大重疊機會、MegaScale-Infer 與 NanoFlow 分別以乒乓管線與奈米批次處理 MoE 推論通訊。文章並梳理動態工作負載下的自適應集合、統一通訊函式庫、異質硬體可攜性、壓縮感知通訊、通訊卸載與容錯等開放挑戰。此縱覽為 LLM 訓練與服務中的通訊最佳化提供系統性地圖與研究路線。

links.title: Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?

evidence: Abstract: HexRoPE reduces exact-belief posterior CE by 0.278 on D6-transformed test orbits and 0.329 on a larger map vs no encoding; both hierarchical-bootstrap CIs exclude zero and Holm-adjusted p<0.001.
Abstract and Section 5.4: aggregate win-rate paired effect of HexRoPE over None is -1.56 points with 95% CI [-4.50, 1.17], i.e., a transparently reported negative closed-loop result.

Section 4 (Models and Protocol): hierarchical paired bootstrap resamples training seeds then paired games/episodes with 5,000 replicates; Holm correction applied to the preregistered HexRoPE-None and HexRoPE-RectRel families; graph-bias and gameplay comparisons marked exploratory.

Section 3.2-3.3: probe splits assigned by D6 orbit so transformed copies cannot cross train/test boundaries; exact posteriors computed by enumeration and every posterior checked to sum to one, isolating belief tracking from imitation labels.
Section 5.2-5.3: RectRel catastrophically fails radius-4 extrapolation (CE 11.008) while HexRoPE imitation gains shrink from +4.63pp at 1k games to +1.55pp at 10k games, with CIs reported for each.

Section 7 (Limitations): benchmark uses one game and small hex maps limiting external validity; only three training seeds for policy/gameplay; imitation labels come from a pool of state-machine, evolved, scripted, and random policies, not expert demonstrations.

Section 8 (Reproducibility): dataset SHA-256 prefix b3927015cab6d7df, per-split manifests with episode/map identifiers and hashes, named entry-point scripts (e.g., run_paper1_belief_matrix.py, run_paper1_gameplay_matrix.py), and per-game/per-episode JSON outputs.
Section 1 (Contributions): authors state 'we do not claim to invent HexRoPE'; contribution is the four-level benchmark and the empirical separation of geometry, belief, imitation, and play.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Methodologically strong empirical study, weakly aligned to the LLM-centric preference profile. Topic relevance is partial: it squarely hits Transformer-architecture interests (positional encodings, RoPE variants, attention biases) and touches policy learning, but contains no LLM, language, reasoning-prompting, or agent content, so the highest-weighted preferences are unmet. Novelty is moderate and honestly framed: the authors explicitly disclaim inventing HexRoPE; the contribution is a four-level benchmark plus an empirical boundary result. Rigor is high: exact-Bayes labels by enumeration with probability-integrity checks, D6-orbit splits preventing leakage, preregistered Holm-corrected families, hierarchical paired bootstrap with 5,000 replicates over seeds then games, and gameplay explicitly labeled exploratory. Evidence strength is good: CIs and effect sizes are reported, including the honest negative that HexRoPE does not improve win rate (CI crosses zero), though only three seeds back the expensive policy/gameplay levels and results come from one small game, limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is excellent: dataset hashes, split manifests, named entry-point scripts, fixed seeds, and per-game JSON artifacts.

primary_link.title: Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?

papers.summary: Transformers applied to spatial imperfect-information games must represent map geometry while tracking hidden entities through time. We ask whether geometry-aware positional encodings improve these capabilities, without claiming a new positional encoding. We construct a four-level benchmark on a hexagonal naval pursuit game: controlled geometry and topology probes, an exact-Bayes hidden-target tracking task, offline policy imitation at 1k and 10k games, and 7,200 fixed-seed games against three l
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討幾何感知位置編碼能否協助 Transformer 在空間不完全資訊遊戲中同時表示地圖幾何並追蹤隱藏目標。作者以改編自棋盤戰棋《Sink the Bismarck!》的六角海軍追擊遊戲建立四層基準:幾何與拓撲探針、以精確貝氏枚舉計算標籤的隱藏目標信念追蹤、1k 與 10k 局的離線策略模仿,以及 7,200 場固定種子對戰,比較無位置編碼、RectRel、AxialRoPE、HexRoPE 與 HexRoPE+Graph 五種設定。結果顯示 HexRoPE 在 D6 轉換測試軌道與較大地圖上分別將精確信念後驗交叉熵降低 0.278 與 0.329,信賴區間排除零且 Holm 校正後 p<0.001;1k 局低資料情境下,動作準確率比無編碼高 4.63 個百分點、比 RectRel 高 2.05 點,但 10k 局時優勢縮小至 1.55 與 0.41;封閉迴圈勝率則未獲改善(HexRoPE 減無編碼為 -1.56 點,區間跨零)。RectRel 雖在 D6 一致性上最佳,卻在半徑 3 外推至 4 時災難性失敗(CE 11.008)。限制包括僅單一遊戲、小地圖、標籤來自舊版 AI 而非人類專家,且僅三個訓練種子。本文的核心貢獻是分離表示、信念、模仿與實際對弈四個層次,證明幾何歸納偏置能改善信念估計與低資料模仿,但不必然轉化為更強的實戰表現。
papers.title: Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?

links.title: CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations

evidence: Abstract and Section 3.1: human study yields 900 image-comparison items and 2700 judgments over CUB-200, ImageNet-100, Places365, comparing LF-CBM, VLG-CBM, CBM-Suite with 3 annotators per item.
Section 4, Table 3: 1–9 score-sum council reaches 70.7% overall strict ranking recovery vs. stated 50% chance reference; Table 5 reports 83.3% on unanimously agreed items.
Section 4, Table 7: swapping explanation positions changes the judge's answer in 17.2–33.2% of comparisons, motivating independent score-based judging as the main protocol.

Section 4, Table 6: CaBM ranks first on CUB-200 and ImageNet-100; ref [1] (Cagliyan, Ozdemir, Akbas) shares authors with this paper, and CaBM/V2C-CBM scores were not validated against human preferences (Section 4 states they are evaluated only 'where their explanations are available').
Section 6 (Limitations): authors acknowledge coverage of only three datasets, three CBMs, 300 images, relative-preference measurement, and judge-specific findings.
Appendix 0.B: complete score-based and pairwise prompt templates with greedy decoding, supporting reproducibility; GitHub link claimed in Abstract but contents unverifiable from text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An evaluation-methodology paper using an MLLM council (five open-weight judges) to score Concept Bottleneck Model explanations, validated by a 2700-judgment human preference study. It is not pure computer vision since the core contribution is an LLM-as-judge protocol (independent scoring vs. pairwise prompting, council aggregation, position-bias ablation), aligning with interpretability/evaluation/MLLM preferences, though the target domain is vision XAI rather than core LLM research. Strengths: proper chance baselines (50% strict, 34.9% weak-ranking), a position-bias diagnostic motivating the design, full prompt templates and greedy decoding, and an honest limitations section. Weaknesses: small scale (300 images, 3 CBMs, 3 student annotators per item), no significance tests or confidence intervals, judge/council selection tuned on the same human data used for headline alignment numbers, and an undisclosed conflict of interest — the top-ranked CaBM on the new leaderboard (Table 6) is authored by an overlapping author group (ref [1]: Cagliyan, Ozdemir, Akbas) and was never validated against humans. Novelty is moderate: the jury-of-judges idea follows PoLL and MT-Bench, applied here to a new niche. A competent but incremental benchmark paper with partial preference fit.

primary_link.title: CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations

papers.summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to make visual classification interpretable by expressing predictions through human-understandable concepts. Although interpretability is the central motivation for CBMs, they are still largely evaluated as predictive models by downstream classification accuracy, supplemented by isolated qualitative examples. This highlights a pressing need for quantitative measures, a challenge complicated by the infeasibility of ground-truth concept annotation at s
papers.summary_zh: 概念瓶頸模型(CBM)透過人類可理解的概念路由預測以提升可解釋性,但現有評估多仰賴下游分類準確率與零散的質性範例,缺乏人類對齊且可擴充的解釋品質量化基準。本文先以人類偏好研究建立參考標準:在 CUB-200、ImageNet-100 與 Places365 上,針對 LF-CBM、VLG-CBM 與 CBM-Suite 的 900 個圖像比較項目收集 2,700 筆評判,標註者比較兩個匿名化解釋並可標記同優或同劣。接著評估五個開放權重多模態大型語言模型(InternVL3.5-8B、Qwen3.5-4B/9B、Gemma4-E2B/E4B)擔任評審,發現以 1–9 獨立評分再彙整分數總和的五評審委員會最對齊人類:在嚴格偏好上恢復 70.7% 的人類排序,在人類全數一致的項目上達 83.3%。直接成對提示則受位置偏差困擾,交換選項順序後 17.2% 至 33.2% 的比較改變偏好,故僅列為消融。以此委員會為固定計分協定,作者推出公開基準 CBX-Bench,給予各 CBM 正規化解釋品質分數與資料集層級排名;排名與準確率明顯分歧,如 CaBM 在兩資料集居首但準確率僅列第三。限制為僅涵蓋三資料集、300 張圖像,衡量的是相對偏好而非解釋的絕對充分性,且結論依賴所測評審與提示設計。此工作將 CBM 解釋品質轉為可量測、可審計的基準目標。

links.title: Inferring 1-Minimal Trigger Configurations for Assessing Linux Kernel CVE Triggerability

evidence: Sec. 5.4: 'We use OpenAI GPT-5.1 (snapshot: gpt-5.1-2025-11-13) with temperature 0. The model is invoked for Stage I candidate identification, Stage II constraint parsing, and Stage III trigger-evidence matching' with JSON schema/regex checks and logged prompts/responses.
Sec. 6.2: 'the configuration success rate improves from 62.5% (55/88) to 96.6% (85/88)' versus the olddef-only baseline, with 3 residual failures attributed to arch/hardware constraints.
Table 1 (Sec. 6.1): FCC Avg |C| 14.72 (471) vs KernJC 69.00 (2208) on the KernJC dataset; 94.6% vs 89.3% coverage with 27.51 vs 201.76 options on KernelCTF.
Sec. 6.3 / Table 2: minimization reduces 14.72 to 1.63 options per CVE (88.93% reduction) and all 32 minimized configurations preserve matched trigger evidence under the protocol.

Sec. 6.1: KernJC-start minimization control reruns make olddefconfig, rebuild/boot, and PoC execution confirming the same trigger-preserving boundary for 32 CVEs, mitigating self-referential ground truth.
Sec. 8 (Threats to Validity): acknowledges upstream-only validation, arch/hardware limits, oracle flakiness (t=5, tau=1), and exclusion of 34 defconfig-trivial CVEs.
Sec. 11 (Data Availability): 'All experimental data and source code used in this paper are available at https://github.com/Cyber-wei10/FCC' with a Zenodo-archived artifact.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid systems-security/SE paper (Linux kernel CVE trigger-configuration inference) in which the LLM is an instrumental, tightly gated component (Stage I candidate identification, Stage II constraint parsing, Stage III evidence matching), with all outputs validated by deterministic make olddefconfig/Kbuild checks (Sec. 4.2, 5.4). Relevance to LLM-centric preferences is moderate: it matches Code & Programming (debugging, vulnerability reproduction) and structured-output/LLM-pipeline practice, but the methodological contribution lies in Kconfig constraint handling and runtime-validated 1-minimal pruning, not language modeling. Novelty is moderate: the task formalization and olddefconfig-effectiveness repair go beyond KernJC's static dependency expansion (Sec. 1, 2.1), but the pipeline is an engineering combination of prompting, constraint parsing, and delta-debugging-style minimization. Rigor is strong for a systems paper: two datasets (88 CVEs, Sec. 5.1), two baselines, a KernJC-start minimization control against circular ground truth (Sec. 6.1), oracle-reliability measurement (Sec. 6.3), symbol-level error analysis (Table 3), and a threats-to-validity section (Sec. 8); deductions for a single LLM, no significance testing, and benchmark ground truth partly self-derived. Evidence is concrete and verifiable (62.5%->96.6% success, 69.00->14.72->1.63 options; Sec. 6.2, 6.3) but limited to the authors' upstream QEMU/KVM setting with x86 constraints and excluded defconfig-trivial cases (Sec. 5.1, 8). Generalizability beyond Linux/upstream kernels is explicitly limited (Sec. 7.1, 8). Reproducibility is good: released code/data with Zenodo artifact, fixed model snapshot gpt-5.1-2025-11-13 at temperature 0, logged prompts and cached snapshots, explicit timeouts/iteration limits (Sec. 5.4, 11).

primary_link.title: Inferring 1-Minimal Trigger Configurations for Assessing Linux Kernel CVE Triggerability

papers.summary: Vendors assessing Linux kernel CVEs need to know whether a bug is triggerable under production-tailored configurations, not merely whether a version is affected, yet upstream reproducers and vulnerability databases rarely provide configuration-level context. We study minimal trigger-configuration inference: given a CVE entry and a target kernel version (optionally a baseline .config), we synthesize a Kconfig-satisfiable option set that remains effective after make olddefconfig and, when a reprod
papers.summary_zh: 廠商評估 Linux 核心 CVE 時,關鍵不在版本是否受影響,而在生產環境量身訂做的核心配置下漏洞是否可被觸發;然而上游重現工具與漏洞資料庫鮮少提供配置層級脈絡,且寫入 .config 的選項可能在 make olddefconfig 後因前置條件未滿足而被靜默回退。本文提出 FCC 框架,分三階段:第一階段以 LLM 分析 NVD 描述、CWE 與外部參考,抽取語意與建置線索並對映到 Kconfig 與 Makefile 符號,產生候選集;第二階段在 olddefconfig 回饋下補全依賴,處理 depends on、select 致能路徑與條件式脈絡,確保關鍵選項在最終配置持續生效;第三階段以依賴拓撲引導執行期驗證最小化,在錯誤簽章比對一致的觸發證據下收斂到 1-最小邊界。在 88 個 CVE(32 個 KernJC、56 個 KernelCTF)上,FCC 將 olddefconfig 後配置成功率從基線的 62.5% 提升至 96.6%,KernJC 集候選集平均自 69.00 個選項降至 14.72,再經最小化至平均 1.63 個選項(縮減 88.93%)且保留觸發證據。LLM 僅用於候選識別、約束解析與證據比對,所有選項均經確定性驗證。限制包括僅在上游核心與 QEMU/KVM 環境驗證,三個失敗案例源於跨架構或硬體限制,套用到下游發行版核心仍需額外調整。對廠商而言,可審計的最小配置邊界提供明確的觸發性決策線。

links.title: LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts

evidence: Abstract: 'agentic PDEVS-LLM framework ... generates and verifying PDEVS statecharts' with 'controlled-correction mechanism ... using propositional logic entailment'.

Section 5 (Experimental Setup): lists eight base models (Llama-3.1-8b through Claude-opus-4.1, GPT-4o-mini), temperature 0.3, thresholds m=n=3, z3-solver, and GPT-4-0125-preview at temperature 0.7 for statechart generation.

Section 6.1, Table 6: model checking before/after verification across 8 LLMs; e.g., Llama-3.1-8b deadlocks 5→2, while 'Mistral-7b-instruct ... displaying the increment in number of deadlock failures (2 in BV, 3 in AV)'.

Section 6.2, Table 8: Statechart Correctness Scores BV vs AV per model; 'Claude-opus-4.1 ... 1.0000' post-verification; smaller models show external-transition decline (e.g., Llama-3.1-8b 0.9434→0.8809).
Section 6.2: correctness is scored by 'a domain expert ... tasked to manually collect the information' with 0/1 answers — single-rater, subjective evaluation.
Section 7 (Limitations): admits LLM-based NL-to-propositional-logic translation is unreliable and that propositional logic is atemporal, so 'no significant improvement in the time advance'.
Section 4: 'The code and test cases to replicate the experiments in this paper are available at GitHub Repository' — claimed but no concrete URL provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper (not a pure domain application) centered on an agentic LLM framework with structured-output prompting and a SAT/entailment-based controlled-correction loop for generating PDEVS statecharts, matching LLM/Agents/Prompting preferences, though the DEVS simulation niche limits breadth. Novelty is incremental: verification-based iterative refinement builds on the authors' prior PDEVS-LLM work and known self-correction/verification paradigms (RCI, ProCo), with the propositional-entailment twist being modest. Rigor is moderate: 14 curated systems (8 for correctness scoring), 8 LLMs, model checking in UPPAAL, and honest negative results (Mistral-7b-instruct deadlocks rose 2→3), but no baselines beyond before/after self-comparison, no statistical treatment, and correctness scores come from a single unvalidated domain expert. Evidence strength is limited by small sample, single-run experiments, manually built Timed Automata replicas, and LLM-mediated NL-to-logic translation that the authors admit is error-prone. Generalizability is constrained to PDEVS/statecharts and depends on assumption of contradiction-free descriptions. Reproducibility is partial: prompts, thresholds (m=n=3, g=3), temperatures, and z3 usage are specified and a GitHub link is claimed, but the link is a placeholder, and manual expert scoring and manual UPPAAL replication are not automatable.

primary_link.title: LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts

papers.summary: The development of models demands sound modeling and simulation knowledge as well as domain knowledge. Every model should accurately represent a system's dynamics and be verifiable. Toward this objective, this research introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework to assist human modelers in generating and verifying PDEVS statecharts for behavior modeling of atomic Parallel Discrete Event System Specification (PDEVS) models. The framework supports (re)generating plausible facts from a system descrip
papers.summary_zh: 從自然語言系統描述自動產生離散事件模擬模型時,大型語言模型常出現邏輯不一致,導致狀態圖行為錯誤。本文在既有 PDEVS-LLM 代理式框架上加入驗證機制:先由 LLM 產生 PDEVS 合理事實並從系統描述抽取行為條件,兩者轉譯為命題邏輯;先以 SAT 求解器(z3)檢查可滿足性,再執行分類蘊含驗證,將未通過的條件透過修改提示送回受控修正迴圈,迭代後選取蘊含數最多的事實生成 PDEVS 狀態圖。為評估正確性,作者將狀態圖手動轉成 UPPAAL 中的時間自動機,檢查死結與相位可達性,並提出狀態圖正確性分數,量化外部轉移、內部轉移與輸出函數的完整性與準確性。在 14 個測試系統(含 MiniFab 基準元件)上,以八個公開 LLM 作為生成代理基礎模型實驗:多數模型驗證後獲得改善,如 Qwen3-32b 與 GPT-4o-mini 在死結與相位可達性上持續進步,Claude-opus-4.1 修正後外部、內部與輸出函數分數皆達 1.0;但 Mistral-7b-instruct 死結案例反增,小型模型的外部轉移分數下滑。限制包括假設系統描述本身無矛盾、命題邏輯轉譯仰賴 LLM 可能出錯,且命題邏輯不含時間語意,時間推進屬性改善有限。此研究展示形式驗證回饋能提升 LLM 生成模擬模型的邏輯一致性,為可信任的模擬建模奠定基礎。

links.title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: GPT-5.5 achieved 59.3%, 33.3%, and 28.3% across the three tasks; Claude Sonnet 5 achieved 53.3%, 18.7%, and 7.3%; 30-participant human baseline reached 80.8%, 68.8%, 64.3%.

Section 3.1 Implementation Details: GPT-5.5 run with 'reasoning effort disabled, low text verbosity, low image detail, and a 128-token output limit'; Claude Sonnet 5 with 'thinking disabled, low effort, and a 64-token output limit' — single-run handicapped API evaluations.

Section 3.5 Results and Discussion, Table 1: raw counts (e.g., GPT-5.5 178/300 cube nets, 85/300 connected grids; Claude 22/300 grids); Table 2: Wilson 95% CIs and paired bootstrap intervals that 'exclude zero on all three tasks'.

Section 3.4 Visible-Derivation and Item Analysis: derivation condition used '30 matched examples per task and model' with a different prompt; across 180 responses, 72 coded as wrong image reconstruction and 41 as incorrect reasoning procedure.
Section 3.3 Human Baseline: 30 adults, 60-item packet (20 items/task), convenience sample 'tests whether the benchmark is interpretable... rather than estimating population-level ability'.

Section 4 Conclusions and Future Work: limitations stated as 'two proprietary models, a convenience-sample human baseline, and three deliberately narrow generated task families'; public release ('generators, rendered data, prompts... evaluation scripts') is stated as a future intention ('A public release should include'), not a current availability claim.
Section 2.1-2.2 Related Works: positions itself against CLEVR, GQA, BLINK, SpatialBot, and Mind the Gap, conceding 'StateSight is narrower than these benchmarks'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A diagnostic benchmark probing latent spatial-state reconstruction in two frontier multimodal LLMs (GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 5) with three procedurally generated tasks. It is not pure computer vision since it centers on LLM evaluation, prompting conditions, and visible-derivation (CoT-adjacent) analysis, giving moderate relevance to Multimodal AI, Reasoning, and Evaluation preferences; however, it is a narrow VLM spatial-perception benchmark with no new language-modeling methodology, no agents/RAG/Japanese-NLP content, and no training experiments, so preference relevance is mid-range rather than high. Rigor is solid for a benchmark paper: deterministic oracles, 300 items/task, Wilson CIs, and paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero (Table 2); but only two proprietary API models were run once each under deliberately handicapped settings (reasoning effort disabled, low image detail, 128/64-token limits, Section 3.1), the human baseline (30 participants, 60 items, convenience sample, Section 3.3) is not item-matched with models, and the derivation condition (n=30/task, different prompt) is acknowledged as confounded. Evidence for the within-scope claims is real and quantitatively reported, with appropriately hedged conclusions. Novelty is modest: CLEVR/BLINK/Mind the Gap already establish diagnostic VLM spatial evaluation; the deterministic machine-checkable StateSight-Steps intermediate states are a fresh twist but untested. Generalizability is low (synthetic tasks, two models, authors explicitly note limits to natural images). Reproducibility is weak in practice: no released code/data/URL; the public release is described only in future terms ('should include', Section 4), though generators and API settings are described well enough to reimplement.

primary_link.title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used for multimodal question answering, yet their ability to reconstruct latent spatial structure from a single image remains difficult to isolate. Broad benchmarks often combine perception, optical character recognition, domain knowledge, linguistic priors, and reasoning in the same evaluation. We introduce StateSight, a procedurally generated benchmark for cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and 4-neighbor connected-component
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型廣泛應用於多模態問答，但一般基準常將感知、光學字元辨識、領域知識與推理混為一體，難以分離模型是否真正重建影像背後的潛在空間結構。StateSight 以程式自動生成三類任務：立方體展開圖的對面對應、被遮擋立方塔的隱藏方塊計數，以及 4-鄰接連通分量計數，每類 300 張單影像題目，皆附決定論式標準答案與精確比對評分。結果顯示 GPT-5.5（API 模型識別碼 gpt-5.5）在三項任務分別達 59.3%、33.3%、28.3%，Claude Sonnet 5 為 53.3%、18.7%、7.3%，且所有直接作答零格式錯誤；但 30 名人類受試者的 60 題基準（80.8%、68.8%、64.3%）在每項任務都高於兩模型。可見推導分析顯示主要錯誤來自影像狀態重建與推理流程。作者另推出 StateSight-Steps，含 900 筆圖文交錯範例與 3,600 個決定論式中間視覺狀態，供未來視覺狀態監督實驗。限制在於僅評估兩個專有模型、人類基準為便利取樣，且任務刻意狹窄，難以直接推論自然影像場景。此研究指出格式正確的回答可能掩蓋模型無法還原可驗證視覺推論所需空間結構的事實。
papers.title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: StateSight：為視覺語言模型的潛在空間狀態重建建立基準

links.title: MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring

evidence: Abstract: 'MEDR improves model accuracy by 0.63%–0.89% on Video-MME' and 'improves accuracy by up to 1.23% with Qwen3-VL-8B' - small absolute gains.

Section 4.2: 'The LongVideoBench result is not equally consistent with Qwen2.5-VL, indicating that the usefulness of a selected frame set also depends on how the downstream MLLM integrates sparse visual evidence.' - cross-backbone inconsistency acknowledged.
Table 1 (Section 4): On <=60s subsets, Uniform/MaxInfo outperform MEDR in most settings (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL B=32: Uniform 57.14 vs MEDR 55.57); AKS exceeds MEDR in most LongVideoBench columns.
Section 4.4 Table 3: 'Fixed Scoring 60.26 (-2.07)' is the largest ablation drop, but 'w/o Motion Signal 62.07 (-0.26)' is near noise.
Section 4.3 Table 2: MEDR 67.12±0.26 overall vs MaxInfo 66.59±0.27 over six order seeds - gain roughly two standard deviations.
Section 4.1: '(ρ,η)=(0.5,0.1)' for B=32 and '(0.8,0.2)' for B=64, M=512, 1 fps decoding, single NVIDIA A100 80GB, deterministic decoding - hyperparameters fully specified.
Section 3.2: signals are color-histogram differences, SSIM (Wang et al. 2004), perceptual-hash differences, Farnebäck optical flow, and OCR - no learned language methodology in the selection method.
Section 5 and full text: no code or artifact availability statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Training-free, query-independent frame selection for video MLLMs using visual/motion/OCR events plus iterative dynamic rescoring. It touches Multimodal AI, Video, and Efficiency preferences via MLLM input construction, but the core methodology is entirely classical visual signal processing (color histograms, SSIM, pHash, optical flow, OCR) with no language-methodology contribution, keeping relevance moderate. Novelty is incremental: dynamic rescoring closely resembles greedy submodular selection with redundancy penalties, and multi-signal event modeling is a combination of known cues; the query-independent/reusable-frame-set angle is the freshest part. Rigor is decent: two backbones, two budgets, two benchmarks, Uniform/MaxInfo baselines, AKS as a query-dependent reference, component ablations, and a six-seed multi-question protocol with std. However, main tables are single deterministic runs with no significance testing, and gains are small (0.63-0.89% Video-MME, up to 1.23% long subset), with MEDR losing to Uniform/MaxInfo on <=60s subsets and to AKS in many columns (Table 1), and the paper itself admits LongVideoBench results are inconsistent with Qwen2.5-VL (Section 4.2). The 0.53% multi-question gain over MaxInfo is only ~2 std (67.12±0.26 vs 66.59±0.27, Table 2). Generalizability is limited to 7-8B models and two benchmarks with no compute-cost analysis of the 1-fps + OCR + optical-flow pipeline. Reproducibility is fair: full equations, hyperparameters ((ρ,η) per budget, M=512), public benchmarks/models, deterministic decoding, but no code release. Not pure computer vision (evaluated end-to-end on MLLM video QA), so the out-of-scope cap does not apply, but the small margins and CV-centric method yield a middling score.

primary_link.title: MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring

papers.summary: Frame selection is a fundamental component of multimodal large language models, enabling long videos to be processed under limited visual-token and computational budgets. Uniform sampling preserves temporal coverage but may miss informative content that appears only briefly. To alleviate this limitation, query-dependent methods can retrieve question-relevant frames. However, because the selected frames depend on the current question, the same visual input cannot be directly shared across differe
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型處理長影片時，需在有限的視覺 token 與運算預算下選取影格。均勻取樣可能錯過短暫出現的關鍵內容，而依賴問題的查詢相關方法雖能擷取相關影格，卻無法在多輪問答間重複使用同一組視覺輸入。MEDR 提出免訓練且與查詢無關的影格選取法：Multi-Signal Event Modeling 將視覺、動作與文字（OCR）訊號分別組織成訊號專屬的時間事件；Dynamic Rescoring 則在每次選取後，依影格訊號強度、新增事件涵蓋度與時間冗餘重新評分候選影格。由於建構時不觀察提問，選出的固定影格集可跨問題重複使用。實驗以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 與 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 Video-MME 與 LongVideoBench 上評估：MEDR 在 Video-MME 相較查詢無關基準提升 0.63%–0.89%；在 LongVideoBench 長影片子集以 Qwen3-VL-8B 最多提升 1.23%；在固定影格集多問題協定下，整體準確率較 MaxInfo 提升 0.53%，且後續問題表現最佳。消融實驗顯示動態重評分、時間冗餘控制與文字訊號貢獻最大。限制包括短影片上均勻取樣與 MaxInfo 仍較強，長影片增益也取決於下游模型整合稀疏視覺證據的能力。此方法對多輪查詢同一影片的場景具實用價值。
papers.title: MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring
papers.title_zh: MEDR：以多訊號事件建模與動態重評分實現與查詢無關的影格選取

links.title: Agentic AI-Enabled Solar-Powered High-Altitude Platforms for Sustainable SAGINs

evidence: Abstract: agent 'invokes quantitative tools for prediction and verification; and coordinates executable actions through a closed control loop'
Section III-B2: 'the HAP agent should have access to at least six tool classes', including forecasting, link-budget simulator, task scheduler, digital twin, and constrained optimization solver
Section IV-B: 'All results are averaged over 50 random seeds with 95% confidence intervals'; baselines are 'an LLM scheme, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO)'

Section IV-B: 'The proposed agent and standalone LLM use the same Qwen2.5-7B model with 4-bit weight quantization ... while only the agent invokes forecasting, scheduling, and constraint-verification tools'

Section IV-C: 'average energy efficiency of 4.20 Mbit/J, outperforming MAPPO, PPO, and the standalone LLM by 27.1%, 51.6%, and 70.2%'; 'task completion rate of 94.6%, compared with 87.5% for MAPPO, 80.6% for PPO, and 76.1% for the standalone LLM'

Sections II-V (whole document): no ablation study, code release, or artifact availability is reported; future work (Section V) lists trustworthy control, multi-HAP orchestration, and digital-twin adaptation as unresolved
llm_evaluation.rationale: A domain application of LLM-based agentic control to solar-powered HAP/SAGIN orchestration. Genuine topical match to Agents & Tool Use (perception-reasoning-action loop, six tool classes, multi-timescale orchestration) and LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B planner), but the contribution is a magazine-style framework rather than new language or agent methodology: the loop, tool-augmented reasoning, and reflection/episodic memory patterns are standard (Section III). Evaluation is a single NS-3 disaster-recovery scenario (60 min, 120 devices) with three baselines and 50 seeds/95% CIs (Section IV-B), reporting quantified gains (4.20 Mbit/J energy efficiency; 94.6% completion; 137.8 ms latency; Section IV-C). No ablations isolating the agent's components, and the LLM baseline lacks tools by construction, confounding tool use with framework benefit. No code or artifact release; prompts and tool implementations unspecified. Simulation-only evidence and domain-specific energy/flight constraints limit generalizability. Above the pure-domain-application cap because language/agent methodology is the central object, but modest overall as ML research.

primary_link.title: Agentic AI-Enabled Solar-Powered High-Altitude Platforms for Sustainable SAGINs

papers.summary: Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks (SAGINs) can extend connectivity, but their communication, computing, and platform operations create tightly coupled energy demands. Solar-powered High-Altitude Platforms (HAPs) offer a promising middle layer by combining persistent regional coverage, renewable-energy harvesting, and onboard computing. However, realizing this potential requires more than optimizing individual links or processors, as radio transmission, task execution, backhaul use, and batter
papers.summary_zh: 太空–空中–地面整合網路（SAGIN）可擴展連線服務，但其通訊、運算與平台運作共享同一能源預算，太陽能高空平台（HAP）因此成為兼具持久區域覆蓋與再生能源收集的中間層。本文提出 HAP 原生 Agentic AI 框架：代理持續感知通訊、運算、能源、移動與任務五類狀態，呼叫太陽能預測、鏈路預算、排程、數位分身與限制驗證等量化工具，並以感知–推理–決策–行動–回饋閉迴路協調可執行動作；設計上以多時間尺度分離快速無線電控制、任務編排與長期能源規劃。災後復原案例以 NS-3 與 Python 共同模擬，在衛星回程壅塞、流量突增與太陽能衰退疊加下，相較 MAPPO、PPO 與獨立 LLM 基準，能源效率達 4.20 Mbit/J（分別提升 27.1%、51.6%、70.2%），任務完成率 94.6%，平均延遲 137.8 毫秒（較 MAPPO 降低 29.1%），並在 60 分鐘結束時保留 28.25% 電量，維持高於 25% 安全儲備的餘裕。限制在於結果來自模擬、代理僅採用 Qwen2.5-7B 量化模型，且可信驗證、多 HAP 協同與數位分身終身調適仍是待解課題。此框架顯示 Agentic AI 能將語意理解轉為可量化的跨域資源決策，對永續網路營運具參考價值。

links.title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research

evidence: Abstract: agent solves/verifies a problem, formulates a new problem via a research-value gate, and organizes proof steps in an executable DAG with per-step certificates.
Section 2.1: dual-model architecture; solver DeepSeek V4 Pro generates proofs, evaluator Claude Sonnet 5 reviews premises, calculations, and logic and cannot modify proofs.
Remark 2.1: an external monitor (Codex running GPT-5.6 Sol) inspected reasoning and supplied guidance, showing internal roles miss deep reasoning errors.
Remark 2.2: single timing comparison on the x^3−x problem with two runs (~53.8% reduction) and explicit admission that 'the entire time difference cannot be attributed to the DAG'.

Table 1 and related-work paragraph: capability comparison to Moonshine, RMA, QED, ProofCouncil, Danus, Rethlas-Archon, MMAT; Andy's local revocation overlaps Danus's verifier-gated fact graph with transitive revocation.
Section 3.4 Theorem 3.5: sufficient conditions for global exponential leader-follower synchronization with self-triggered impulses, recovery window, Zeno exclusion, and exponential bound (20).
Example 3.1: five-follower numerical example, max error 4.3163e-7 at t=12s under control vs ~8.4527 without control.
Appendix A.1 Table 2: nine problem versions scored by the system's own evaluator; versions 4-7 passed thresholds but were rejected only for multiple parallel subquestions.
Appendix A.4: failed branch N9 after three revisions, invalidated main branch N6-N8 after interface change, final chain N1-r2 to N12-r4 recorded with 19 immutable node revisions.
Title-page header: project homepage and source code GitHub URL claimed but no prompt, seed, or evaluation protocol details provided in the document; LLM randomness acknowledged in Remark 2.2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-based autonomous mathematical research agent (solver DeepSeek V4 Pro, evaluator Claude Sonnet 5) with version-bound proof DAGs, interface-based invalidation, and a research-value gate, demonstrated on one control-theory case study. Topic fit to high-weight preferences (agents, mathematical reasoning, LLMs) is strong, but the agent methodology itself is an engineering combination of prior systems (Danus fact-graph revocation, QED/RMA verification, MMAT co-pilot), and the evaluation is thin: a single case study, self-generated gate scores (Appendix A.1 Table 2), a two-run toy timing test with an admitted confound (Remark 2.2), no independent human or formal (Lean) verification of the produced theorem, and admission that an external LLM monitor was still needed (Remark 2.1). The control-theoretic theorem and proof (Theorem 3.5) are detailed and internally structured with Zeno exclusion and a numerical example, but are unverifiable from the document alone and constitute a domain deliverable rather than a general agent result.

primary_link.title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research

papers.summary: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that turns a mathematical problem into a traceable proof. It solves or verifies a submitted problem, formulates a literature-grounded new problem through a research-value gate, and carries it through proof construction and final verification. It organizes proof steps in an executable DAG, verifies each step independently and binds the result to a certificate, retains verified work whose interfaces remain unchanged during local repair, and records
papers.summary_zh: Andy 是一套自主數學研究代理，可將數學問題轉化為可追蹤的證明。它先解出或驗證使用者提交的問題，再經研究價值關卡（評估重要性、原創性、可行性與連貫性）提出有文獻依據的新問題，並完成證明建構與最終驗證。系統以可執行的 DAG 組織證明步驟，每個節點包含陳述、假設、依賴、證明與驗證憑證；節點經獨立驗證後即凍結，修訂僅在介面指紋改變時才使下游節點失效，從而保留已驗證成果。架構上採求解者與評估者分離：DeepSeek V4 Pro 負責生成與修訂，Claude Sonnet 5 負責審查前提、計算與邏輯完整性。案例研究從已驗證的自觸發脈衝共識結果出發，Andy 歷經九個版本、七條證明路線，最終提出具切換通訊拓撲之時延異質網路的全域指數領導者–追隨者同步定理：混合控制結合自觸發脈衝、執行延遲與復原視窗內的連續回饋，建立了充分條件、排除 Zeno 行為並附數值範例；單一任務上 DAG 流程較普通流程省時約 53.8%。限制包括評估僅屬初步、深度推理錯誤仍需外部監督者介入，且尚未支援形式化證明。此工作展示可稽核、逐步驗證的自主數學研究工作流程，有助於長程證明任務的透明追蹤與除錯。
papers.title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
papers.title_zh: Andy：一個用於嚴謹證明與自主研究的數學代理

links.title: Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach

evidence: Section 2: 'PGCL belongs to this broader family. Its specific contribution is to study a frozen-text-embedding setting with a dual stream projection, prototype-anchor attention, offset-based prototype margins, and stream regularization.'
Section 4.3 Table 7: paired bootstrap differences - AmazonReviews 0.0904 [0.0443, 0.1377]; ToxicComment 0.0009 [-0.0012, 0.0029] 'confidence interval overlaps zero'.
Section 4.3 Table 8: Encoder-LoRA 0.831 and full fine-tuning 0.820 exceed PGCL 0.772 on GoEmotions; 0.959/0.965 exceed 0.953 on ToxicComment, bounding the claim.
Section 4.4 Table 13 vs Section 4.2 Table 4: retrained AmazonReviews full objective 0.569 vs headline PGCL 0.727, indicating cross-protocol inconsistency.
Section 3.4 and Appendix B: Theorems 1-2 are sufficient-condition triangle-inequality bounds; 'these assumptions... are not automatic consequences of gradient-based training'.
Appendix D.2: fully specified local LLM protocol (temperature 0.0, seed 42, telemetry tables) using 'qwen3.6:27b' via Ollama; model identifier is questionable relative to cited Qwen3 report.
Section 4.1 Table 1: fixed splits GoEmotions 5126/906/881 and AmazonReviews 2271/487/487 are small; Appendix A.5 gives only preliminary-experiment justification for d=64.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A metric-learning paper (PGCL) that regularizes frozen text embeddings with prototype anchors, supervised contrastive loss, offset margins, and orthogonality penalties for post-hoc evaluation proxies (toxicity, emotion, review rating). Preference relevance is moderate: it connects to AI Safety (toxicity as a proxy task), evaluation/LLM-as-judge comparisons, and embeddings, but the core contribution is representation learning rather than LLM methodology; the LLM baseline is a single local Qwen few-shot protocol. Novelty is limited: the paper itself concedes PGCL 'belongs to this broader family' of supervised metric learning (Section 2), combining SupCon, center/triplet losses, ArcFace/CosFace-style margins, and prototype attention. Rigor is above average: direct frozen-embedding baselines, PEFT diagnostics, ablations, sensitivity, leakage audit, and paired bootstrap CIs are reported, and claims are deliberately bounded. Evidence is mixed: bootstrap CIs support PGCL on AmazonReviews (0.0904 [0.0443,0.1377]) and marginally GoEmotions, but ToxicComment overlaps zero (0.0009 [-0.0012,0.0029]), LoRA/full fine-tuning beat PGCL on two datasets (Table 8), and headline AmazonReviews numbers (0.727 in Table 4) diverge sharply from retrained ablation values (0.569 in Table 13), reflecting protocol inconsistencies. Theory is a sufficient-condition triangle-inequality bound explicitly disclaimed as non-guaranteeing. Generalizability is constrained by one encoder (jina-embeddings-v3) and small splits (e.g., GoEmotions 5126/906/881). Reproducibility is decent via full LLM telemetry and hyperparameters, but no code/artifact release is stated and the 'qwen3.6:27b' model identifier is dubious.

primary_link.title: Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach

papers.summary: Reliable post-hoc evaluation asks whether already generated text satisfies a target criterion after generation. In this paper we study a focused frozen-embedding setting using principle-evaluation proxy tasks: toxicity detection, fine-grained emotion categorization, and ordinal review rating. General-purpose text embeddings are widely deployed for such tasks, but broad semantic similarity can place semantically similar yet task-distinct examples in overlapping regions of the representation space
papers.summary_zh: 可靠的事後評估需判斷已生成文字是否符合目標準則，但通用文字嵌入的廣域語意相似性會使語意相近卻屬不同任務標籤的樣本在表示空間中重疊，作者稱之為表示糾纏。本文提出原型引導對比學習（PGCL），在凍結文字嵌入之上加入輕量模組：結合語意 MLP 流與原型錨點注意力流的雙流架構，並以監督對比損失、偏移原型邊界損失、流正交損失及選配的幅度損失訓練，全程不更新基礎編碼器；理論以充分條件分析原型邊界幾何。在 GoEmotions、AmazonReviews 與 ToxicComment 三個代理任務上，以凍結 jina-embeddings-v3 特徵實驗顯示 PGCL 均優於原始嵌入，其中 AmazonReviews 提升最明顯（加權 F1 由 0.589 升至 0.727），GoEmotions 與 ToxicComment 則與 center loss 等直接度量學習基線具競爭力（後者信賴區間跨零）。與本地 few-shot LLM（qwen3.6:27b）的固定協定比較中 PGCL 亦佔優，但 LoRA 與完整 fine-tuning 在部分資料集上更高，故其定位為凍結嵌入的事後方法而非 PEFT 替代品。限制包括消融結果具任務相依性、資料集僅為代理任務。其價值在於以低成本模組改善既有嵌入儲存，並大幅降低下游分類器的訓練與推論成本。
papers.title: Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach
papers.title_zh: 為原則評估結構化語意嵌入：原型引導對比學習方法

links.title: Handoff-H1: An Orchestrated Vision-Agent System for Material Quantity Takeoff from Construction Blueprints

evidence: Sec 3.1 (Figure 3 caption): 'Model identities, prompts, and orchestration specifics are withheld.'
Sec 3.5: 'Stage decomposition, routing, and verification logic are not disclosed.'
Sec 3.4: 'Its contents, sources, and curation methodology remain proprietary.'

Sec 3.1: 'None of the three is the differentiator on its own; the human-level performance on the benchmark (Section 5) is the product of their combination' — no ablation experiments reported anywhere in the paper.
Sec 4.1: '10 residential blueprint sets ... 2,009 verified line items, 1,348 of them primary-tier and in scope for scoring.'

Sec 4.3: judge is 'OpenAI gpt-5.5', every prediction 'judged ten times and the reported metrics are averages across judge runs'; Sec 4.3 caveats admit judge is 'not a substitute for a human adjudicator on genuinely ambiguous rows'.
Sec 5.1 Table 1: Handoff-H1 composite 81.6 (86.1 coverage, 78.8 P@.25) vs best baseline claude-fable-5 at 61.4 and estimators at 77.6.
Sec 4.5 / Appendix A: evaluation harness 'public under Apache-2.0' via harbor; 'blueprint sets and ground-truth takeoffs are available upon request' after review.
Sec 6 'Evaluation scope': 'Results are reported on residential blueprints. Commercial construction, multi-story buildings ... may behave differently and remain to be evaluated.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Domain application (construction takeoff) but built on substantial LLM methodology: tool-using vision agents (ReAct-style, Sec 3.3), hierarchical RAG-style 'project foundation' (Sec 3.4), self-refinement verification (Sec 3.5), and an LLM-judge benchmark (Sec 4.3), so it is not a capped out-of-scope pure-domain/CV paper. Topic fit is solid for Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and Evaluation, though no Japanese/NLP or reasoning-method contribution. Novelty is moderate: the consensus-validated TakeoffBench-v1 ground truth is a genuinely new resource, but the system assembles known patterns (ReAct, Self-Refine, HiRAG/RAPTOR-style hierarchy, LLM-Wiki) with incremental engineering. Rigor is mixed: same judge across systems, 10 judge runs, human-estimator baseline, per-trade analysis and honest caveats (Sec 6), but only 10 blueprint sets, no ablation isolating the three claimed-complementary layers despite Sec 3.1 asserting none is the differentiator alone, and no significance testing. Evidence strength is limited by self-reporting: the central 20-point gap (Table 1: 81.6 vs 61.4) and human-level claim rest on withheld ground truth and a proprietary system (model identities, prompts, orchestration, and verification logic all withheld per Sec 3.1/3.5; KB 'remains proprietary' Sec 3.4), and the judge itself is an LLM (gpt-5.5) whose systematic bias is acknowledged but unmeasured. Generalizability is low (residential-only, domain-specific curated KB; commercial/multi-story explicitly unevaluated, Sec 6). Reproducibility is partial: public Apache-2.0 harness via harbor (Sec 4.5, Appendix A) and data on request, but the evaluated system cannot be reproduced.

primary_link.title: Handoff-H1: An Orchestrated Vision-Agent System for Material Quantity Takeoff from Construction Blueprints

radar.summary: Converting a set of architectural blueprints into a complete material quantity takeoff requires visual perception across drawing sheets, dimensional and multi-hop reasoning, and grounding in construction conventions that the drawings never state. We present Handoff-H1, a takeoff system built from three layers: purpose-built computer-vision models that extract primitives; tool-using agents equipped with image operations and in-house visual-task tools, including CV-model-backed counting, detection
radar.summary_zh: 將一組建築藍圖轉為完整的材料數量估算，需要跨圖紙的視覺感知、尺寸與多跳推理，以及圖紙上從未明述的營建慣例知識。本文提出 Handoff-H1，由三層組成：專用電腦視覺模型從每張圖紙還原型別化基元；配備通用影像操作與自家視覺工具（構架構件分解、計數、偵測）的視覺代理；以及持久化、階層式的專案基礎層，結合策展營建知識庫，供按工種編排的估算流程與獨立驗證使用。評測採自建的 TakeoffBench-v1：10 組經授權的住宅藍圖、2,009 筆專家共識驗證列項，僅計分 1,348 筆主要材料，由 LLM 評審依覆蓋率與 Precision@25% 組成合成分數。結果顯示 Handoff-H1 端對端自原始 PDF 達 81.6%（覆蓋率 86.1%、P@.25 78.8%），約高出最強前沿代理 claude-fable-5（61.4）20 分，並超越獨立專業估算師（77.6%）：人類精準度高（87.9%）但覆蓋率低（65.5%），七個前沿與開放權重模型（35–61）則普遍覆蓋率勝過精準度。逐工種分析顯示系統在需推導的 Drywall、Insulation、Framing、Roofing 領先，估算師仍守住 Siding。限制包括連續測量工種仍是難點、知識庫需持續維護、僅限住宅且由 LLM 評審計分。此研究證明工程化的感知、知識與編排組合能以相同輸入大幅超越通用模型。
