links.title: PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas

evidence: Sec. 2.3: four-stage PCT pipeline uses GPT-4o-mini candidate generation, rule-based validation, GPT-4o LLM-as-a-Judge, and failure-aware regeneration; cross-family re-judging with Claude/Gemini yields κ=0.978/0.804.
Sec. 4.1: authors adopt ADE/FDE as primary metrics because PDMS 'may penalize intentionally aggressive or cautious trajectories', acknowledging evaluator-protocol mismatch with non-normal personas.
Sec. 4.2: DiffusionDrive ResNet-34 baseline, 100 epochs, AdamW lr 0.0006, batch 128 on 6×A6000; seed coefficient of variation of Avg. ADE/FDE below 0.12% with wins in all nine cells.
Table 4 / Sec. 4.5: ablation isolates PCAT, PCMF, and diversity loss; full model reaches Avg ADE 2.39/FDE 3.71 vs 3.93/5.79 text-encoder-only baseline, with per-persona detail in Table S.4.

Supp. Sec. 7: limitations state the persona space is a discrete 3×3 grid, evaluation uses a nonreactive NAVSIM simulator calibrated for normal driving, and 0.18% of LLM-generated scenes remained unrecovered after retries.
Supp. Sec. 4.10: the PCT generation pipeline applied unchanged to 1,000-scene nuScenes and Waymo subsets reproduces the axis structure, but model-level transfer is not tested.
Table 1 / Supp. Table S.1: human evaluation with 13 (main) and 21 (supplementary) participants; persona identification accuracy 85.7%, above chance including within-axis cells.

Supp. Sec. 8.2: keyword-stripped prompts (32.2% top-1 vs 11.1% chance), unseen free-form prompts (44.4%), and paraphrase robustness (88.9% cell stability) probe semantic grounding of the text conditioning.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Autonomous-driving trajectory prediction with genuine but largely instrumental language methodology: personas are controlled via natural-language descriptions, GPT-4o-mini/GPT-4o generate and judge the synthetic PCT dataset, and text-vs-one-hot ablations (Table 6) show language conditioning adds value. However, the core contribution is a domain (driving) application where LLMs serve as data tooling rather than the research subject; no core LLM/NLP methodology (reasoning, agents, alignment) is advanced. Evaluation is partially circular: ADE/FDE measure fidelity to LLM-generated pseudo-ground-truth (Secs. 2.3, 4.1), though the paper transparently flags PDMS miscalibration. Rigor is unusually strong: component ablations (Tables 4, S.4, S.9-S.11), hyperparameter sweeps (S.13), Wilcoxon axis tests (Sec. 2.4), human study (Table 1/S.1), cross-family judge agreement (κ=0.978/0.804), trained 1D-vs-multi-D comparison (S.8), and seed-variance reporting (<0.12% CoV). Cross-dataset transfer (S.4.10) covers the generation pipeline, not the trained model. Code, dataset, and full prompts released.

primary_link.title: PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas

radar.summary: Although recent trajectory prediction and end-to-end autonomous driving methods improve robustness in urban environments, they still lack meaningful controllability. Existing benchmarks either provide no persona-conditioned annotations or support only a single urgency spectrum (i.e., emergency, normal, relaxed), which cannot distinguish personas that share the same urgency level but require different driving dynamics. To address this, we propose (i) the Persona-Conditioned Trajectory (PCT) datas
radar.summary_zh: 現行軌跡預測與端對端自動駕駛方法缺乏可控性，既有基準不是沒有人格條件標註，就是僅支援單一緊急程度光譜，無法區分急迫程度相同但駕駛動態相異的情境。本文沿「時間急迫性」與「乘坐舒適度」兩軸分解駕駛人格，各取三層級形成九種人格的 PCT 資料集，每種人格附自然語言描述與對應軌跡，透過候選生成、規則驗證、GPT-4o 評審與失敗感知再生的四階段管線建構於 OpenScene 之上；人類辨識準確率達 85.7%，且與 Claude、Gemini 評審具高度一致性。方法上提出 PersonaDrive：PCAT 依文字導出的急迫性純量與舒適度向量對軌跡錨點進行階層式調變，PCMF 於 BEV 層級進行條件化融合，並以階層引導損失與軸分解多樣性損失監督訓練。於 NAVSIM 上，PersonaDrive 達到最低 ADE（2.39）與 FDE（3.71）及最高 PDMS（57.7），在全部九種人格上皆優於基線；消融確認各模組貢獻，MiniLM 勝過更大的文字編碼器，而一維條件化在急迫與舒適需求相衝突的情境明顯退化。限制包括離散 3×3 網格、非反應式模擬器與 LLM 生成資料的偏誤風險。此工作展示以文字連續控制駕駛行為、超越單軸人格的可能性。
radar.title: PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas
radar.title_zh: PersonaDrive：以多維度駕駛人格實現可控軌跡預測

links.title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations

evidence: Section 2.1: cites Bean et al. (2025) systematic review of 445 LLM benchmarks finding over half lack construct definitions and nearly half lack validation rationale.
Section 2.5: documents the FrontierMath/OpenAI funding-disclosure case and admitted Llama 4 benchmark 'fudging' via footnoted news sources with access dates.
Section 3: maps benchmarking harms onto four of Young's five faces of oppression (exploitation, marginalisation, powerlessness, cultural imperialism).
Section 4.1: categorizes benchmarking as 'avoidable structural injustice' using McKeown's (2021) pure/avoidable/deliberate taxonomy.
Section 5: proposes 'third-order change' and 'well-ordered science' remedies but presents no empirical evaluation or implementation of these proposals.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A normative position paper critiquing AI/LLM benchmarking culture through Iris Marion Young's oppression and structural-injustice frameworks. Topic substantively matches the LLM evaluation/benchmark, safety-fairness, and dataset preferences (Sections 2-3 discuss LLM benchmarks, contamination, toxicity measurement), but it offers no language methodology, no experiments, and no original empirical data, so relevance to the technical LLM core is moderate. Novelty is moderate: applying Young's four faces of oppression specifically to benchmarking appears new, while the constituent critiques (construct validity, bias, contamination, gaming, corporate capture) are compiled from prior work the paper itself cites. Rigor is decent for a philosophy paper - clear structure, systematic mapping in Sections 3-4, consistent hedging - but unverifiable normative claims appear (e.g., economic motives for overselling in Section 2.4). Evidence strength rests entirely on cited studies and footnoted news cases rather than the authors' own analysis. The framework generalizes across AI evaluation practices, but reproducibility is minimal since no code, data, or artifacts exist.

primary_link.title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations

radar.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarks are not neutral tools of evaluation but socio-technical artefacts that shape competition, power, and research priorities within AI. Benchmarks standardise the assessment of systems and facilitate the creation of leaderboards that reward state-of-the-art performance with prestige, citations, trust, and institutional influence. As the costs of developing competitive AI systems rise, these rewards increasingly concentrate among powerful, industry-funded labs.
radar.summary_zh: 本文為對 AI 評估文化的批判性論文，主張基準測試並非中立工具，而是塑造競爭、權力與研究優先順序的社會技術產物。作者先整理既有問題：建構效度不足（回顧 445 個 LLM 基準發現過半缺乏明確定義或驗證）、偏誤與錯誤再現（熱門基準多由西方菁英機構建立且偏向西方視角）、地面真相的自然化、對擬人化能力神話的助燃，以及 FrontierMath 資金爭議與 Llama 4 成績美化等操弄案例。接著援引 Iris Marion Young 的壓迫五面向理論，論證 AI 基準實踐體現其中四面向：剝削、邊緣化、無權力與文化帝國主義；並以結構性不正義概念說明這些傷害源自常態化、個體層面可辯護的行動與網路效應，屬於有權力者有能力改變卻未改變的「可避免」結構不正義。作者指出此結構窄化研究軌跡、傷害資源不足的實驗室與邊緣社群，並使公眾陷入認知依從，削弱整體科學品質；因而呼籲超越技術修補的第三階段改變、參與式評估生態、權力批判研究，以及對操弄評估者的問責與民主監督。其價值在於將評估危機重新定位為結構與政治問題，而非僅是度量技術問題。
radar.title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations
radar.title_zh: 基準測試的陷阱：AI 評估中的權力與不正義結構

links.title: Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features

evidence: Abstract: A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s; FineCops-Ref shows a 0.52-point A4 deficit at IoU@0.5 (95% CI [0.12, 0.95] favoring S4), and A8 finishes 0.26 points above S4
Section 3.4: invariant checks verify that A4 contains no FFN, that S4's final FFN receives gradient from the localization loss, and that output distributions are finite and sum to one
Section 3.5: three-seed comparisons use 10,000 paired percentile bootstrap replicates with fixed seed 20260812, resampling image IDs so references to the same image move together

Section 4.5: A8's 95% interval relative to S4 is [-0.34, +0.52], described as consistent with recovery rather than a new accuracy advantage, and A8 is explicitly not compute-matched (approx. 840M vs 504M decoder MACs)
Section 4.6: end-to-end pipeline latency is 209.35 ms for A4 vs 210.20 ms for S4 (0.4% difference), so no meaningful end-to-end speed claim is supported

Section 5 (Limitations): result applies to one small single-query decoder over frozen features; does not cover segmentation, multi-object, open-vocabulary detection, or backbone/generative FFN removal; CLIP control is one-seed and RefCOCO is seed-0 only

Appendix A: pinned checkpoint revision f775b65a79762255128c981547af89addcfe0f88, frozen mass threshold 0.8, machine-readable study contract, SHA-256 input hashes, decision logs, and a CPU-only 'make verify-paper' audit of headline values
llm_evaluation.rationale: A carefully controlled FFN-deletion study for a small single-query visual grounding decoder over frozen SigLIP2/CLIP features, with a parameter-matched attention-depth control (A8), prespecified retention gates, image-clustered bootstraps, modality shuffles, and honest preservation of negative results. Rigor and reproducibility are strong (pinned backbone revision, frozen bootstrap seed, SHA-256 artifact manifests, verification scripts). However, the paper aligns mainly with lower-weight preferences (Transformer Architecture, Multimodal AI, Scaling & Efficiency) and does not touch the high-weight LLM, reasoning, agent, or Japanese-NLP themes; effect sizes are fractions of a percentage point, the headline A8 'recovery' interval crosses zero (95% CI [-0.34, +0.52] vs S4), and scope is explicitly narrow (one decoder family, one fully-studied backbone, 24x24 heatmap, single-box output, backbone keeps its FFNs).

primary_link.title: Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features

radar.summary: Do feed-forward networks (FFNs) in visual grounding decoders add essential computation once a pretrained vision-language model has already encoded image and language context? We compare a four-block attention-only decoder (A4), a matched four-block attention-plus-FFN decoder (S4), and an eight-block attention-only parameter control (A8) over frozen VLM features. A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s. FineCops-Ref reveals a small A4 deficit of 0.52 percentage points at IoU@0
radar.summary_zh: 在預訓練視覺語言模型已提供情境化影像與文字特徵後，小型視覺定位解碼器是否仍需要逐詞前饋網路（FFN）？本文在凍結 SigLIP2 特徵上進行嚴格控制的 FFN 刪除實驗，比較四層純注意力解碼器 A4、結構對應的注意力加 FFN 解碼器 S4，以及以注意力深度換取參數預算的八層對照 A8。結果呈現混合但一致的圖像：在 RefCOCOg 直接指涉上 A4 以 +0.26 個百分點通過保留關卡（但預先規劃的直接－邏輯交互作用未獲證實）；在對抗性 Ref-Adv-s 上 A4 領先 0.79 點，難度切片未呈現單調劣化；在組合性 FineCops-Ref 上 A4 出現 0.52 點的顯著劣勢（95% 信賴區間全在零以下），而參數匹配的 A8 完全彌補此差距。結論是 FFN 既非普遍必需也非一律多餘：在受測規模下，增加注意力深度可替代 FFN 容量。A4 減少 44.4% 可訓練參數並降低 10.1% 快取解碼延遲，但端對端延遲仍由凍結骨幹主導。限制包括僅針對單一查詢解碼器、骨幹本身保留 FFN、24×24 熱圖輸出，以及 CLIP 對照僅單種子描述性證據。本研究證據優先的釋出方式與對陰性結果的誠實保留，對架構消融研究的報導具示範意義。

links.title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Table 1 (Sec 5.1): CF-ZOO succeeds 637/797 cases (79.9% [77.0,82.6] Wilson 95% CI) vs White-CW 322/797 (40.4%), the paper's only quantitative baseline comparison.
Table 3 (Sec 5.3): diagnosis over 3,195 stress cases - 78.7% solved, 16.6% grid-infeasible foils, 94.4% recovery restricted to feasible cases using a 200-values-per-dimension command grid.
Sec 5 / Sec 2.3: only baseline is a white-box Carlini-Wagner attack via ART; prior RL-counterfactual methods (RACCER, ACTER, GANterfactual-RL, SAFE-RL) are cited but not empirically compared.
Sec 7: acknowledged limitations - failures may reflect infeasible foils or optimizer failure; human studies to validate explanation usefulness are future work.
Sec 1 (code link) and Appendix A.2 Table 4: public GitHub repository plus full hyperparameters (kappa=0.05, c=1.0, ZOO-ADAM lr=0.01, h=1e-3, seed 0, 9k-21k query budgets) support reproducibility.

Sec 3.2 and Appendix A.4: boundary seeding assumes access to the training-time Pareto archive, and the feasibility audit scales as 200^d commands, restricting applicability to low-dimensional command spaces.
Appendix A.5 Table 5: CF-ZOO mean runtime 48.78s vs White-CW 8.73s per query, quantifying the cost of the higher success rate.

Sec 2.2: return-only PCN variant introduced after observing horizon conditioning was unstable; claim of recovering more Pareto-optimal Minecart solutions than the original implementation is supported only by Figure 1 without statistical backing.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Off-core for the curator's LLM-centric preferences: the paper is pure multi-objective RL plus explainability, matching only the Reinforcement Learning and Interpretability/Explainability categories (plus a tangential AI-safety link via repurposed adversarial attacks), with no language-model content. Scientifically it is a competent XRL contribution: intervening on the PCN desired-return command rather than states/pixels is a genuinely new explanation target, though the optimization machinery (C&W margin loss, ZOO-ADAM, boundary-seeded directional search from Cheng et al. 2019) is a fairly direct adaptation of known adversarial techniques. Evaluation is unusually thorough for this area (797-case baseline comparison with Wilson CIs, 3,195-case stress test, exhaustive 200^d grid feasibility audit separating search failures from infeasible foils, runtime tables), but it lacks any baseline from prior RL-counterfactual methods (RACCER, ACTER, GANterfactual-RL are cited but not compared), uses a single seed, and defers human evaluation of explanation usefulness to future work. Scope is small gridworlds plus Minecart; the method requires a logged Pareto archive for seeding and the feasibility audit scales as 200^d, limiting generalizability to low-dimensional command spaces. Code and full hyperparameters are provided, aiding replication, though PCN training details and custom-environment specifications are thin.

primary_link.title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

radar.summary: Pareto Conditioned Networks learn multiple multi-objective reinforcement learning behaviours by conditioning a single policy on a desired return command. However, the local mapping from command and state to action remains opaque. We propose command-space counterfactual explanations for PCNs: given a fixed state, original command, and foil action, we search, in a black-box setting, for a minimally changed desired-return command under which the same trained policy would choose the foil. Our contri
radar.summary_zh: 帕累托條件網路（PCN）以單一策略網路條件化於期望回報命令，能表示多目標強化學習的多種權衡行為，但命令與狀態到動作的局部映射仍是黑箱。本文提出命令空間反事實解釋：給定固定狀態、原始命令與對照動作，在黑箱設定下搜尋最小幅度改變的期望回報命令，使同一訓練策略改選對照動作，產出「若你的權衡稍微偏向 X，代理就會選擇 Y」式可操作解釋。方法採用僅回報條件的 PCN 變體以避免時間視野條件化帶來的不穩定，並將對抗機器學習技術轉用於解釋：CF-ZOO 結合 Carlini–Wagner 式目標邊際損失、ZOO 零階座標最佳化，以及以訓練期帕累托前沿為行為啟發的邊界種子方向搜尋。實驗橫跨八個環境共 797 例，CF-ZOO 成功率 79.9%，大幅高於白盒 C&W 基線的 40.4%；壓力測試 3,195 例成功率 75.8%；可行性稽核顯示在已知可行案例中可回收 94.4%，其餘多屬網格不可行的對照動作。限制包括目前僅適用於 PCN、單次查詢平均耗時約 50 秒，且失敗可能反映策略未學到該行為。此工作為多目標 RL 決策支援提供了以使用者偏好語言表達的局部可解釋性。
radar.title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
radar.title_zh: 帕累托條件強化學習之命令空間反事實解釋

links.title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions

evidence: Abstract: 'TwinGridShield produced 0 unsafe releases in those 500 trials... this result verifies conformance of the implementation to its encoded authorization predicate rather than safety under model error.'

Section IV (Experimental Method): 'the proposal source is a parameterized stochastic threat surrogate [18]... These probabilities define fixed proposal distributions for evaluating execution policies, not measured attack rates for a specific LLM' — no actual LLM agent is evaluated.

Section IV: 'each experimental rating is assigned as max(1.35|f_k^0|, 25 MW)' and 'they need to be validated with equipment ratings from a utility transmission system' — synthetic stress-test thresholds.

Section V-A (Sensitivity to Model Mismatch): unsafe acceptance '1.94%, 4.02%, and 5.63% at 5%, 10%, and 20% mismatch' for load error and '10.24%, 16.85%, and 30.09%' for rating overestimation; false-block rate remains 0%.

Section VI (Limitation and Path Forward): 'limited to single-step actions on the IEEE 14-bus DC formulation... does not evaluate AC voltage constraints, reactive-power limits, dynamic-security behavior, cascading effects, stale topology, or multi-step adversarial command sequences.'

Section IV: 'The experiment uses seed 2026 and generates per-trial CSV files, vector figures, and audit-chain verification with one command' and 'Seven unit tests evaluate base-case flow, island detection... and log-tampering detection.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Addresses agent-safety topics (runtime authorization for LLM tool calls, prompt injection, shielding) that match weighted preferences, but no LLM is actually run in any experiment: the agent is replaced by a configured stochastic surrogate, so LLM relevance is framing-only. The matched-model headline result (0 unsafe releases in 500 attacked trials) is explicitly a conformance check against an oracle sharing the same DC model, ratings, and invariants, which the paper candidly admits; the substantive evidence is the mismatch analysis (5.63% unsafe acceptance under ±20% load error, 30.09% under 20% rating overestimation). Methodologically the system combines known ideas (runtime enforcement, safe-RL shielding, ToolEmu-style sandboxing) into a domain-specific gate. Scope is a single IEEE 14-bus DC study, single-step actions, with author-assigned synthetic branch ratings; no AC, dynamics, multi-step sequences, or version-pinned LLM agents. Rigor is above average for honesty, Wilson CIs, unit tests, and pre-action-unsafe filtering, but evidence strength is limited by tautological headline results and the absence of any LLM in the loop. Reproducibility is aided by fixed seed (2026), pinned Python/NumPy versions, and one-command artifact generation, though no public code release is stated.

primary_link.title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions

radar.summary: Large language model (LLM)-assisted energy-management tools can translate natural-language context into structured grid commands, but syntactic validity does not imply physical admissibility. This paper presents TwinGridShield, a model-independent runtime authorization layer that evaluates each proposed action in a deterministic network twin before release. The prototype checks connectivity, branch-flow, generator, and load-shedding invariants and records each decision in a hash-chained log. A c
radar.summary_zh: LLM 輔助能源管理工具可將自然語言轉為結構化電網指令，但語法有效不等於物理可允許。本文提出 TwinGridShield，一個與模型無關的執行期授權層：代理提案先經型別化命令邊界，再於確定性電網孿生中求解直流潮流，檢查連通性、支路潮流、發電機限制與負載卸載上限等不變式，僅在通過時釋放命令，並以雜湊鏈日誌記錄每筆決策；遭拒時提供機器可讀的違規原因並呈報人類操作員。在 IEEE 14-bus 對照實驗中，設定為 84% 不安全選擇率的隨機提案代理產生 421/500 個不安全提案；匹配模型條件下 TwinGridShield 零不安全釋放——但作者明言這僅驗證實作符合其編碼授權述詞，而非模型誤差下的安全性。主要的穩健性證據來自參數不匹配實驗：±20% 各匯流排負載量測誤差下不安全接受率升至 5.63%，實際支路額定低於模型 20% 時更高達 30.09%。延遲 p95 僅 0.44 毫秒，開銷可忽略。限制包括僅評估單步動作、直流潮流、合成額定，未涵蓋交流電壓、暫態安全與多步攻擊。此研究示範了將語言命令提案與物理後果釋放分離的執行期保障架構，對網路物理安全具實務意義。
radar.title: TwinGridShield: Consequence-Aware Runtime Authorization for LLM Grid-Agent Actions
radar.title_zh: TwinGridShield：針對 LLM 電網代理動作的後果感知執行期授權

links.title: MoE Router-Guided Clustering for Heterogeneous Federated Instruction Tuning

evidence: {'claim': "Routing-aware collaboration 'consistently improves personalized performance' over FedAvg and local training", 'source': 'Abstract and Section V (Conclusion)'}

{'claim': 'Contradiction: at Dirichlet α=0.1, MoE-FedAvg average ROUGE-L 0.4960 vs ClientMorpher-C 0.4959 and ClientMorpher-E 0.4929, so clustering does not improve over FedAvg in the stated high-heterogeneity setting', 'source': 'Table III, Section IV-E'}

{'claim': 'In the 4-client pathological split, ClientMorpher-C average 0.4731 is below Local training 0.4824; only ClientMorpher-E (0.4986) exceeds MoE-FedAvg (0.4927)', 'source': 'Table II, Section IV-D'}
{'claim': 'Fair communication comparison: all federated methods exchange identical LoRA parameters equal to 0.0878% of the model per round', 'source': 'Table II caption and Section IV-D'}

{'claim': 'Method details: frozen pretrained MoE backbone, expert-usage profiling via top-k router counts, K-Means on client profiles (Variant C) or expert signatures (Variant E), cluster-wise FedAvg', 'source': 'Section III, Algorithm 1, Eqs. 1-9'}

{'claim': 'Experimental scale limited to one dataset (Databricks Dolly-15k) with pathological and Dirichlet (α=0.1, 1.0) splits, 4-8 clients, four NLP task types, ROUGE-L only', 'source': 'Sections IV-A, IV-B, Tables II-III'}

{'claim': 'The MoE backbone model is never named and numeric values for clusters K, profile budget B, rounds R, local steps L, and LoRA rank are not reported; no code availability statement', 'source': 'Sections III-A and IV (absent details)'}
{'claim': 'No comparison to clustered-FL baselines (IFCA, CFL, FedGroup, StoCFL) discussed in related work, nor ablations on K or profile budget', 'source': 'Section II-A vs Section IV-C'}
llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuine LLM-methodology paper: routing-aware clustered federated instruction fine-tuning of sparse MoE LLMs with LoRA, matching LLM (2.5), MoE/transformer, training, and NLP preferences, though it misses the highest-weight topics (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). The core idea—using frozen pretrained MoE router activation profiles as a free client-similarity signal before aggregation—is a reasonable but incremental extension of clustered FL (IFCA/FedGroup) and federated MoE work; the related work itself cites task-conditioned routing signatures, limiting novelty credit. Rigor is undermined by small scale (4-client pathological, 8-client Dirichlet), a single unnamed MoE backbone, a single dataset (Dolly-15k), no cluster-count/profile-budget ablations, no significance testing, and no comparison against the clustered-FL baselines cited in Section II-A. Most critically, the headline claim of 'consistently improves personalized performance' (Abstract) is contradicted by the paper's own Table III: at α=0.1, MoE-FedAvg (0.4960) ties or beats ClientMorpher-C (0.4959) and ClientMorpher-E (0.4929), and in Table II ClientMorpher-C (0.4731) underperforms even Local training (0.4824); only ClientMorpher-E's +0.006 over FedAvg in the pathological split supports the thesis. Communication-budget control (identical 0.0878% LoRA exchange, Section IV-D) is a genuine methodological strength. Generalizability is limited by one dataset, one backbone, tiny client counts, and ROUGE-L only; reproducibility is poor since the MoE model is never named and key hyperparameters (K, B, R, L, LoRA rank) lack values, with no code release.

primary_link.title: MoE Router-Guided Clustering for Heterogeneous Federated Instruction Tuning

radar.summary: Federated instruction fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to decentralized, privacy-sensitive data without requiring data sharing. Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs are particularly attractive for federated learning because their sparse activation reduces computation and communication while scaling model capacity. However, existing federated MoE methods primarily focus on parameter aggregation and personalization, overlooking the routing behavior of MoE models as a sourc
radar.summary_zh: 在資料異質的聯邦學習中對 LLM 進行指令 fine-tuning，無差別的 FedAvg 聚合常導致負遷移。本文提出 ClientMorpher，一個路由感知的個人化聯邦指令 fine-tuning 框架：利用預訓練稀疏 MoE 模型的路由行為作為客戶端資料分布的結構性訊號，於聚合前組織客戶端協作。研究兩種互補聚類策略：ClientMorpher-C 直接以專家激活輪廓對客戶端聚類；ClientMorpher-E 先依專家的跨客戶端使用簽章聚類專家，再導出客戶端協作群組。整體流程凍結 MoE 主幹，僅訓練少量 LoRA 適配參數（每輪 0.0878%），並在叢集內執行 FedAvg，通訊成本與標準方法相同。在 Dolly-15K 的病理式與 Dirichlet（α=0.1、1.0）異質切分上，跨分類、問答、資訊擷取與摘要四類任務評估：病理切分中 ClientMorpher-E 以平均 ROUGE-L 0.4986 最佳，優於 MoE-FedAvg 的 0.4927 與本地訓練的 0.4824；α=0.1 時兩變體皆顯著優於本地訓練並與 FedAvg 相當，其中 C 在摘要上較強、E 在分類上較佳，顯示客戶端中心與專家中心聚類捕捉互補的任務相似性。限制為僅在 Dolly-15K 與小規模客戶端設定下驗證。此工作顯示路由統計是免費且輕量的協作結構訊號。

links.title: LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset

evidence: Section VI-C: LAPF mean path length 512.83±26.78 m vs straight-line optimum 497.33 m; CoT LLM 619.16±29.01 m; results from three independent trials.

Section VI-D: obstacles injected by 'overriding the sensed clearance c_t at five pre-selected decision steps'; four register below d_safe=5 m; identical unsafe-event counts (mean 4.0) across methods; authors state this 'establishes mechanism correctness under a controlled stimulus'.
Section VI-E: 'the contribution of the visual channel is not isolated here... an image-ablated configuration is left to future work'; semantic and depth channels not fused.

Section IV-C / Property 1: corrective operator R is proven metric-neutral (Eq. 12), enforcement scored via N_h rather than path efficiency, and R is a deterministic contraction toward p_goal with kappa=0.5.
Section VI-B: baselines are only Pure LLM and CoT LLM on the same Qwen2-VL-7B backbone; no agentic-without-memory or classical planner baseline is evaluated.
Section VII: 'the current evaluation is limited to a single scene, one backbone, and three trials per configuration'.

Table IV: hyperparameters fully specified (Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct, mlx-vlm backend, temperature 0.7, horizon 110 steps, k=3 memory, d_safe=5 m); Section VI-A reports fallback never activated over 660 decision steps on a MacBook Air M5 with 16 GB.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical alignment with LLM agents, CoT, tool use, and prompting (Qwen2-VL backbone, memory/planning/action modules), applied to UAV navigation rather than pure robotics, so not capped. Novelty is incremental: the perceive-memory-plan-act loop and CoT reuse established agent patterns (ReAct/Reflexion-style); the genuinely new piece is the guaranteed-invocation hazard test with a deterministic, metric-neutral corrective operator (Property 1), which is a simple contraction toward the goal. Rigor is mixed: controls are careful (identical observation streams, same backbone, same C/H operators for baselines, explicit metric definitions), but there are no ablations isolating memory or the visual channel (Section VI-E admits image ablation is future work), no classical-planner or alternative agentic baseline, only n=3 trials, one scene (AMtown03), 41 frames cycled to 110 steps, and obstacles are synthetic overrides of c_t rather than real hazards (Section VI-D). Evidence supports only 'mechanism correctness under a controlled stimulus'; the headline 17-18% path reductions over weak non-agentic baselines in an open-loop replay protocol are modest and the near-100% efficiency partly reflects a metric that rewards collinear goal-directed commands. Generalizability is limited by single scene/backbone/dataset per the authors' own conclusion. Reproducibility is decent: full hyperparameter table (Table IV), prompt template (Fig. 4), algorithm pseudocode, open-weight model and consumer hardware, but no code release claim.

primary_link.title: LAPF: LLM-Agent-Based Path Finder Using the UAVScenes Dataset

radar.summary: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous navigation in complex outdoor environments, where dynamic conditions and mission requirements require intelligent adaptive decision-making. Existing optimization-based, Machine Learning (ML), and Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches often rely on predefined models or task-specific training, limiting their generalization and adaptability in uncertain scenarios. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted approaches offer pr
radar.summary_zh: 本論文提出 LAPF，一個以 LLM 代理為核心的無人機自主導航框架，針對傳統最佳化、機器學習與強化學習方法依賴預定義模型、泛化能力不足，以及單次 LLM 提示缺乏記憶、規劃與工具互動等問題。LAPF 將感知、記憶、規劃與行動四個模組整合於閉迴路認知架構，以 UAVScenes 資料集的 RGB 影像、LiDAR 摘要統計與 6-DoF 位姿作為多模態觀測，並透過保證呼叫的危障檢查，把每個偵測到的危險耦合到有界的修正動作。所有方法共用相同的 Qwen2-VL-7B 骨幹與觀測序列，整個評估在搭載 M5 晶片的筆記型電腦上本地運行，無需 fine-tuning。在 AMtown03 序列的開闊場域與障礙注入情境中，LAPF 平均路徑長度分別為 512.83 與 506.37 公尺，相對 497.33 公尺的直線最佳值達成 97.05% 與 98.09% 的路徑效率，並維持零 clamp 事件，而 CoT 提示的 clamp 事件從 9.7 增至 14.0。限制包括僅評估單一場景、每配置三組試驗、語義與深度通道尚未融合，且安全層採用保守的純量淨空訊號。此研究顯示代理架構中的記憶與工具強制行動，而非推理深度本身，才是可靠自主導航的關鍵。

links.title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs

evidence: Abstract: StructRL relocates policy stochasticity to the action space via a deterministic ODE decoder, structured action-space noise, and last-step replay for flow-based VLAs.

Sec. 3, Table 1: in-chain injection on GR00T N1.5 LIBERO-Long leaves output autocorrelation near SFT baseline (0.79/0.72/0.58) under rho_inj=0.95, while action-space injection shifts it to 0.70/0.64/0.63.
Sec. 5.2, Table 3 (ManiSkill): endpoint Gaussian Baseline improves OOD average over Flow-SDE by 28.0 points on pi0 (39.3%->67.3%) and 16.6 on pi0.5 (49.3%->65.9%); StructRL OOD avg 66.8/70.3.

Sec. 5.3, Fig. 3(a-d): four ablations on LIBERO-Long (noise level, injection scheme, train-inference consistency, denoising steps T in {2,3,4,5}) support efficiency rather than final-performance claims.
Sec. 5.4, Fig. 4: real-world Franka FR3 pick-banana reaches 84% SR (21/25) vs Gaussian baseline 56% (14/25) after 60 min online RL with AWAC; small sample counts.
App. G, Tables G1-G2: full hyperparameter tables for LIBERO/CALVIN/ManiSkill; project page listed but no explicit code or artifact release statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Technically solid RL-for-robotics paper: identifies 'Structured Noise Dilution' in flow-based VLA denoising chains, moves exploration to the action space (AR(1) temporal correlation, group-aware scales) with last-step replay for tractable likelihoods. Verification experiments (Sec. 3, App. B), three backbones, three sim benchmarks, two real tasks, and controlled ablations (Sec. 5.3) are well designed, and hyperparameters/pseudocode are supplied (App. A, G). However, this is pure robotics/embodied-AI work: the contribution is exploration-noise structure and policy-gradient plumbing for manipulation policies, with no language-model methodology; the VLM backbone (PaliGemma features, App. E) is inherited and unstudied. Under the curation policy, pure robotics is out of scope and capped at 0.20 despite strong internal quality. Minor quality caveats: no error bars/seeds in main tables, no explicit code-release claim (only a project page), and real-world comparisons use small trial counts (21/25 vs 14/25).

primary_link.title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs

radar.summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are now widely used for continuous robotic manipulation, and online reinforcement learning (RL) is emerging as a key technique for adapting them to new tasks. Existing RL methods typically inject stochasticity inside the denoising chain, often through isotropic or temporally independent noise. However, effective robot exploration calls for structured noise: temporally smooth and scaled differently across action groups. We show that simply switching
radar.summary_zh: 流匹配動作頭已成為視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型的主流設計，而線上強化學習（RL）是將此類模型適應新任務的關鍵技術。既有方法多在去噪鏈內注入各向同性或時間獨立的雜訊，但機器人探索需要結構化雜訊：時間上平滑，且對位置、旋轉、夾爪等動作群組採用不同尺度。作者指出在中間流時間注入的雜訊會被剩餘去噪步驟稀釋，稱為結構化雜訊稀釋（Structured Noise Dilution）。StructRL 將策略隨機性移至動作空間，包含三個耦合設計：確定性 ODE 解碼器、直接在動作空間注入具 AR(1) 時間相關與群組感知尺度的結構化雜訊，以及最後一步重放，使策略梯度更新無需為中間去噪狀態定義似然。在 π0、π0.5 與 GR00T N1.5 三個骨幹上，LIBERO 平均成功率達 99.0%，ManiSkill 的 OOD 比較顯示注入位置本身貢獻主要增益；真實 Franka 機器人搭配 AWAC，pick-banana 於 60 分鐘達 84% 成功率，高斯基線僅 56%。飽和後最終效能可能與高斯基線相近，結構化探索主要提升學習效率。此工作證明探索雜訊的注入位置與結構設計對高效 VLA 適應至關重要。
radar.title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs
radar.title_zh: StructRL：針對流式 VLA 的結構化動作空間探索

links.title: Perspective-Invariant Attack with Enhanced Transferability of Adversarial Examples

evidence: Section IV-B, Table II: with RN-50 surrogate, PIA-Mix averages 85.5% ASR vs SID 82.2% and PIA alone 82.9% across eight targets on the ImageNet-compatible dataset.

Section IV-E, Table VIII: MLLM attacks on 100 sampled images against Qwen2-VL, Claude-3.5, GPT-4o; PIA-Mix reaches 66.0%/75.0% (closed/open) vs SID 59.3%/66.0%; open-ended protocol uses a separate LLM judge (Claude-3.5).
Section IV, Table IX (Stability Analysis): mean and std over 5 independent runs; max std for PIA-Mix is 0.30%, below BSR (0.81%) and SID (0.64%).
Section V-C, Table XII: PIA+SID pool (0.5,0.5) attains 85.5% average ASR vs 83.5% for SID+BSR+SIA without PIA, with total transformed copies N kept constant at 20.

Section IV-A, Implementation Details: delta_max=0.6, vertex mode distribution pi=(0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1), N=20, MI-FGSM with eps=16/255, T=10; no code or artifact availability statement appears in the paper.
Section V-D and Figure 5: tuned sweeps show affine peaks ~76%, TPS below 75%, elastic below 70%, all below the 8-DOF perspective baseline of 80.7%.
Table V: computational cost PIA 0.739 s/image vs SID 1.217 s; adding PIA to L2T/OPS raises time only marginally (8.184 s vs 8.127 s; 6.373 s vs 6.311 s).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed adversarial-ML paper whose core contribution (PIA/PIA-Mix, an 8-DOF perspective input transformation for transfer-based attacks on image classifiers) matches the AI Safety preference (adversarial/attack/defense/robustness) but offers little language-model methodology; LLM relevance is confined to one secondary experiment attacking Qwen2-VL/Claude-3.5/GPT-4o on 100 images with an LLM-as-judge protocol, so preference relevance is partial rather than capped as pure CV. Novelty is incremental: projective warping is a natural extension of DI/SIA/BSR/SID, with the multi-DOF vertex sampling hierarchy and Lemma 1 as modest new elements. Rigor is high: 8 targets x 4 surrogates (Table II), 12 defense configurations (Table VI), CIFAR-10 and ensemble transfer (Tables IV/VII), 5-run variance analysis (Table IX), and thorough ablations including tuned sweeps against affine/TPS/elastic alternatives (Section V-D). Evidence is solid though headline gains over SID are small for PIA alone (82.9 vs 82.2 avg ASR, Table II) and hyperparameters (delta_max=0.6) were tuned on the evaluation benchmark; MLLM results rest on only 100 samples. Generalizability is demonstrated across architectures, two datasets, and three attack frameworks, all within image classification. Reproducibility benefits from a fully specified algorithm and hyperparameters (delta_max=0.6, pi=(0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1), N=20) on public data, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Perspective-Invariant Attack with Enhanced Transferability of Adversarial Examples

radar.summary: Adversarial examples generated on a surrogate deep neural network (DNN) can often successfully fool other black-box DNN models. This cross-model transferability poses serious security threats to DNNs in practical applications. Input transformation techniques are widely used to enhance adversarial transferability by increasing the diversity of input images. However, existing methods primarily rely on local operations with limited degrees of freedom (DOF), such as block-wise shuffling and resizing

III-E), so LLM preference signals are present but peripheral — the dominant domain is embodied manipulation, keeping relevance well below frontier-LLM work yet above out-of-scope pure robotics since language-model token conditioning and LoRA fine-tuning are integral. Novelty is solid: unifying memory read/write in one cross-attention stack with learned update gates, existence probabilities, and insertion/pruning is a genuine step beyond MemoryVLA's 2D bank and ConceptGraphs' hand-crafted rules (Sec. II-A), though the emergent-eta claim resembles prior learned-gating ideas. Rigor is decent: 10 published LIBERO baselines, matched-backbone control, and a thorough Table III ablation ladder (passive memory +8.0, learned gate +2.4, unified vs decoupled +2.3, capacity curve peaking at 32K). IV-A) introduce a view-availability confound only partially mitigated by the Fig. 7 view-count ablation, three seeds averaged with no variance or significance testing reported, and no limitations discussion or code availability claim in the Conclusion. primary_link.title: GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

radar.summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally relies on persistent spatial memory. However, existing 3D memory systems function merely as passive recorders: they store observations using fixed, hand-crafted rules, treating every scene element--whether a critical grasp target or an irrelevant background wall--with equal importance. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from passive storage to active, task-driven spatial memory. We argue that a robot's memory should not simply record what i
radar.summary_zh: 長時程機器人操作依賴持續的空間記憶，但既有 3D 記憶系統多為被動記錄器：以固定規則儲存觀測，對抓取目標與背景一視同仁。本文主張記憶應從被動儲存轉向主動、任務驅動的學習，提出 GaussMemory，以 3D Gaussian Splatting 作為持久幾何基底，每個高斯攜帶時間戳、物件身分與存在機率等時間元資料。核心為統一記憶注意力（UMA）：單一交叉注意力模組同時讀取記憶以預測動作並寫回更新，使記憶生命週期端對端可微，讓任務需求塑造更新策略，記憶狀態則回饋影響動作讀取。系統採用與 OpenVLA 相同的 Prismatic VLM 骨幹（Llama-2-7B）與擴散動作頭，確保效能差異僅來自記憶機制。在 LIBERO 上，GaussMemory 於 Goal 與 Long-10 分別達 96.8% 與 94.1%，超越 MemoryVLA；在 VLABench 上超越 π0-FAST 達 +5.2%（Track 1）與 +6.0%（Track 6）。湧現的更新閘門呈雙峰分布：受操作物件約 0.74、背景約 0.06。消融證實 3D 幾何表徵比 2D 記憶更關鍵，記憶收益隨任務時程增長。限制包括需多視角輸入並渲染虛擬視點。此為首個將 3DGS 整合為 VLA 時間場景記憶的工作。
radar.title: GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
radar.title_zh: GaussMemory：用於長時程機器人操作的任務驅動 3D 高斯場景記憶

llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM-application paper (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) for AI-generated image detection that sits between Multimodal AI/Prompting/LoRA-fine-tuning preferences and a CV-forensics task; it is not pure CV (evolutionary instruction search with GPT-4o and label-conditioned text training are genuine language methodology), so the out-of-scope cap is not applied, but the language side is auxiliary and text faithfulness is explicitly not evaluated. Novelty is incremental: binary-supervised VLM detectors exist (FakeVLM, FakeReasoning, AIGI-Holmes), prompt-pool evolution resembles APE/OPRO, and self-generated rationale distillation is STaR-like. Rigor is supported by component ablations, prompt-sensitivity analysis, and hyperparameter sweeps, but the closest VLM-based competitors are absent from the comparison tables, only one baseline is a stated reproduction, no seed/variance reporting, and intro citations include tangentially related works. primary_link.title: UC-VLM: Consistency-Driven Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection with Vision-Language Large Models

radar.summary: Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) are promising for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection because they can produce both a prediction and a natural-language output. However, most existing VLLM-based detectors primarily fine-tune the language side while giving limited attention to low-level visual forensic cues. They also often depend on manually crafted prompts or human-annotated rationales, which limits scalability.We present UC-VLM, a unified multi-stage framework for AIGI detection that relie
radar.summary_zh: AI生成影像（AIGI）偵測中，現有以VLLM為基礎的偵測器多只微調語言端，忽略低階視覺鑑識線索，且依賴人工設計的提示與人工標註的解釋，難以擴充。本文提出UC-VLM，一個僅使用二元（真實/生成）標籤的統一多階段學習框架，以Qwen2.5-VL-7B為骨幹。其核心是將同一組二元標籤重複作為共享監督訊號：(i)視覺適應階段透過隨機裁切與patch隨機重排，抑制高階語義、強化對非語義鑑識線索的敏感度；(ii)指令最佳化以LLM自動生成、評估並演化指令池，選出最穩定的Prompt-B，降低對提示措辭的敏感度；(iii)標籤條件化再生成以二元標籤監督文字輸出，凍結視覺編碼器後以LoRA微調語言模組，無需人工理由標註。實驗顯示UC-VLM在GenImage達96.1%平均準確率，較最強先前方法DEUA提升4.6%；在Chameleon於ProGAN/SDV1.4訓練下達69.6%/77.9%，較最佳基線AIDE提升11.2%/15.3%。消融實驗證明三元件互補，單獨微調視覺或語言端皆不足。限制方面，生成文字僅為輔助訓練訊號，不保證忠實反映影像證據，可能出現幻覺；對極度擬真的生成影像與藝術風格圖像仍可能誤判。此工作顯示弱二元監督可在視覺與語言兩端轉化為有效訓練訊號，兼具可擴充性與穩定性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A 3D vision-language systems paper: open-vocabulary language grounding onto reconstructed articulated assets with structured graph-to-graph assignment, calibrated abstention, and typed joint actuation. Topic fit to the stated preferences is partial: strong on multimodal/vision-language (frozen FG-CLIP2 distillation, VLM proposals) and adjacent to robotics/embodied AI, but the core method contains no LLM (parser is rule-based/typed), no agentic loop, no reasoning/CoT or Japanese-NLP content; GPT-4o appears only as a weak baseline probe. We present ArtLang, a framework for open-vocabulary language control of persistent reconstructed articulated assets. ArtLang represents an asset as a semantic-kinematic articulation graph and augments its surface with language features and graph-constrained motion. Open-vocabulary proposals are
radar.summary_zh: 關節式物件的3D重建雖能還原幾何與運動學，但部件缺乏語義標籤，使用者只能以索引與數值關節參數操作。本文提出ArtLang，將重建資產表示為語義—運動學關節圖，並在表面附加開放詞彙語言特徵與圖約束運動，實現對持久重建資產的自然語言控制。系統以ArtMesh為重建骨幹，透過FG-CLIP2蒸餾稠密語言特徵，並以投影式匈牙利匹配（含私有虛擬節點）將視覺語言提案綁定到部件，允許不確定部件保持未命名。型別化解析器將指令轉為指令圖，含指稱表達、動作、量值、參考框架與關係；再以全域圖對圖接地問題聯合推理語義、空間、關係與動作—關節相容性，求解為MILP，支援空指派與模糊時棄權。接受的指令經型別化目標轉換映射為觀測運動範圍內的連續關節座標，並以順向運動學執行。在Articulate-100、mesh輸入設定與真實SplArt擷取上，ArtLang於關節恢復與語言接地（L-Sem/L-Spat/L-M）皆優於OPD、Articulate-Anything、ArtGS與GaussianArt；消融顯示語義、空間與運動三軸各自不可或缺。限制包括需兩個觀測姿態、動作詞彙有限，且失敗常源自上游視覺語言提案之錯誤命名。此工作填補了自然語言與關節資產之間的操作介面缺口。

links.title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback

evidence: Abstract: claims 'the first results for this setting, including O(T^{3/4}) static, adaptive, and dynamic regret' for adversarial OCO with dueling feedback via the DTFO reduction.

Table 1 (Sec 1) and Appendix A Table 2: prior continuous dueling methods are restricted to stationary/stochastic or linear settings (DB-regret, offline sample complexity, contextual BR-regret), supporting the first-results novelty claim.

Section 2, Assumption 1 and Remark 1: requires rho'(0)=gamma>0 and bounded curvature; Algorithm 1's estimator g_hat_t = d/(2*gamma*delta) * o_t * u_t presupposes knowledge of gamma, a restriction vs. Saha et al. (2025) that is not discussed as a limitation.

Appendix D (proof of Lemma 1): fully derives deterministic norm bound ||g_hat_t|| = d/(2*gamma*delta) and bias ||B_t|| <= (d*M*G^2/gamma)*delta via exact second-order Taylor expansion of the transfer function.

Appendix F, proof of Corollary 7: the additive penalty D * sum Psi_t ||A_t^{-1}||_2 is dismissed with a qualitative 'bounded accumulation' remark while the text concedes ||A_t^{-1}||_2 'diverges as iterates approach the boundary', leaving a gap in the claimed O(T^{2/3}) smooth-case proof.

Abstract/Table 1 report O(sqrt(T log T)) for strongly convex & smooth objectives, while Corollary 8 and its proof yield O(sqrt(T) log T) with eta ∝ 1/sqrt(T), delta=1 - an inconsistent rate statement.

Section 6 (Conclusion) and full document: purely theoretical; no experiments, no code or artifact availability statements, and no lower bounds establishing optimality of the T^{3/4} general-convex rate.
Appendix F, Lemma 7 proof: final displayed equation omits the square on ||g||_2 present in the lemma statement (minor typo, statement itself is standard).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Pure online-learning theory paper: first regret guarantees for adversarial OCO under 1-bit dueling feedback via a Duel-To-First-Order reduction. Its connection to the stated preferences is motivational only (intro cites RLHF/DPO/LLM alignment; dueling feedback is the RLHF abstraction), with no language methodology, experiments, or LLM content, so topical fit is low. Within its niche the contribution is genuinely new: Table 1 and Appendix A Table 2 show prior continuous dueling work (Kumagai 2017; Saha et al. 2025; Saha & Schapire 2025) is stationary/stochastic or linear. Proofs for the main DTFO framework are detailed and largely verifiable, but the smooth-case additive bias term is hand-waved, the strongly-convex-and-smooth rate is inconsistently reported across abstract vs. Corollary 8, the estimator requires knowing the transfer slope gamma (not flagged as a limitation), and there are no experiments, lower bounds, or code.

primary_link.title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback

radar.summary: We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. While dueling feedback is well understood in discrete or stochastic settings, the adversarial convex setting has remained unexplored. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yiel
radar.summary_zh: 偏好式學習中常只有一比特的成對比較（對決）回饋，但對抗式線上凸最佳化在此設定下先前從未被研究。本文提出Duel-To-First-Order（DTFO）包裝器，將對決回饋化約為近似梯度：在縮減域內於對稱擾動點查詢偏好，經球面平滑與對傳遞函數的泰勒展開分析，構造有界且偏差可控的梯度估計器，進而套用任何現成的一階OCO演算法，並證明通用的區間遺憾移轉定理。以不同基礎演算法實例化，得到一般凸函數O(T^{3/4})的靜態、自適應與動態遺憾；強凸假設下改善為O(T^{2/3})。針對平滑目標，作者提出以self-concordant barrier為正則的FTRL搭配橢球梯度估計器，並透過球面四階動差恆等式使病態條件數懲罰在內積中恰好抵銷，達成平滑凸O(T^{2/3})與強凸且平滑O(√(T log T))的靜態遺憾，匹配單點bandit最佳化已知最佳速率。假設涵蓋傳遞函數於原點斜率為正且曲率有界，包含Bradley–Terry等常見偏好模型。限制：平滑設定僅提供靜態遺憾保證；擴充至K>2排序回饋與一般偏好模型留待未來。此結果首次在僅一比特比較回饋下橋接偏好學習與一階OCO理論，對大型語言模型對齊等應用具理論意義。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A document-parsing benchmark for two document-level tasks (TOC hierarchy recovery and typed contextual relationship recovery) plus a long-document QA utility study. Moderately relevant to stated preferences: it evaluates several LLMs (GPT-5.6-Sol, MiniMax-M2.5, GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.6, Qwen3.5) on relationship recovery (Table 5) and connects document structure to BM25/RAG-style retrieval QA (Section 3.6), but the core contribution is a document-AI benchmark rather than LLM/language methodology, so relevance is mid-range rather than capped as pure CV. Novelty is moderate: it differentiates from FinTOC, HRDoc, MPDocBench-Parse, and MinerU-Popo via unified, human-verified, type-specific (caption/note/source) evaluation, but builds on TEDS and existing protocols. Rigor is reasonable (multi-stage annotation, expert QA, with/without-ignorable ablation, controlled QA conditions sharing parsed content, prompt, and answer model), but weakened by annotation candidates seeded by TextIn—which is also the top-scoring TOC system (Section 2.2 vs Table 4), a potential bias; no inter-annotator agreement, no significance testing, unspecified QA test-set size, and a single answer model. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 5 macro means check out; Table 7 deltas 12.97/14.64/21.31 points are arithmetically correct), and the page-level vs document-level gap (Overall 93.54–95.96 in Table 6 vs ≤0.55/0.63) is a clear diagnostic finding. Generalizability is limited by 85 documents concentrated in finance (42/85). Reproducibility benefits from a claimed public release of benchmark, protocol, and testbed, but no concrete link is shown, key details are deferred to an appendix absent from the text, and several evaluated systems are proprietary.

primary_link.title: LongDocBench: Benchmarking TOC Hierarchy and Contextual Relationship Recovery in Long Documents

radar.summary: Parsing visual documents into machine-readable representations is fundamental to document intelligence. Existing benchmarks focus on page-level element recognition, reading order, formula recognition, and table structure. Long documents, however, also require document-level structure recovery. This includes reconstructing cross-page table-of-contents (TOC) hierarchies and identifying typed links from tables and figures to their captions, notes, and sources, often in one-to-many form. Because the
radar.summary_zh: 現有文件解析基準多聚焦頁面層級元素辨識與閱讀順序，但長文件還需要文件層級結構還原：跨頁重建目錄（TOC）層級，以及辨識表格/圖片與其標題、註解、來源間（常為一對多）的型別化連結。本文提出LongDocBench，含85份真實財報、教科書與學術論文，共2,582頁（最長105頁），提供人工核驗的3,937個標題節點（平均深度3.55、最深9層）與橫跨2,680個表格/圖片物件的3,258條型別化脈絡關係。標註流程為TextIn預標註、全文件人工校正，加上自動驗證與兩階段專家審查。以TEDS與文字編輯相似度評估，頂尖解析器（TextIn、MinerU2.5-Pro等）在TOC還原最佳僅0.55 Macro TEDS，脈絡關係還原最佳Macro為0.63（GPT-5.6-Sol），其中註解關係最難（0.16–0.42），遠低於其頁面層級表現（Overall皆逾93.5）。問答實驗顯示人工核驗的TOC與關係將準確率從BM25基線的32.98%提升至54.29%，兩者資訊互補；自動還原結構僅達37.86%，顯示還原品質仍不足以發揮完整下游效益。限制為基準規模與涵蓋範圍有限，但已確立文件層級組織還原為重要且尚未被充分解決的能力。

links.title: A Constant-Competitive Algorithm for Dynamic Mixture-of-Experts Serving

evidence: Abstract: claims E[ALG] <= 10*C_PB*OPT + (5*C_PB+2)*k + 16, machine-checked in Lean 4 relative to explicit source interfaces for two cited theorems.
Section 2: defines the integral MoE state space, reciprocal-max service cost f_t(x)=max_i r_t,i/(1+x_i), and the fixed-sequence (oblivious-adversary) convention.
Section 4, Lemma 2: proven tangent envelope with identity r/q - L_{r,p}(u) = r(q-p)^2/(qp^2) >= 0 and 3/4-approximation via p=ceil(q); finite grid of size 2k+1.
Section 5.1, Lemma 4: balanced projection map (8) shown nonexpansive, exact-budget, removing positive-body resource augmentation at epsilon=1.
Section 5.2: charging argument yields sum_t f_t(x(u_t)) <= (4/3)M + 16/3 using resets delta_t = 2^-t with sum delta_t = 1; error terms verified to telescope to 16/3.
Section 6: lifted comparator path movement bounded by k + 2*cost(y), giving M <= C_PB(k + 2*OPT) from Theorem 1.1 of [1]; final assembly matches Theorem 1 arithmetic.

Section 7: Lean 4.32.2 / Mathlib 4.32.2, SHA-256 artifact hashes, 24 passing tests, deliberately corrupted negative control, and claimed independent replay; no repository URL or artifact-hosting link is provided in the text.
Section 8: explicit scope limits — deterministic integral ratio, adaptive adversary, best constant, and bit-complexity implementation left open.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A pure online-algorithms theory paper proving a Theta(1) randomized competitive ratio for dynamic Mixture-of-Experts serving, improving the prior O(sqrt(log k)) primal bound. Topic relevance is moderate: MoE, serving, and inference optimization match the preference profile, but the text contains no LLM/language-model content beyond the MoE-serving framing. Novelty is solid if the claimed open-problem resolution holds, resting on a new finite tangent-envelope reduction to positive-body chasing plus a balanced projection. Rigor is reasonably high: the presented chain (Lemma 2 tangent envelope, Lemma 4 nonexpansive projection, 4/3 M + 16/3 charging with summable 2^-t resets, k+2·OPT comparator lift, final 10·C_PB assembly) is internally consistent and checkable, with external theorems [1] and [2] used as explicitly declared interfaces that cannot be verified from the text. Evidence is theoretical (formal Lean 4 proof, rational controls, a corrupted negative control) with no empirical workload validation. Reproducibility claims are unusually specific (versions, hashes, replay commands, 24 tests, independent replay) but no public repository URL is given. Scope is honestly limited: deterministic ratio, adaptive adversary, and optimal constant remain open, and the result is specific to reciprocal-max service cost.

primary_link.title: A Constant-Competitive Algorithm for Dynamic Mixture-of-Experts Serving

radar.summary: Huang, Lou, and Xiao introduced Dynamic Mixture-of-Experts Serving and gave an O(sqrt(log k))-competitive randomized algorithm for its integral primal problem, where k is the number of replica GPUs beyond the mandatory copy of each expert. Their matching lower barrier applies to an auxiliary dual and leaves the primal order open. We prove that the randomized primal competitive ratio is in fact Theta(1) for arbitrary numbers of experts. The upper bound reduces reciprocal-max service costs to chas
radar.summary_zh: 動態混合專家(Mixture-of-Experts)服務須在工作負載變化時決定每位專家要配置多少個副本 GPU:移動副本有切換成本,複製不足則推遲瓶頸延遲。先前研究對此線上問題提出競爭比為 O(√log k) 的隨機演算法(k 為額外副本 GPU 數),但其下界只建立在輔助對偶問題上,原始問題的漸近階仍屬未知。本文證明原始問題其實具有常數競爭比:核心觀察是倒數型服務成本的上圖可用有限切線包絡在常數因子內近似,因而可約化為追趕正體(positive bodies)的已知定理;作者再以可加總、幾何縮小的重置把累積服務成本轉為移動成本,並以非擴張的平衡投影消除資源擴增,最後結合 Lazy Threshold Rounding 得到整數線上演算法。主要定理給出 E[ALG] ≤ 10·C_PB·OPT + (5·C_PB+2)k + 16,乘性常數與專家數、GPU 數與時程長度皆無關。整個約化、捨入組合與定理均以 Lean 4 機器化驗證,並附獨立重播與確定性有理數控制。限制在於未確定最佳數值常數、確定性整數競爭比與適應性對手下的表現仍待研究。此結果釐清動態 MoE 服務的理論難度,對大型模型的 GPU 分派具有指標意義。
radar.title: A Constant-Competitive Algorithm for Dynamic Mixture-of-Experts Serving
radar.title_zh: 動態混合專家服務的常數競爭比演算法

links.title: BOCoDe: Engineering-Centered Benchmarking for Bayesian Optimization

evidence: Abstract: 'an open-source, PyTorch-native benchmark comprising 307 BBO problems, including 159 engineering design tasks'; machine-readable metadata 'supports programmatic discovery, including by LLM-based agents' — the only substantive LLM/agent connection.

§3.2 and §5.3: surrogate swap limited to GP/RF/TabPFN(v3)/TabICL(v2); 'TabICL is statistically tied with the GP' (CD=0.69 SCBO, CD=0.38 TuRBO) while TabPFN and RF rank below — tabular, not language, foundation models.

Appendix F, Table 6: SO-Mixed-Variable/Engineering Friedman p=3.98e-01 and SO-Unconstrained/HPO p=3.46e-01 are non-significant; SO-Unconstrained/Engineering p=2.80e-02 is only marginal, and §5.1 reports 'all six methods fall within a single critical difference (rank spread 0.82 vs. CD 0.89 on engineering)'.

Appendix F (Rank transfer): single-objective transfer correlations weak/insignificant (SO-Unconstrained Eng↔Syn τ=+0.47 p=0.27; SO-Mixed-Variable Eng↔Syn τ=-0.20), while constrained/MO classes transfer (τ=+0.67 to +0.73); authors concede 'at most k=6 methods... these tests have little power, so we read the table as trends'.
Table 3, §5.1: feasibility rates drop from 0.94–1.00 on synthetic to 0.51–0.91 on engineering SO-Constrained problems (CLF-CBO 0.51, Penalty 0.64), supporting the domain-gap claim.

Appendices D–F: pinned BoTorch v0.18.1, GPyTorch v1.15.2, PyTorch v2.11.0, pymoo v0.6.2; 25 seeds, n_init=D, 250-evaluation budget with equalized evaluation accounting (Table 5); code and data at https://github.com/rosenyu304/BOCoDe; PyPI release promised after acceptance.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A Bayesian-optimization benchmarking paper (307 problems, 159 engineering, 31 algorithms, statistical ranking protocol) that sits almost entirely outside the LLM/agent preference space. LLM relevance is incidental: one sentence on LLM agents selecting problems via metadata (Abstract, §3.1.1) and tabular (non-language) foundation models as swappable BO surrogates (§3.2, §5.3); keyword matches like 'benchmark'/'foundation model' reflect spirit mismatch, not LLM methodology. On its own merits it is strong: novelty is moderate-at-scale (first large-scale BO rank-transfer study, but aggregative — problems and algorithms largely curated from prior work; TabICL-as-surrogate is a small new empirical result). Rigor is high (Friedman/Iman-Davenport, Nemenyi with Holm-Wilcoxon confirmation on small panels, Cliff's δ, family-clustered bootstrap, equal-budget accounting, three ablations), and reproducibility is excellent (public repo, pinned versions, seeds, full per-problem tables). Evidence strength is tempered by the paper's own admissions: the headline 'rankings do not transfer' partly rests on panels that are non-significant (SO-Mixed-Variable/Engineering p=0.40; SO-Unconstrained/HPO p=0.35) or marginal (p=0.028) with compressed ranks, transfer correlations are underpowered (k≤6), and the constrained/MO classes actually do transfer (τ=+0.67–0.73). Weighted score reflects genuinely high execution but low preference fit.

primary_link.title: BOCoDe: Engineering-Centered Benchmarking for Bayesian Optimization

radar.summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a sample-efficient, surrogate-based approach to black-box optimization (BBO), but its evaluation remains dominated by synthetic functions and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) tasks that are typically low-dimensional and single-objective. Engineering design poses a substantially different regime: problems are physics-based, often high-dimensional, constrained by requirements such as cost and manufacturability, and may involve multiple objectives or mixed variables.
radar.summary_zh: 貝氏最佳化(BO)的評估長期仰賴合成函數與超參數最佳化(HPO)任務,多為低維、單目標,與實際工程設計問題常見的受限、多目標、混合變數與高維特性差距甚遠。本文提出 BOCoDe,一個 PyTorch 原生的開源基準,收錄 307 個黑盒最佳化問題,其中 159 個為工程設計任務,另有 68 個合成與 80 個 HPO 參考問題;每個問題皆有可引用來源與機器可讀中繼資料,支援以 LLM 代理程式化選取,並透過統一 API 與 31 個 BO 及演化演算法介接。研究以 Friedman、Nemenyi 與 Wilcoxon 等統計檢定建立排名協定,在五類問題上完成約 36,000 次執行的大規模評測。主要發現:最佳方法會隨領域改變,合成基準上的排名無法可靠轉移到工程任務;工程問題獨佔受限、多目標與混合變數區域;在工程問題上,表格式基礎模型 TabICL 作為代理模型可與 Gaussian process 統計上並列,TabPFN 與隨機森林則較弱;受限方法在工程問題上的可行率明顯偏低。限制為涵蓋仍不完整,多目標混合變數問題與代理模型的多目標擴充尚待補足。此基準證明工程設計是不同而非更難的測試情境,對 BO 方法開發具長期價值。
radar.title: BOCoDe: Engineering-Centered Benchmarking for Bayesian Optimization
radar.title_zh: BOCoDe:以工程設計為中心的貝氏最佳化基準測試

links.title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs' presented as a 'Proof-of-Concept (PoC) demo' with radar charts and decision indicators, not an evaluation study.

Section 2: 'In the PoC, these are self-reported and single-channel validation of state-of-the-art approaches for each dimension are relegated to future work.' — admits no validated measurement of MSV dimensions.
Section 4: only 'three representative query types' (factual/technical/complex) with qualitative screenshots (Figures 2 and 5); no metrics, baselines, or comparisons anywhere in the paper.

Section 2.3: implementation is '˜1,500 LOC, publicly available at the above link', using 'llama 3.2 via ollama' and 'FastAPI, HTMX, and Bokeh' on 'a Macbook M3 Pro with 18GB of RAM' — supports reproducibility but also shows toy scale.

Section 2.2: Scalability/role-based clustering for 'ensesembles beyond 5 nodes' (high CI >70, EM >80, PI >75 triggers) is described prospectively with no experiments; early-stopping thresholds like 'exceed 85%' or 'below 20%' are arbitrary examples.
Section 2.1: aggregation weights (α, β, δ, ω, w_k) in MSV formulas and role-transition vectors are stated as 'learned or manually configured' with no learning procedure or values given.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic for LLMs, multi-agent orchestration, and deliberative reasoning (System 1/2 routing, role assignment via Hungarian algorithm, graph-based control), which aligns strongly with high-weight preferences (LLMs, Agents, Reasoning). However, this is a demo/proof-of-concept paper with no baselines, no quantitative evaluation, no ablations, and no user study; all MSV dimensions are self-reported with unspecified weights, and support consists of three cherry-picked toy queries (capital of California, FFT, '10% of brain'). The framework itself was defined in prior work (Sethi et al., CIKM 2025), so the contribution is an implementation plus UI, moderately novel in packaging but composed of standard ensemble/role-assignment machinery. Reproducibility is decent on paper (public ~1,500 LOC codebase, llama 3.2 via ollama, FastAPI/HTMX/Bokeh, stated hardware), though key thresholds and weights are unreported and the artifact cannot be verified from the text. Scalability and clustering claims are speculative. Overall: relevant topic, weak research evidence.

primary_link.title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs

radar.summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms.
  Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantify
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型(LLM)難以評估自身不確定性、偵測知識衝突或辨識超出能力的問題,削弱可靠性與信任。本文實作首個針對 LLM 整體(ensemble)的後設認知框架:以認知心理學為基礎,計算五維的後設認知狀態向量 MSV,涵蓋情緒反應、正確性評估、經驗匹配、衝突資訊與問題重要性,同時支撐監控與控制。系統依 MSV 閾值自動在 System 1(快速、單節點或平行 bagging)與 System 2(審慎、多節點循序 boosting)之間切換;另建圖論控制層,以 Hungarian 演算法解決角色指派衝突,讓節點扮演領域專家、評論者、評估者、綜合者與通才,邊權重則由各節點的 MSV 動態調變,並支援大規模下的角色群聚與階層組織。概念驗證以約 1,500 行 Python 搭配 llama 3.2(經 ollama)與 FastAPI、HTMX、Bokeh 介面完成,提供雷達圖、決策指標與網路圖視覺化。展示例子顯示簡單事實查詢走 System 1,技術與複雜查詢觸發 System 2。限制是 MSV 為自我回報、各維度僅單通道,驗證屬質性展示,尚無量化實驗。此工作為 LLM 自我調節的多代理架構提供可行性證明與後續研究方向。

links.title: A Pilot Study of Autocompleting Tokenizers

evidence: Abstract: 'On English–French, our best method preserves translation performance while reducing source sequence length by nearly one-third... compression ratios between 0.47 and 0.67' across Finnish, Russian, Chinese pairs
Section 4.1, Table 1: Implicit Sentinel (Absolute α=0.9) reaches chrF 60.3 / BLEU 33.3 at compression ratio 0.679 vs uncompressed byte baseline chrF 60.4 / BLEU 33.2, supporting the parity claim
Section 4.1, Figure 3: 'No Vowels' and 'First Three' baselines underperform the Sentinel-Free scheme, used to argue the autocomplete model adds value over naive deletion
Section 4.1: baselines in Table 1/Figure 3 are all byte-level variants (Byte, No Vowels, First Three); no subword/BPE comparison is reported anywhere in the paper

Section 4.2, Table 2: ru-en chrF improves from 47.1 to 54.9 (ratio 0.468) under Implicit Sentinel (abs, α=0.8) in a single setting; Section 4.2 admits 'some training examples exceed the maximum sequence length... leading to truncation', an uncontrolled confound for the improvement

Section 4.1: full training protocol reported — 12 encoder/12 decoder layers, d_model=1024, Adafactor, weight decay 0.01, batch 32, 600k steps, beam 4, HF evaluate v0.4.3 SacreBLEU/chrF, single Nvidia RTX A6000 (footnote 2); no code or seed release mentioned
Appendix A, Figure 5: omission analysis shows >90% of Finnish UTF-8 continuation bytes and 54% of Russian lead bytes removed vs ~12-25% of ASCII letters, explaining why non-Latin scripts benefit more
Section 5 (Conclusion): stated limitations — 'experiments focus exclusively on machine translation', fixed predictor architecture, source-side compression only, target side left to future work
llm_evaluation.rationale: A competent, honestly-scoped pilot study on predictability-based byte compression for Transformer inputs. Preference relevance is moderate: it intersects tokenization/efficiency for Transformers and NLP (machine translation), but it does not engage the heavily weighted preference areas (LLMs, agents, reasoning, Japanese NLP) — the LLM connection is only cited motivation (BLT, Lester et al.) and experiments never touch LLM-scale settings. Novelty is moderate: the core insight (predictable regions need less explicit representation) is shared with BLT and neurally compressed text; the contribution is a middle-ground selective-omission scheme with four sentinel variants, a reasonable but incremental design space. Rigor is mixed: 26 controlled configurations with scheme/threshold ablations and sanity baselines (No Vowels, First Three), but no subword/BPE baseline, single runs with no seeds or significance testing, and the large ru-en gain (chrF 47.1→54.9) is confounded with truncation effects that the paper acknowledges but does not control. Evidence strength is solid on En-Fr (parity claim at ratio 0.679 matches Table 1: chrF 60.3 vs 60.4, BLEU 33.3 vs 33.2) and includes a useful byte-category analysis (Appendix A), but cross-language improvement claims rest on one setting and one run each. Generalizability is decent across scripts/morphology for translation only; extension to other tasks or target-side compression is deferred. Reproducibility is fair: detailed architectures, optimizer, steps, thresholds, evaluation tooling, and hardware are reported, but no code release and no seeds.

primary_link.title: A Pilot Study of Autocompleting Tokenizers

radar.summary: Modern input methods routinely rely on autocomplete to omit information that can be recovered from local context. Inspired by these autocomplete-assisted writing systems, we investigate whether Transformer inputs can be compressed in a similar manner. Byte-level tokenization offers a simple and language-independent alternative to subword tokenization, but its longer input sequences typically result in increased computational cost and reduced model quality. We propose a compression scheme that em
radar.summary_zh: 位元組層級分詞對 Transformer 具語言中立與免詞表優勢,但序列過長導致運算成本高、模型品質下降。本文受輸入法自動補全啟發,提出壓縮式輸入表示:先訓練一個輕量自迴歸位元組語言模型,辨識容易被上下文預測的位元組並移除,再將壓縮後序列交給標準 encoder–decoder Transformer。文章比較四種壓縮方案(無哨兵、顯式哨兵、長度編碼哨兵、隱式哨兵)與絕對、相對兩種預測閾值,以機器翻譯驗證。結果顯示:英法翻譯中,隱式哨兵在壓縮比 0.679(刪除近三分之一來源位元組)下仍與未壓縮位元組基準持平;在 WMT19 的芬蘭文、俄文、中文對英文任務上,壓縮比介於 0.47 至 0.67 時品質相當甚至更好,俄英 BLEU 從 21.4 提升到 28.3。位元組類別分析顯示空格與 UTF-8 編碼位元組最常被移除,表示壓縮主要針對結構性冗餘而非語意內容。限制包括僅測機器翻譯、預測器架構固定、壓縮僅作用於來源端。此研究指出大量輸入位元組其實可隱式表示,為降低位元組模型的序列長度負擔提供簡單機制,並在 BLT 與神經壓縮之間佔據中間定位。

links.title: Prototype-Rectified Iterative Self-supervised Manifold Denoising under Severe Acoustic Shift

evidence: Abstract: PRISM improves over the zero-shot baseline by +12.94 pp on UrbanSound8K and surpasses oracle-assisted ContextDA by +9.41 pp; §5.2.1 confirms 71.71% vs 58.77% zero-shot in Table 1.

§5.1.2: All experiments use only LAION-CLAP (checkpoint 630k-audioset-fusion-best.pt) with fixed hyperparameters (K=60, p=0.8, q=0.7, α=0.3, λ=0.01, R=3) across every fold, environment, and dataset; no second audio-text backbone is evaluated.
§5.3/Table 5: Incremental ablation attributes +9.58 pp to OPCA, +3.09 pp to CCVD, +0.27 pp to ABR over the 58.77% zero-shot baseline.
§6.1/§6.2: street_music collapses −17.20 pp (92.53%→75.33%) under CCVD (Polyphonic Trap); CAR recovers it to 83.49% (+8.16 pp) at a 0.48 pp cost in overall accuracy (Table 7).
Table 6/§5.3: 311 ms one-time precomputation and 0.0009 ms per-sample inference with no gradients; Table 4 shows PRISM highest at every SNR including 57.45% vs 32.69% zero-shot at −6 dB.
§5.2.1/DCASE row of Table 1: under assumption violation (device mismatch), base PRISM degrades to 15.63% vs 17.36% zero-shot while PRISM+CAR reaches 17.70%, the only method above zero-shot.
llm_evaluation.rationale: This is a pure-audio paper (environmental sound classification robustness for CLAP-style audio-text models), which the rubric places out of scope, capping preference relevance despite incidental matches to 'foundation model' and 'test-time' keywords; there is no LLM, NLP, reasoning, or agent methodology — the frozen text encoder only supplies classification anchors. Methodologically, the work is competent and somewhat novel: the Affine Noise Hypothesis (low-rank affine latent distortion, SVD-validated in §3.2/Fig. 2), closed-form Procrustes/Fisher/ridge corrections compiled into a static projection matrix (§4), and the identified 'Polyphonic Trap' failure mode with CAR mitigation (§6) form a coherent, gradient-free TTA pipeline. Rigor is above average: incremental ablations (Table 5), hyperparameter sensitivity (Fig. 6), an assumption-violation test on DCASE, and fixed hyperparameters across folds; arithmetic in §5.2.1 checks out against Tables 1-4. However, no statistical significance testing or variance is reported, the Affine Noise Hypothesis validation requires paired clean-noisy embeddings (diagnostic only), and the sub-microsecond 0.0009 ms latency claim (Table 6) is stated without measurement detail. Evidence strength is solid but limited by a single backbone (LAION-CLAP 630k only, §5.1.2) and transductive calibration that uses the full unlabeled evaluation batch. Reproducibility is good: code URL, public datasets, exact checkpoint and hyperparameters (K=60, p=0.8, q=0.7, α=0.3, λ=0.01, γ=10).

primary_link.title: Prototype-Rectified Iterative Self-supervised Manifold Denoising under Severe Acoustic Shift

radar.summary: Audio-Text Foundation Models (ATMs) fail catastrophically under severe acoustic noise, yet existing adaptation strategies either rely on gradient-based Test-Time Adaptation (TTA), which reinforces noise rather than signal, or on prompt tuning that requires privileged noise annotations unavailable at inference. We address these failures with PRISM (Prototype-Rectified Iterative Self-supervised Manifold Denoising), a training-free, source-free TTA framework grounded in the Affine Noise Hypothesis:
radar.summary_zh: 音訊—文字基礎模型(Audio-Text Foundation Models)在嚴重聲學雜訊下效能崩壞,而既有調適策略中,梯度式測試時調適(TTA)反而強化雜訊,提示調優則需要推論時無法取得的特權雜訊標註。本文提出 PRISM,一個免訓練、免來源資料的 TTA 框架,立基於「仿射雜訊假說」:嚴重聲學雜訊在多模態潛在空間造成低秩仿射偏移,實證顯示超過 90% 失真能量集中在前 60 個主成分。PRISM 以凍結文字原型為幾何錨點,利用未標記目標批次,依序執行正交 Procrustes 跨模態對齊(OPCA)、類別條件變異緊縮(CCVD)與逐類殘差平移,再以 Affine Bias Regression 將三個封閉式修正編譯成單一靜態投影矩陣;推論時只需一次矩陣—向量乘法,約 0.0009 毫秒,遠快於梯度方法。在 UrbanSound8K 上較零樣本提升 12.94 個百分點,超越需特權提示的 ContextDA 9.41 個百分點;ESC-50 達 93.39%。作者並找出寬頻類別與雜訊子空間重疊的「複音陷阱」,以信心感知迴歸(CAR)部分緩解,最多挽回 8.16 個百分點。限制包括在 DCASE 等違反低秩假設的裝置失配情境下失效,以及校準具有批次相依的轉導性質。此方法使邊緣裝置上的即時穩健推論變得可行。
radar.title: Prototype-Rectified Iterative Self-supervised Manifold Denoising under Severe Acoustic Shift
radar.title_zh: PRISM:嚴重聲學偏移下的原型校正迭代自監督流形去噪

links.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages'; models 'exhibit a left-branching preference' on artificial languages but an SVO advantage on natural languages at scale, establishing data-driven bias.

Section 5.2, Table 1: SVO-SOV gap absent at 5 MB (Mann-Whitney U=353, p=.99) and large at 1 GB (Cliff's delta=-0.76, U=84, p<10^-5), with the same 68 languages compared across all four training sizes so the shift is attributable to data volume.

Section A.5, Table 6: the is_SOV x size interaction survives all covariate controls (beta +0.049 to +0.038, p<=.001) including morphological complexity (subword MATTR), resourcedness, and OSCAR web-crawl share, plus a maximal random-effects robustness refit.

Section 5.2, Table 2 and footnotes 11-13: SVO advantage extends to mGPT and XGLM but reverses in BLOOM because 21 of 28 SVO languages are very-low-resource Niger-Congo (median 1.7 MB vs 3.7 GB), supporting the resource/data-quality explanation.

Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1: 192 grammars x 10 disjoint splits trained per data size (~252 A100 GPU-hours), full hyperparameters in Table 3, plus a unigram-tokenizer re-run of all 192 models (Spearman rho=0.94 at 5 MB) confirming results are not tokenizer-driven.

Limitations section: admits GPT-2-only architecture, written formal/translated corpora (FLORES-200, PUD; translationese risk), coarse data-quality proxy, and categorical WALS word-order labels as constraints on generalization.
Title page: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/kleines-gespenst/word-order-preferences'; Appendix A.7 documents licensing for all artefacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core decoder-only LM/transformer analysis (GPT-2, Goldfish, mGPT, BLOOM, XGLM) squarely matching the highest-weight LLM, transformer, and NLP preferences, though it does not touch reasoning, agents, RAG, or prompting. Methodologically strong: 192 artificial languages x 10 splits x 2 data sizes, matched architectures across artificial/natural settings, Holm-Bonferroni corrections, mixed-effects models with morphological/resource/data-composition covariates, script-confound subset checks, PUD replication, and a tokenizer robustness re-run. The central claim (word order preference is data-driven, SVO advantage emerging with data scale) is supported by quantified effects (Cliff's delta -0.76 at 1GB, is_SOV x size beta surviving all controls) and the homogenisation risk is carefully framed as a precondition rather than an overclaimed result. Novelty is good but partly incremental over White & Cotterell (2021), whose left-branching finding is corroborated rather than overturned; the artificial+natural unification and scaling analysis are the genuinely new contributions. Generalizability is limited by small (20.6M) models, written/translated evaluation text, and no frontier-model validation, which the Limitations section transparently acknowledges. Code, data, hyperparameters, compute cost, and licensing are all provided, making the work highly reproducible.

primary_link.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

top5.summary: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages em
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討語言模型是否對語序有系統性偏好,以及這些偏好源自架構本身還是訓練資料。作者結合兩條研究路線:一是在192種人工語言(6種S/V/O基本語序搭配32種內部成分排列)上訓練GPT-2風格的解碼器模型;二是評估訓練資料量從5MB到1GB的單語Goldfish模型,以及mGPT、BLOOM、XGLM等多語模型,涵蓋類型多樣的自然語言,以困惑度與BPEC(每英文字元位元數)等指標衡量建模難度。結果顯示,在人工語言上模型一致偏好左分支配置,既不符合跨語言的語序共性,也與人類學習者的和諧偏好相左;在自然語言上,小資料量時未見明顯偏好,但資料規模擴大後,SVO語言變得最容易建模,SOV語言儘管是跨語言最常見的語序反而落後,且此SVO優勢延伸到多語模型,並與語言資源等級及資料品質相關,而非語序本身。同一架構在兩種設定下呈現相反偏好,證明實際觀察到的語序偏好是資料驅動的。作者也討論限制:實驗限於GPT-2架構與書面正式語料,類型學資料庫的二分標籤可能掩蓋漸變的語序變異,資料品質也只能以粗略代理指標衡量。由於高資源語言絕大多數為SVO,這種偏好在LLM普及下可能導致「靜默類型同質化」,逐漸侵蝕語序多樣性,因此透過資料策展可望緩解此風險,對多語言NLP的公平性具重要意義。

links.title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning

evidence: Section 4.1: FoT@32 and SC@32 return the same correctness outcome on 3,580 of 3,600 paired model-problem instances (12 FoT wins, 8 losses), not significant under McNemar's exact test (p=0.50), bootstrap CI [-0.14,+0.36] pp.
Table 2: across 6 models x 4 math benchmarks, FoT@32 averages 94.5 accuracy vs SC@32's 94.4 with 50.7% average attention-FLOP saving; per-cell savings range ~33-60%.

Table 7 (Section 4.5): two-by-two ablation shows random pruning loses accuracy (-0.42) at similar compute savings while hesitation-density pruning preserves SC@32 (94.61 without early voting), isolating the lexical signal as the operative mechanism.
Section 4.4 / Table 6: online SGLang deployment on a single A100 with DS-R1-7B on 30 AIME24 problems: FoT@32 solves 24/30 vs SC@32's 23/30, wall time -37.6%, attention FLOPs -56.1%.

Section 4.2 / Table 4: unchanged configuration transfers to four held-out models (Qwen3-14B/32B, Skywork-OR1-7B, Phi-4-reasoning), aggregate +0.6pp with 51.9% average FLOP saving; Section 4.3 / Table 5 shows GPQA-Diamond +1.3pp and LCB-Lite +1.42pp mean pass rate with pass@32 -2.8pp.

Section 6 Limitations: evaluation restricted to extractable-answer tasks, calibration pool has MATH500 supplying 3,000 of 3,600 pairs, English-only marker kernel and fixed checkpoints; Appendix D.2 quantifies savings degrading from 48.7% to 23.0% under linear attention.

Appendix D.1: generation uses SGLang with T=0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 30, max 32,768 tokens, seed 42+rep_id; grading moved from exact match to math_verify with effects disclosed; Table 8 lists the full 21-marker kernel with point-biserial statistics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning-efficiency work squarely within scope: a training-free test-time scaling method (early voting + hesitation-marker-density pruning) that matches SC@32 accuracy at roughly half attention FLOPs across six LRMs, directly serving the high-weight reasoning/CoT, LLM, scaling-efficiency, and inference-serving preferences. Novelty is moderate: the lexical 'Wait/Actually/perhaps' signal is simple and adjacent to prior keyword-suppression and budget-forcing work; the distinct contribution is pool-level relative density ranking plus vote banking, and the demonstrated Pareto point rather than a new modeling technique. Rigor is unusually strong: 115,200 rollouts, pre-registered baselines (Adaptive Consistency, Slim-SC, DSC, Certaindex proxy), a 340-configuration hyperparameter sweep, a 2x2 mechanism ablation showing random pruning loses accuracy while density pruning does not (Table 7), kernel-size robustness, and significance testing (McNemar p=0.50, bootstrap CI) with honest reporting of non-significant accuracy deltas and three coexisting FLOP accountings. Evidence is mostly well supported, though most results are offline simulations of a pre-generated pool and the online deployment (Table 6) covers only 30 problems on one model; the calibration pool is admittedly MATH500-dominated. Generalization is demonstrated on four held-out models and two out-of-domain tasks with an unchanged configuration, but is scoped to English, extractable-answer tasks and large pools (k>=16-24), and savings degrade to 23.0% under linear attention (Appendix D.2). Reproducibility is good: generation parameters, seeds, the full 21-marker kernel, checkpoint schedules, and baseline configurations are disclosed, but no explicit code-release claim is made.

primary_link.title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning

top5.summary: Large Reasoning Models produce diverse, sometimes inconsistent answers across repeated queries on the same problem, so multi-sample inference is a prerequisite for reliable deployment. Majority voting at k rollouts is the standard solution and the de facto accuracy target for this regime, but it is prohibitively expensive at the scale LRMs require. We introduce Funnel of Thoughts (FoT), an inference-time method that preserves the full 32-trajectory voted accuracy while halving its attention FLOP
top5.summary_zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）對同一問題重複取樣時，答案常多樣且不一致，因此以 Self-Consistency（SC@k）多數決投票作為可靠部署的標準做法，但每條軌跡都須完整生成，注意力計算量隨序列長度平方成長，在 LRM 規模下成本高昂。本文分析 6 個 LRM 在 AIME24/25、AMC23 與 MATH500 上共 115,200 條推理軌跡，發現錯誤與無答案軌跡僅佔約 9.5%，卻消耗不成比例的運算，且其文本中猶豫標記（如 Wait、Actually、perhaps）密度顯著偏高，與正確性呈負相關。作者據此提出 Funnel of Thoughts（FoT）：在固定 token 數檢查點執行兩項機制——早期投票先將已承諾答案的軌跡存入票庫，軌跡剪枝則依密度排名移除最無生產力的少數，全程不需訓練、獎勵模型或 logit 存取。結果顯示 FoT@32 在維持 SC@32 準確率的同時，節省約一半注意力 FLOPs（全模型 FLOP 減少 28.8%），線上部署時整體耗時亦降低 37.6%，且相同設定可直接轉移到未調校的模型與 GPQA、程式碼生成等跨領域任務。限制包括僅適用於可抽取最終答案的任務、取樣池過小（k<16）時剪枝可能有害，以及猶豫標記核心與答案承諾偵測皆以英文情境為主，且在高效率注意力機制下節省幅度會縮減。其價值在於以零成本的詞彙訊號，大幅降低測試時擴展的運算門檻。
