top5.title_zh: Funnel of Thoughts：透過早期投票與軌跡剪枝實現高效率測試時擴展

links.title: Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit

evidence: Abstract: 'Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells ... churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta', with cells spanning 1.3B-405B parameters.
Section 3.2 / Table 1: TOST certification tables computed from observed discordance rates, with paired-design advantage ranging 2.3x (GSM8K) to 14.7x (MuSR), 4.2x pooled over 1,707 cells.
Section 5.2 / Table 3: 'No audited source declares a prospective numerical equivalence margin'; 0 of 16 eligible sources release task-matched per-item outputs (Section 5.4).
Section 6.2 / Table 5: preregistered H3 rule returns 'supported' with winner reversals across calibration seeds in 5 of 8 cells and range/gap criterion in 7 of 8.
Section 7 / Table 20: exploratory harness-sensitivity study shows scoring-filter choice moves fixed-model GSM8K accuracy 0.232 to 0.566 (Appendix H.1), R up to 1.585 relative to quantization.
Section 8: artifacts released at 10.5281/zenodo.21939143, including 88 per-item JSONL files, flipeval package (Apache-2.0), and reproduction package.
Section 9 and 9.1: explicit scope limits - atlas is 'a record, not a sample'; binary per-item outcome model is a binding condition; graded-metric extension stated but not validated.

Appendix K.3/K.4: claim extraction performed by LLM agent sessions; model IDs, prompts and settings not recorded; no human-validation subset extracted; author states design is 'auditable but not re-executable'.
Section 3.7 / Appendix B: preregistration compliance with dated amendments; the analyst decision that moved the headline (K=1 to 5 to 4, settled at 1 of 11) is disclosed with its timeline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A preregistered evaluation-methodology paper on statistical certification of compressed LLMs (GPTQ vs AWQ on Qwen2.5/Llama, MMLU/GSM8K), squarely within LLM scope via the LLM (2.5), Scaling & Efficiency (quantization/compression), and evaluation preferences. Methodological rigor is exceptional: frozen protocols with dated amendments, disclosed analyst rulings, independent reimplemented spot-checks, and sensitivity sweeps. Evidence combines a 1,707-cell observational atlas with a controlled 8-cell seed-paired experiment showing ranking reversals. Novelty is good but transfer-based: the churn/cancellation insight is credited to Dutta et al. 2024 and TOST is standard statistics; the shift from detection to certification plus required-n tables is the incremental contribution. Empirical claims are deliberately scope-bounded (binary metrics only, 4-bit, one vendor stratum, 1.5B-8B controlled grid), limiting generalizability; the audit's LLM-agent extraction lacked human validation. Artifact release (Zenodo DOI, 88 per-item JSONL files, flipeval code, hashes) is exemplary.

links.title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form

evidence: §2.2: 'The primary checkpoint is Qwen3.6-27B... Instruction-tuned checkpoints throughout' plus four additional open-weight checkpoints — core LLM subject matter.
§4: 'Attention carries most of it; no MLP in the window carries any' (attn.L39 +1.618 vs mlp.L39 -0.400 under Lz) — attention/residual-stream mechanism analysis.

§9 Related Work: 'Four differences make our transport result an increment' over Gurnee et al. (2026), while conceding the gather 'belongs to an established literature' (Geva 2023; Wang 2023; Todd 2024).
§8: negative result that lens readout shifts are uncalibrated — three components move readout within 12% but differ 7.4x in behavioural effect, with a matched positive control.
Table 1: paired contrasts with 10,000-resample instance-clustered bootstrap; flexible−control ΔRz = +0.0891 [+0.0799, +0.0983] at accuracy matched at 0.940 in both arms.

Appendix A: BH at q=0.05 'runs independently inside each donor pairing'; label-symmetry guard (breaking it inflates the headline effect 26%); selection provenance with frozen L39/H15 screens and a confirmation split table.
Appendix B: gauge-invariance derivation with fp32 verification (largest logit change 1.4e-5) used to disqualify one checkpoint.

§2.1 and §5: readout saturation admitted ('92% of flexible-arm cells at L40–L44 read above 0.999'); under Rz 'the same grid does not localise the window', so depth claims rest on the non-saturating readout.
§10 Limitations: 'the attention route, the head, the mediation and the ablations on Qwen3.6-27B and the language family alone'; mediation partial ('runs through' not 'mediated by').
Appendix E: two candidate checkpoints excluded by explicit screens; Llama-3.1-8B window sweep uninterpretable for lack of accuracy headroom — scope condition on the design.

Appendix H / Reproducibility statement: exact HF revisions, SHA-256 of lens and dataset files, seeded stochasticity, MIT-licensed releases, and an audit command matching every numeric literal to the artifact tree.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability study of open-weight LLMs (Qwen3.6-27B, phi-4, Llama-3.1-8B, gemma-4-31B) using Jacobian-lens readouts, activation patching, probing and ablation to show a latent variable is attention-gathered into a mid-depth 'workspace' window rather than admitted at the query position. Highly aligned with LLM, interpretability and transformer-architecture preferences. Novelty is genuine but incremental: the paper itself concedes attention-to-position transport is 'convergent' with Geva/Wang/Todd and scopes its increments to demand-dependence over a fixed context, installation-vs-survival separation, and a methodological negative (readout shifts uncalibrated). Rigor is exceptional: instance-clustered bootstrap, BH correction per pairing, a verified gauge-invariance argument (Appendix B), frozen selection with a confirmation split, adversarial bounds on estimator nuisance, and candid scoping. Evidence is broad but key effects are small, window localization fails under the saturating readout, the operator decomposition flips sign, mediation is partial and its share unstable, and the head decomposition is single-pairing. Mechanism claims beyond the entry effect rest on one checkpoint and one task family. Reproducibility is exemplary: released code/data/lenses, exact HF revisions with SHA-256, and an audit command matching every numeric literal to artifacts.

primary_link.title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form

top5.summary: Language models hold latent quantities in a form they can report on, and more of a quantity is present in that form when the task requires reusing it flexibly. What causes a representation to enter that form is open, and the word workspace invites an admission story: a gate that decides what gets in. Testing it on open-weight models with Jacobian lenses, over a benchmark whose five arms share an identical context, we find no gate where it predicts one. Demand raises a concept's lens visibility b
top5.summary_zh: 語言模型的殘差流中存在一組內容可被模型言語報告的方向（verbalizable workspace），當任務需要彈性重用某潛在量時，該量在此形式中更為顯著；但什麼促使表徵進入該形式仍未明。「工作空間」一詞暗示「准入」假說：存在一道閘門決定何者進入。作者以 Jacobian lens 檢驗開放權重模型（主要檢查點為 Qwen3.6-27B），設計五臂共享完全相同上下文的 JGateBench 基準，包括 automatic、report、flexible、control 與 supplied，使所有對比皆為配對內比較。結果反駁准入說：需求確實提高概念可見度（準確度配對下 flexible 對 control 為 +0.0891 百分位，對 supplied 亦為 +0.050），且效應在四個檢查點與兩個任務家族上均為正；但單一線性探針能從每一臂——包括不需該變數的對照臂——解碼出潛在變數，達選擇校正後基線的 6.4–9.0 倍，可見性與可用性分離。機制上，是注意力在中等深度窗口（約 L36–L42）把變數「聚集」到查詢位置：非飽和讀出下，窗口內傳輸量至少為較淺層的 17 倍，且窗口內沒有任何 MLP 輸出呈正向貢獻；窗口下緣是存活失敗，過早植入的值無法存續到讀出，上緣則是介入由替代轉為破壞；此窗口在 64 層混合架構與 62 層稠密的 gemma-4-31B-it 上落於相同分數深度，並隨任務需求集中約七倍。限制方面，研究只定位植入與讀取之處，未定位變數來自文章的路徑；lens 讀出亦非因果使用的校準量度——三個元件使讀出位移在 12% 內相近，對答案行為的影響卻相差 7.4 倍。此文對「把讀出變化解讀為機制」的慣例提出附正面對照的方法學警訊，並警示 activation patching 結果對 donor 配對抽樣高度敏感。

Appendix C.2: bank-test semantic alignment audit, ALFWorld nearest-bank cosine mean 0.879 vs random-bank control 0.068; BCB-Hard mean 0.594 vs random 0.061.

Appendix B.3/Table 5: MemGPT, Mem0, Zep excluded from main comparison on budget grounds ('roughly 2,700 to 9,000 auxiliary LLM calls... and wall-clock budgets of 11 to 23 hours'), with cost-matched surrogates in the main table.

Appendix G (Limitations): documents two implementation deviations (M8 PPO controller replaced by zero-shot LLM; M11 KV in-place edit replaced by utterance-level re-prefill due to Qwen3 hybrid attention kernel incompatibility).
Appendix D.4: 'We report point estimates in the main tables for legibility' with only a qualitative resampling argument (gaps ≥0.05 'unlikely to reverse'), i.e., no CIs or significance tests.
Appendix A/Table 3: 52-system survey quantifies evaluation gaps — LoCoMo 38% + LongMemEval 24% of benchmark pairs, 81% GPT-family backbones, only 21% report any efficiency metric.

Table 1/Section 4.1: no single substrate wins every capability; M5 leads LoCoMo and LME-S P4 across all three model bands (e.g., 0.683/0.719) while internal substrates (M9) collapse on QA (P4 0.379–0.399).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-scope evaluation paper sitting at the intersection of the highest-weight preferences (LLM agents, memory/long-context, RAG-style retrieval substrates). It delivers the claimed first controlled harness comparison of 11 memory substrates (7 families) across 3 backbones and 4 benchmarks spanning user-centric QA (LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, MemoryAgentBench) and agent-centric regimes (ALFWorld, BigCodeBench-Hard), with 26 performance/efficiency metrics. Novel contributions are genuine for an evaluation paper: a 52-system landscape survey exposing benchmark concentration (62% of pairs on LoCoMo+LME, only 21% reporting efficiency), a cross-regime Pareto analysis, a retrieval-depth reversal finding with an attention-probing mechanism explanation, and a scalability sweep. Rigor is strong: substrate isolated as the variable, bank-test semantic alignment validated against random-bank controls (Appendix C.2), excluded production systems costed explicitly (Appendix B.3/G), implementation deviations documented (Appendix B.2). Deductions: no confidence intervals or significance testing (point estimates only, Appendix D.4), single LLM-judge (gpt-4o-mini) as primary QA metric, substrate implementations are adaptations of existing methods rather than new methods, code only promised 'upon acceptance', and specific substrate rankings may be backbone/benchmark-bound even if the regime-level design rule generalizes.

top5.summary_zh: 隨著 LLM 代理人邁向長時程任務,持久記憶已成為核心基礎設施,但既有評估多集中於對話基準與準確率,鮮少指出何種記憶基底(即記憶表示與儲存的底層媒體)在何種操作情境下最為合適。本文提出受控的 harness 評估,將記憶基底設為唯一實驗變數,涵蓋外部記憶的扁平索引、文字紀錄、結構化、階層式與精煉式五族,以及內部記憶的權重與 activation 兩族,共 11 種方法;於 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B-AWQ 與 Gemma 三種骨幹上,在 LoCoMo、MemoryAgentBench、ALFWorld 與 BigCodeBench-Hard 四個基準量測 26 項效能與效率指標。主要發現:沒有任何基底在所有情境皆佔優;結構化圖記憶領先對話問答,卻在代理式任務被支配;精煉式記憶則反之。擴大檢索廣度有助事實問答,卻透過注意力稀釋傷害循序決策;擴展性構成第三個路由軸線,精煉式記憶隨歷史增長最為穩健,結構化與全文基底則面臨部署極限。作者據此提出「以讀取廣度換取寫入深度」的設計原則,並主張通用代理人記憶應為多基底、多代理人的組合系統。限制包括將 MemGPT、Mem0、Zep 等生產級系統排除於主比較之外,且兩種實作與原方法略有偏差。本研究為自適應記憶系統提供了首個跨情境的路由訊號與部署成本分析,深具設計參考價值。
